chapters.title: Chapter 651 Buy Second Building
paragraphs: "Father! Mother! I'm back!"
Yun Shang, Guo Xuehua, Li Yao, Yun Aoxian, and Yun Qinghai turned to look at Yun Xinyue, who was walking toward them.

The presence of the seven women behind Zhang Fei attracted their attention, and their beauty captured them. Yun Shang only admired their beauty for a few seconds and turned his gaze away again, but Yun Aoxian and Yun Qinghai couldn't take their eyes off them.
"Hiss!" With a grimace, Yun Aoxian turned to face Li Yao, who was fiercely glaring at him and pinching his waist. 'Wife! Stop it!'

'If you dare glance at those women again, I will let you sleep in the guest room for a year, and you cannot touch me during that time.' After Yun Aoxian nodded with a pitiful face, Li Yao immediately pulled his hand back and looked at all the women again. 'The three women in the shop are already extremely beautiful, but he still has so many women who are no less beautiful than them.'
'Son!'

Upon hearing his mother's voice in his mind, Yun Qinghai immediately lowered his face, but his heart raced at the thought of one of them. 'Sigh! The pink-haired woman is beautiful and graceful, but she is Zhang Fei's woman.'
The pink-haired woman Yun Qinghai was referring to was Angela, especially since only she and Hu Yue had long pink hair in Zhang Fei's harem.
Zhang Fei naturally noticed Yun Qinghai's actions. He pulled Angela closer and gave her an intimate hug around the waist, which made the female demon fish feel a little awkward.

As they arrived in front of Yun Shang and the others, Yun Xinyue immediately hugged his parents in turn. "Hehehe! Zhang Fei wanted to look at the buildings in this capital, and he also wanted to go to the Guo Clan, so I went home with him. However, I will go with him again to continue my seclusion after his business in our kingdom is finished, and I probably won't be home for quite some time."
"It's okay; you can focus on your seclusion." Yun Shang then asked Zhang Fei. "Are they your wives? Have you found a suitable building for your shop in our capital?"

"Yes, Emperor Yun. They are my wives, with the exception of Feng Yao." Zhang Fei then introduced the six women to them. "I saw a suitable building on the way here, and Princess Xinyue mentioned that it's right next to the Alchemy Union. Since the building is empty, I want to use it for my new shop and restaurant."
Zhang Fei's decision shocked both Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua. "Do you want to clash in direct trade with them?"

"No." Zhang Fei then told them. "Unlike my shop in the Xian Capital, I will not sell herbs or pills in this kingdom, and I will only sell items from my home realm. That way, I don't need to clash against them in trade, and we can avoid meaningless fights with them."

"Since you decided, you can have the building for 150,000 gold coins." Zhang Fei unhesitatingly agreed to the price and handed the gold coins to Yun Shang, who immediately contacted someone to get the building document. "How long will you stay in our capital?"

"I will stay for two days to renovate the building, and I will open my new shop and restaurant once the renovation is complete. My five wives will handle both, and I will supervise from home." Zhang Fei then pointed at Zhong Yan and Angela before asking Guo Xuehua. "Can they train at the lightning pond in your clan, Empress Gou?"

Guo Xuehua immediately nodded at him. "They have the lightning element, and they can practice in that place. However, due to their limited body cultivation, they are unable to practice for extended periods. They must take a break every six hours and resume their practice after another six hours, or they will die."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, and Yun Shang immediately handed him the building document that had been sent to him. "In that case, we will leave now to buy the necessities for renovating the building, and we will visit the Guo Clan once we open our shop and restaurant."
After they left, Li Yao immediately asked Yun Xinyue. "How was your training after training in his private place?"

"Hehehe." Yun Xinyue laughed before demonstrating her speed. Although she had not yet adapted to the first level of the gravity feature, her training in the past few days had already given her speed a considerable boost. "What do you all think?"

Yun Qinghai became depressed after witnessing his sister's speed. Although their strength and speed were previously equal, he failed the challenge, and his sister advanced to the finish. Moreover, Yun Xinyue also established a good relationship with Zhang Fei when they were in the tower, and he gave her an opportunity to develop herself.
"I'll go back to my room first." Yun Qinghai immediately stood up and ran away, leaving them behind.
Guo Xuehua let out a heavy sigh and hurried after her second son. Yun Xinyue, who had previously been happy, became gloomy because of her second brother's behavior.

"You don't have to be gloomy like this, Xinyue." Yun Shang then pulled her sole daughter to sit beside her. "You must know that Qinghai is not jealous of you, but he is indeed weak-hearted. He has always had a hard time accepting defeat, and his loss to Zhou Tai has been haunting him, so he has become like that now."
Yun Xinyue nodded and hugged her father. "I don't mean to show off to my brother, and I just want to show him that we can still improve."
"I know." Yun Shang sighed softly before rubbing her daughter's head. "Even though it is difficult, your brother will overcome his defeat and return to his true self."

Yun Xinyue then told them. "Xianqin has already broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Transcend two days ago, and I don't want to lose to her. Therefore, I decided to enter a long seclusion, and I hope to break through to that stage after I come out of my seclusion."
"How could Xianqin suddenly break through?" Li Yao suddenly asked.
"Haha." Yun Xinyue simply laughed and stuck out her tongue at her sister-in-law. "I will catch up to you two soon, so you must not be lazy, or I will surpass you."

Li Yao's forehead darkened, and Yun Aoxian shook his head at his little sister. "Yao'er and I will soon break through to the 2-Moon Divine Transcend, so you must work harder when you enter seclusion to catch up to us."
"Don't worry! I will prove that I can be strong, and I will also surpass you two." Yun Xinyue then kissed her father's cheeks before running off to catch up with Zhang Fei and the others.

Yun Shang shook his head, then turned his gaze to his son and daughter-in-law. "You two have been too focused on your cultivation for the past decade, so I think it's time for you to think about your descendants. Your mother and I have long dreamed of a grandchild, so I hope you two don't delay it any longer and give us a grandchild as soon as possible."
Li Yao immediately lowered her face in shame, but Yun Aoxian rebutted his father. "Father, we—"

"No buts." Yun Shang immediately interrupted his son. "Aoxian, strength is important, but our lineage is much more important. Moreover, you are often involved in the battlefield, and the situation on the battlefield is difficult to predict, so I want you to think about it seriously."

Yun Aoxian looked annoyed, but he also understood that lineage was important. Moreover, he was the crown prince of their kingdom, and his little brother was hard to rely on. "All right, we will not delay having children any longer, but we will not promise you anything, and it is up to fate."

"Haha." Yun Shang laughed and took out a pill bottle before handing it to Li Yao. "It contains the Lotus Fertility Pill, which increases pregnancy chances, so take it before doing it with your husband."
Li Yao was truly embarrassed by Yun Shang's attitude, but she immediately accepted the bottle and stored it in her storage ring.
"Go now."
"Yes, Father." Yun Aoxian immediately led his wife away, and Yun Shang went elsewhere to take care of his royal affairs.
At the border of the two demon kingdoms, the two demon emperors and empresses were already standing side by side, and their children were standing beside them.

Behind Ximeng Gongfu and Zheng Moyue, Xian Hong leisurely stood at his spot, leading the people of the Dark Demon Kingdom. Next to him, a female demon in a sexy outfit was leading the people of the Zheng Clan.
Two demon men with three horns on their heads were standing behind Ximen Changtian and Nu Huangjin, leading the people of the Ximen Demon Kingdom and the Nu Clan.
"Since everyone has gathered, how about we leave now, Big Brother?" Ximen Gongfu asked.

Ximen Changtian nodded to his little brother before turning to his two children. "Hongwu, you must protect your little sister, and Uncle Gui will protect you. As for you, I forbid you from leaving your room, Yueliang."
Ximen Yueliang momentarily raised an eyebrow before nodding. "Yes, Father."

"I will definitely protect Yueliang, Father." Ximen Hongwu replied, stealing a glance at Ximen Yan, who stood with an indifferent expression. 'Did something happen to him? Why does his attitude seem different than usual?'
After that, the entourage of the two demon kingdoms departed using two different flying artifacts.
Ximen Hogwu then spoke to her sister. "Let's go back, Yueliang."
"Yeah." Ximen Yueliang immediately flew after her big brother, but she suddenly received a voice transmission from Ximen Yan, causing her to grit her teeth. 'Tch! That bastard!'
Ximen Yan also flew towards the Dark Demon Kingdom, but Xin Yanluo suddenly appeared in front of him and took him to another area.
*Bam*
Xin Yanluo forcefully slammed Ximen Yan onto the ground, yet the Ximen Prince remained unfazed, his gaze also unusual.

Xin Yanluo stepped on Ximen Yan's chest and pulled his soul out of his body, but she frowned after finding Zhang Fei's demon slave mark inside. "As expected! A demon has already enslaved him! Who is the demon that enslaved him? When did he enslave him? Could it have occurred within the Star Tower?"

Xin Yanluo then touched Zhang Fei's demon slave mark in Ximen Yan's soul. She wanted to remove it from his soul, or else he would be useless to her. As soon as she started injecting her demon power into the slave mark, she suddenly received a voice transmission, which shocked her.

Xin Yanluo immediately spread her senses as far as possible and checked the entire demon island, but she couldn't find anything suspicious. "Who is that man? Why can't I find him? How could he know my name and origin? How could he know about my relationship with Zhou Xiaochuan?"

Xin Yanluo looked at Ximen Yan again for a while before returning his soul to his body again. "Tch! If I weren't afraid of Princess Feng, I would have forcibly removed that man's slave mark from this foolish demon's soul."

Ximen Yan immediately stood up and spoke to Xin Yanluo. "My master asks you not to interfere with his plans, or he will report you to the demon hunters in the upper realms, and you must know the risks."
"You!" Xin Yanluo clenched her fist tightly and wanted to punch Ximen Yan, but her hand stopped in mid-air. "What does your master want from me?"

"My master wants to meet you to talk." Xin Yanluo frowned at Ximen Yan's answer. "If you are willing, you can go to the small island in the middle of the southern ocean at midnight, and he will meet you there. However, he wants you to bring your master with you, especially since he doesn't want to talk to people who can't make decisions."
After he said that, Ximen Yan immediately flew away from that place, leaving Xin Yanluo perplexed.

Xin Yanluo instantly disappeared from that place, and she arrived at Ju Yingzhi's room a few minutes later. She immediately informed her about the message from Ximen Yan earlier, causing her to frown.
"What do you think we should do? Should we go find that mysterious man, or should we leave this realm right now?" Xin Yanluo asked.

Ju Yingzhi continued to think about the pros and cons for some time. "I'm curious about how that mysterious man knows your identity and our origins, but I'm worried that he's related to Feng Yao. If they have a relationship with each other, I'm afraid they will attack us, and I won't be able to fight them with my current strength. Moreover, her phoenix flames are too terrifying, and we will definitely die in her hands."
"Does that mean we will leave this realm now?" Xin Yanluo asked in impatience.
Ju Yingzhi nodded. "We will leave this realm now and go to one of the demon realms in these middle realms, or we will face great danger if Feng Yao finds us."
"In that case, let's not waste any more time and leave this realm right now." The two female demons immediately exited the secret place.

However, they suddenly sensed a powerful pressure moving toward their location, causing the weakened Ju Yingzhi to stagger backward. Xin Yanluo immediately supported her and looked into the distance, but her expression turned pale as she saw a gigantic red bird flying toward them at high speed. "Master."
Ju Yingzhi gave a light nod. "Sigh! The mysterious man is indeed in a relationship with Feng Yao, and she has been monitoring this entire realm with her divine senses."
"What should we do now?"
"It's too late for us to leave."

In a few moments, Feng Yao arrived at their location. She immediately returned to her human form and landed in front of them. "I had guessed that one of you had spatial abilities, but I didn't expect to meet an Abyssal Rift Demon like you, Ju Yingzhi."
"What do you want from us, Feng Yao? Do you want to kill us?" Ju Yingzhi softly asked.
Xin Yanluo immediately pulled Ju Yingzhi back, returned to her demon form, and released her demon power. "Princess Feng, if you dare to attack my master, I will fight you to the death."

"Hehe." Xin Yanluo's action made Feng Yao chuckle. "If I wanted to attack you two, I would have done so before I arrived. If only you hadn't touched my friend's slave mark, you guys would have been able to hide safely. Unfortunately, your reckless attempt to remove my friend's slave mark allowed me to pinpoint your location."
"Tch!" Xin Yanluo gritted her teeth in anger.
Feng Yao then asked them. "Didn't my friend send a message through his slave? He didn't have the slightest ill intention; he only wanted to talk to you two, so you guys don't have to be this scared."
"I don't believe you!" Xin Yanluo shouted. "If he didn't have evil intentions, he wouldn't have threatened me by reporting my whereabouts to the demon hunters."

"My friend didn't even know about demon hunters until now, so how could he report you to them?" Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo raised their eyebrows in disbelief. "I asked him to threaten you like that because I knew you would come out of hiding if he did that, and the result was as I expected; you two are in front of me now."
"What does your friend want from us?" Feng Yao then told Ju Yingzhi about the reason behind Zhang Fei's desire to meet them. "Why should I believe him?"

"I'm not asking you to believe him." Feng Yao's answer confused the two female demons. "If you want to recover faster, you can meet him at midnight. If you want to leave this realm, I won't stop you from leaving."
After she said that, Feng Yao immediately flew away from them and rushed back to Yun Kingdom.
Xin Yanluo then asked Ju Yingzhi. "Are you thinking about meeting that man, Master?"
"Yes." Ju Yingzhi immediately grabbed Xin Yanluo's shoulder and brought her back to their hiding place.

Zhou Hanling did not immediately move and looked at Zhang Fei [1], who pretended not to notice his presence. He leisurely walked into the forest, and the old man immediately stood up before carefully following behind him.

When they were a little deeper in the forest, Zhang Fei[1] immediately disappeared using his invisibility. Zhou Hanling was shocked to see that and tried to track his whereabouts, but he saw Feltia [2] moving erratically in another area of the forest, so he immediately followed him.

However, Zhou Hanling was once again confused when Feltia [2] suddenly disappeared, only to discover that Zhang Fei [4] was already far ahead of him. 'What the hell? How can that brat move so fast with his low cultivation? Furthermore, his movements resemble those of a ghost, making it difficult for my senses to lock onto him.'

Zhou Hanling immediately followed Zhang Fei [4], but he disappeared once he almost reached his location. Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared in the distance, sprinting rapidly to lure the old man toward the trap's location.
As anticipated, Zhou Hanling trailed closely until he reached the trap location, but Zhang Fei [5] had once again vanished from his view.

However, Zhou Hanling's expression changed to shock when he saw Zhou Meiling lying on the ground, but he did not immediately approach his niece and check the surrounding area. 'So it's true that Meiling fell into the hands of that brat, huh? Did he deliberately use her to lure me into his trap?'
Zhou Hanling then picked up some rocks from the ground, infused his qi into them, and threw them at Zhou Meiling. However, the area did not show any reaction, so he thought there were no traps there.
Even so, Zhou Hanling did not rush to approach his niece. He carefully walked toward her, holding two sickles connected by chains at both ends.
Soon, Zhou Hanling arrived slightly in front of Zhou Meiling, but her naked body caused a lump to protrude from beneath his trousers, and his expression became lustful while licking his lips.
The four clones, in their invisible state, watched Zhou Hanling's reaction and could only shake their heads. 'This old man! He lusts for his niece's body!'

"Hahaha! Back then, Zhou Xiaochuan snatched her mother from me, and I will snatch her daughter from him today." As soon as he walked forward to approach Zhou Meiling, Zhou Hanling sensed the movement of Qi from the ground, forcing him to retreat. "Fuck! It's a trap!"
The four Zhang Fei clones, who were already behind Zhou Hanling in the invisible state, immediately kicked his back at the same time.
"Guah!" Zhou Hanling screamed as he staggered forward, but before he could stabilize himself, the four Zhang Fei clones simultaneously used the demon king's roar.
*Roar... Roar... Roar... Roar....*

The four deafening roars made Zhou Hanling dizzy and nauseous, but the four Zhang Fei clones were already moving above him with their right legs raised. They immediately swung their feet at his head and shoulders, sinking his feet into the ground. "Gah!"

They immediately moved away from Zhou Hanling, and Zhang Fei [1] pulled Zhou Meiling from there, activating the portable illusion formation array in the process. At that moment, an illusion materialized before the old man's eyes, causing him to scream in terror. "Argh! No! Don't come any closer!"
After Zhou Hanling fell into the trap, Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] immediately entered the training space again, and Zhang Fei [5] brought Zhou Meiling back to the Yin-Yang Space.

"It seems like he saw a terrifying illusion." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head as he listened to Zhou Hanling continue to scream in fear. "This way, I just need to wait for his mental breakdown, and I can do something about him after this."
Zhang Fei [1] then returned to the capital, but within a few moments, he had already returned to the forest, accompanied by Zhou Shenxin.

"You are really like a ghost! You suddenly appeared and brought me here!" Zhang Fei [1] smiled and pointed at Zhou Hanling, shocking Zhou Shenxin. "How did you manage to trap my uncle in an illusion?"
"Secret." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a wink. "I knew he was always monitoring you, and he was also thinking of targeting my three wives at the restaurant, so I decided to act."

Zhou Shenxin was completely shocked by Zhang Fei [1]'s actions, especially since his cultivation was far below his uncle's. She then took several deep breaths before asking. "Do you realize that you are too terrifying? Although your cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, you have already defeated many cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, which is why I am truly terrified of you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and pulled Zhou Shenxin into a hug. "Why should you be afraid of me? I already said that I want you, and I would never hurt the woman I want."
Zhou Shenxin did not comment on that and looked at Zhou Hanling again. "What are you going to do to him? Are you going to kill him?"
"Why should I kill him if he is still useful to me?"
"Then, what are your plans?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately whispered something into Zhou Shenxin's ear, causing her to look at him with wide eyes. "Can you really do such a thing?"

"You can watch it later, but we have to wait for your uncle's mental breakdown first." Zhou Shenxin nodded in understanding, especially since Zhou Hanling's cultivation was too high for the current Zhang Fei [1]. "Do you still doubt that I can change your future? If you become my wife, I can help you become the Empress of the Zhou Kingdom, and they will all submit to you, including Zhou Xiaochuan."
"Can you really help me become the empress?"

"Do you still need to doubt my abilities?" Zhang Fei [1] asked her back. "If I wanted to, I could kill your uncle right now, with or without Feng Yao's help. As for your father, I found something interesting about him, and I can use that to destroy him."

Zhou Shenxin was curious about his plans for her father, but Zhang Fei [1] just smiled at her without any intention of explaining. "If I accepted you as my man and you helped me become empress, wouldn't you become emperor?"

"Do you think I am suitable to be an emperor?" Zhou Shenxin nodded at Zhang Fei [1]. "Haha! In my eyes, status is nothing compared to a free life. I'm a free man and don't like being tied down with complicated matters, and I'm lucky to have many wives who can help me take care of trivial matters. This way, I can focus on my strengths, and I can help them become strong. However, having an empress's wife should be satisfying, so I want to have one."
Zhou Shenxin stared at Zhang Fei [1] for quite some time. "Help me become the empress of my kingdom, and I'll be your wife."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yes."

Zhang Fei [1] smiled in response. "Before I help you become the empress of your kingdom, you must first focus on improving your cultivation, and you must also build up your power. A ruler must have clear power, or the people will never obey you, and they may rebel against you."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhou Shenxin replied with a heavy sigh. "There are so many people who are much stronger than me in my kingdom, including my mother, uncles, aunts, and half-siblings. Not to mention, my father has so many concubines, so a power struggle will immediately break out if you get rid of my father, and we won't be able to compete against them."

"That's right." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "In a power struggle in your kingdom, only your seniors can get involved, and you can't become empress unless you kill them all, which is impossible. So, who are the people on your side now?"

"Not much." Zhou Shenxin replied disappointedly. "In my kingdom, women are not respected and have no value, so we can't get too involved in political affairs, and they always think of us as tools to smooth things over. Almost all the seniors side with my half-brothers, especially Zhou Tong. Only my mother and her family support me, but she's one of my father's concubines and has little political power. Fortunately, I was born with a good talent, and I can compete with my half-brothers, but my hard work is still meaningless because I am a woman."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "Even though it is difficult, I am still confident that I can make you the empress. However, the process will not be quick, so you must be patient while continuing to improve yourself."

"Are you really going to do that to him?" Zhou Shenxin asked.

Zhang Fei [1] chuckled and hugged Zhou Shenxin's waist. "Shouldn't it be obvious, my future empress?"
Zhou Shenxin did not answer that. "Let's go back."

"Becoming an empress is not my ultimate goal; my ultimate goal is to become a free woman. Unfortunately, I will never be free as long as I live in my father's shadow, and the only way to gain my freedom is to overthrow him and take over his position. I don't know how he'll help me, but he should be able to do it with all his absurd abilities, so I'll place my hopes on him."
Meanwhile, Yun Xinyue and the others arrived at the building, and they immediately helped Zhang Fei in the renovation process.
Feng Yao took a leisurely seat and exerted pressure on Wei Chou and the other members of the Alchemy Union, ensuring that none of them dared to disturb them.
Time passed swiftly, and the sun had once again set. Zhang Fei immediately summoned his fifth clone so his clone could continue the renovation process.

Zhang Fei then brought the eight women back to his residence to have dinner with his grandmother and the others. After finishing their meal, he sent them all into the training space, except for the Phoenix Princess, who was going with him to meet Xin Yanluo and Ju Yingzhi.
Feng Yao then asked him. "What are you going to do now? We still have a few hours before midnight."

"I'll break through first." Zhang Fei's answer surprised Feng Yao. "My cultivation has increased too quickly because I absorbed most of Huangfu Ziyuan's Qi three days ago, but my cultivation is not stable yet. Fortunately, I have my clones and training space, so my cultivation is stable now."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "In that case, we go to that island now, and you can break through there while waiting for them to come to us."
"Yeah."

Upon their arrival at the small island in the southern ocean, Zhang Fei immediately summoned the thunderbird out of the beast space and sat on his back. He and all his clones except the fifth were immediately cultivated to complete the daily quest, or he would run out of time.

Meanwhile, Feng Yao stood a little away from them and enveloped the small island with her aura. 'His cultivation speed is terrifyingly fast! If he continues to improve this fast, he might be able to surpass me in ten years or maybe less.'
After several hours of travel, the groups from both demon kingdoms arrived at the Star Tower, and they immediately led their respective men toward the stone obelisk.
Since all of them had already challenged the tower up to several floors, the test of strength was not a significant obstacle for them, and all of them managed to pass without any effort.
Unfortunately, the challenges that awaited them inside were different from those in the past, especially since the old man who controlled the tower deliberately increased the difficulty severalfold.
In the Blossom Heaven Realm.

Ma Mingxin, who was still furious and disappointed over losing Meng Qi, suddenly felt many powerful auras entering her realm. She rushed out of her house and looked up at the sky, finding seven large, luxurious flying artifacts entering the realm. "Who exactly are they? How did they know about the Sun Tower in this realm?"
"Big Sis."

Ma Mingxin turned to Ma Xiaowei, who had just arrived. "I sensed a terrifying aura from one of those flying artifacts, and its owner seems to be vicious, so you must order our people not to approach them."
"Yes, big sis."
In front of the Sun Tower, Feng Jiu and the others immediately opened their eyes after sensing the arrival of the six flying artifacts.
However, a giant fox with golden fur and nine tails jumped down from one of the flying artifacts. "Husband! I'm coming for you!"
"Hahaha!" Feng Jiu laughed out loud after hearing that, and she immediately turned to the Nameless One, who had already moved away from them. "Brother, your future wife is too excited to meet you."

The Nameless One bitterly smiled as he looked up at the golden fox. Xue Bao, lying on his shoulder, could only shake his head at the behavior of the two. "That seductress never stops trying to seduce you, Master."

paragraphs: As she flew down, a golden light enveloped the golden nine-tailed fox's body. Soon, a woman in her twenties emerged from the light, and her appearance was difficult to describe in words. Her beauty was otherworldly: two wide eyes with bright golden pupils, an exquisite slender nose, sensually thick lips, and curly golden hair that danced in the wind.

The woman's figure is truly tall and voluptuous, at around 2 meters high. Her breasts are massive, at around 105 centimeters. Her neck is a bit long and slim. Her waist curves beautifully, resembling a guitar. Her buttocks stick out perfectly from beneath her gold dress, and her long legs look smooth.

Just as the woman was about to embrace him, the Nameless One abruptly vanished from his position, leaving her to embrace empty air. She disappointedly looked up at the top of the Sun Tower. "Husband! I haven't seen you in a long time, but now you're avoiding me."
The nameless one shook his head before replying. "Huli Xianniang, please refrain from referring to me as your husband, as this could lead to misunderstandings among your admirers."

"Humph!" Huli Xianniang snorted and disappeared from her spot, but once she reached the top of the Sun Tower, the aura and figure of the nameless one completely vanished. "Tch! Husband! You don't need to care about those bastards! You are the only man who is worthy of being my husband!"
However, the nameless one did not respond to Huli Xianniang, which greatly annoyed her. She finally gave up and moved in front of Feng Jiu before hugging her. "Hehehe! I missed you so much, Jiujiu."

"Haha! You're as aggressive as ever, and he keeps avoiding you because of it." Feng Jiu hugged Huli Xianniang for a while before turning to the seven flying artifacts that had landed in front of them.
The first to come down was a young man with a calm expression and azure hair, but he had two dragon horns on the top of his head. He was the leader of the Azure Dragon Race, Long Qiang.

The second was Dai Hubai, the leader of the White Tiger Race. A tall young man with his muscles bulging across his skin. His expression was truly ferocious, like a tiger, and his white hair was in long waves.

The third person was also a young man, but his appearance was different from the previous two. He looked more playful and childish, and a black tortoiseshell hung on his back. Despite his appearance, he was the leader of the Black Tortoise Race, Wang Wugui.

The fourth was Zhu Hong, the leader of the Vermilion Bird Race. Like Feng Jiu, she had long red hair, but her aura was more fierce. Although her appearance was not inferior to that of the Phoenix Empress, she was bolder in her dress, wearing a transparent red dress.

Next, a young woman of short stature who looked like a teenager in her 17s also descended from one of those flying artifacts. She had long, light brown hair tied in two braids at the back and short bangs covering her wide forehead. Her appearance stood in stark contrast to the tall and voluptuous figure of Huli Xianniang. She was the leader of the mythical deer race, commonly called Fuzhu, Fu Xin.

The last person was a young woman with a tall build, long white hair, and a slim waist. Her expression was calm but serious, and her gaze was sharp. The most interesting among them is the man called the Nameless One, and he possesses the void element. Let's see how far they can go, but I won't let them pass my challenges easily."

Lei Que immediately carried Zhang Fei, who was sitting on his back, into the sky. However, he stopped mid-air, patiently waiting for the heavens, still brewing his master's lightning tribulation, to strike.

Below them, Feng Yao gazed solemnly at Zhang Fei and Lei Que, feeling the power of the lightning tribulation. Moreover, he would not only encounter the lightning tribulation once but would need to confront it multiple times. Despite this, the Phoenix Princess wasn't too worried about him, and she believed that he would be able to get through it.

In several areas of the realm, people stood in the sky, their gazes fixed on Zhang Fei's location. Long Huang and his family stood in the sky in their beast kingdom. Xian Lianghua and several people from the natural races, including Aqua, also stood in the sky above their kingdom.
Of the human kingdoms, only Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang were aware of Zhang Fei's breakthrough, and both of them stared at his location from a balcony of their palace.

After facing his lightning tribulation several times, Zhang Fei no longer felt afraid to face it. Instead, he looked up at the sky with a calm gaze, and he was also eager to get it done as soon as possible.
*Rumble... Rumble....*
"Master, this lightning tribulation will be stronger than the last one."

"Yes." Zhang Fei stroked the thunderbird's head. "The stronger my lightning tribulation, the more beneficial it is for both of us, and you should make good use of each lightning tribulation to strengthen yourself."
"Yes, Master."
*Zap...Zap...Zap...*
"Ugh!"
*Screee*
Three hours later.
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 3 Star Earth Realm.]

After the lightning tribulation stopped, the sky returned to normal, and Zhang Fei lay on the thunderbird's back with a satisfied smile. Although his body was still in great pain from the lightning attacks, his regenerative healing factors continued to work to heal his wounds.
Zhang Fei then sent the thunderbird back to the beast space before he landed in front of Feng Yao. "Are you worried about me?"

"You have already faced two lightning tribulations from your previous two breakthroughs, and you have faced hundreds more in the sin challenge, so I believe that you will be able to pass it easily. "Can't you feel my cultivation yourself?"

Ling Long nodded in understanding after checking his cultivation. "3-Star Earth Realm, huh? You make me jealous, you know? You have an abundance of clones to assist you, which enables your cultivation to progress rapidly."

"Here." Ling Long's eyes lit up as soon as Zhang Fei [5] gave her a bottle of Yang Qi, and she hurriedly finished it in one gulp. "I will send you out in a few days, and you can return to the Huangfu Kingdom with those two idiots."

Zhang Fei [5] did not respond to that and questioned her instead. "Have you ever tried using your Heavenly Marionette Arts on Huangfu Shou?"

"Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying were exposed to something in the Star Tower, so Huangfu Lian was forced to give up on the maze challenge, and their conditions continued to worsen. "Are you really going to infiltrate the Huangfu Kingdom? If Huangfu Shou finds you there, he will immediately capture you."

"However, you have to be careful with my grandfather; his eye technique is very unique, and he might see through your disguise." Ling Long then told Zhang Fei [5] about her grandfather's technique, but he didn't worry too much about him. "When are you going there?"
"As soon as I finish the renovation of my new shop."
Inside the house, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was enjoying his time with Shang Xinyu in the living room. Wu Lianzhi was already fast asleep, and Shang Yifen was cultivating in the room.

Meanwhile, Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying were in their respective clan residences taking care of some matters, especially since they were sure that Shang Ziyuan would soon find out about Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's disappearance.

Shang Xinyu stroked Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head on her lap. "Long'er, you already have Shang Yaolin and Shang Yumei as your women, but you also have a relationship with Aunt Qianyin. "Are you jealous of them, Big Sis Xinyu?" Shang Xinyu answered Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a shake of the head. "Honestly, I wanted to have fun with you, but I knew you weren't ready, so I didn't do anything with you."

Shang Xinyu smiled at that. "Somehow, I feel jealous of you because your cultivation can break through so easily, and your body cultivation also breaks through faster than mine. Not to mention you are Senior Hun Di's disciple, and your soul cultivation also broke through so fast."

"You don't need to be jealous of me because I can help you become strong." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sat down on the chair and made Shang Xinyu face him. "We haven't cultivated dual soul for quite a while, so we'll do it now, but you should swallow my Yang Qi first because it will help you a lot."
"All right." Shang Xinyu shyly swallowed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s yang Qi before releasing her soul. "Shall we do it now?"

"Yes." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] released his soul, he began to dual soul cultivate with Shang Xinyu. Unfortunately, her soul power still pales in comparison to Shang Yaolin's, let alone Shang Yingyue's.

paragraphs: "Hmm?" Murong Qianying, who was briefing the members of the Murong Clan in the main hall, immediately turned to the entrance. "I thought you would arrive tomorrow, but you're here now, Yumei."

Shang Yumei glanced at the members of the Murong Clan, but she raised an eyebrow when she saw Murong Yinghua among them. "Why are you suddenly taking care of them yourself? Didn't you hand them over to Murong Mengying?"

"The situation in this realm and our realm will become complicated soon, so I must personally intervene to prepare them for the changes in the situation." Murong Qianying then told Shang Yumei about Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's relationship, which shocked her. "Mengying is going to another realm with Yaolin and Guangming, so I sent Yinghua here. However, she is less experienced than her big sister, so I can't leave her to take care of this clan alone."

Shang Yumei nodded in understanding. "I didn't expect that Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin would have such a relationship, and it would definitely infuriate Shang Ziyuan. Where is that kid? Why can't I find him at the Shang Clan residence?"

"I brought Long'er to a secret place." Hearing that, Shang Yumei wanted to go there immediately, but Murong Qianying hurriedly stopped her. "Stop it, Yumei! He is Senior Hun Di's disciple now, so you should cancel your intention."
Shang Yumei responded to her mother with a frown. "Since when did he become his disciple?"
"A few days ago." Shang Yumei's expression turned annoyed because of that. "Anyway, you wait here first, and we'll go there together after Xinxin arrives."

Shang Yumei said nothing and sat on an empty chair, her mind constantly mulling over ways to subdue Zhang Xiaolong [3] without causing trouble with Hun Di, particularly considering the consequences she would face if he provoked the Soul Emperor's fury.
Sometime later, Hong Xinxin arrived at the Murong Clan residence, and Murong Qianying had also finished briefing her clan members, so the three of them hurried to the secluded house.

When they entered the house, they found Zhang Xiaolong [3] dual-soul cultivating with Shang Xinyu. However, Shang Yumei's expression looked complicated after seeing his face, especially since the demon fox's soul kept reminding her of her sexual activities with him a few months ago.
When he heard of their arrival, Zhang Xiaolong [3] began drawing his Yang Qi back from her soul, and Shang Xinyu followed him by pulling her Yin Qi back.

Shang Yumei's arrival took Shang Xinyu aback, and she briefly glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] before rushing to her room, particularly after realizing that he was going to enjoy himself with the three women. "Congratulations on your breakthrough to the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, Big Sis Yumei. Although I haven't directly checked it, I can sense that your body has become stronger than before, which I attribute to my Yang Qi."

Shang Yumei responded by moving in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and strangling his neck. She used the heart-binding art to bind his heart to hers, preventing him from running away from her, but the system thwarted her plan and dispelled her technique, shocking her.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and pulled her into a hug, but Shang Yumei immediately broke free and pushed him back. "Big Sis, you should stop thinking about controlling me because you will never succeed."
"How could you do that?" Shang Yumei asked as she furiously glared at him. "My technique just now wasn't the nine-tailed demon fox's technique, so you shouldn't be able to do it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonchalantly shrugged his shoulders. "Even though your technique is different, I am immune to all control techniques. I am a soul cultivator, and my soul power has reached the Earthly Soul Level. Moreover, Master Hun has taught me his soul technique, and since I am nearly at the third stage, I can easily counter such a technique."

<Hahaha! Wang Xiaofeng, Wang Zhuxian, Hu Xiufu, Ming Hao, and Ming Yanyu decided to go to other places for sightseeing, especially since they had not gone anywhere since they arrived in the Nine Stars Realm.

Zhang Fei had no problem with their wishes because the situation in the Xian Capital was much safer and more conducive. He decided to send Zhong Yan, Tang Ziyu, Ye Lian, and Zhou Ziqin to the capital of the Yun Kingdom to help his fifth clone.

Zhang Fei then sent Lillea and Janette to the capital of the Natural Races' Kingdom. The two Dryads have decided to manage their new shop and restaurant in the kingdom, which requires them to familiarize themselves with the local conditions and establish connections with other natural races.

Huang Rong and the six women from Earth chose to explore the area around the residence. Zhang Fei asked Boitata, Lei Que, and the other beast contracts to accompany them, as they were not cultivators and could easily be killed by the beasts.

Zhang Lin brought the hippocampus, Hai Ma, to the southern ocean. Shen Yu and Shen Xueyi also joined the two, especially since they were sea serpents and sometimes missed the ocean. Angela, the rainbow fish demon, also went there to enjoy herself.

Of all his wives, Ru Xue and Liu Qingyu remained in the training space and focused on their training in healing techniques under Elmyra's guidance. Hu Yue, along with Hu Lili and several others, concentrated on her training using the gravity feature, particularly since she had lagged behind her other sisters.

To Zhang Fei's surprise, Virgil and Ursula asked him to send them to the Netherworld Realm to join Zhang Wuji and Yan Zhixiu, mainly because they wanted to increase their demon power. He immediately agreed to their wishes and sent them there.
Zhang Chen and Qing Yi asked Zhou Shenxin to accompany them to chat, and the Zhou Princess was pleased to do so. After all, they treated her warmly, unlike her father or the people in her kingdom.
Zhang Fei was satisfied to see Zhou Shenxin, especially because she looked beaming when she talked with his mother and grandmother.

Zhang Fei had already brought Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue into the Yin-Yang Space, but the Yun Princess felt strange seeing nine naked women. Seven of them were focused on cultivating in their respective rooms; one woman kept screaming and pulling the chains on her hands and feet, and the other woman seemed nonchalant to their presence.
"Isn't she Ling Long? Since when did you lock her up here?"

"After Feng Yao helped me defeat Huang Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan four days ago, I brought Ling Long here. As you can see, she doesn't feel depressed and is enjoying her time here instead." Zhang Fei then led them to Qian Ying's room. "I sense that she is mentally stable, so I will try to wake her up, and I hope she is back to normal."
"Yes, please wake her up, Fei." Xian Xianqin really missed her best friend, and she wanted to talk and joke with Qian Ying again like in the past.
Yun Xinyue knew about Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying's relationship. She then embraced the Xian princess. "I'm sure she'll be fine, and you can hang out with her again soon."
"Yeah."

After he had undone his dream imprisonment from Qian Ying's subconscious, Zhang Fei immediately channeled his light Qi into her body to wake her up. 'Do you think her condition will be normal, Mei? Or should I modify her memories and erase everything that happened after she fell into the demon's control?'
[Let's wake her up first, Master. If Qian Ying's mental state worsens when she wakes up, you can use your memory manipulation ability to erase those bad memories.]
'All right.' A while later, Zhang Fei had already withdrawn his light qi back and stood beside the two princesses. "Let's wait for her to wake up, and we can see the results after he wakes up."
After they waited a few minutes, they heard a soft moan from Qian Ying's mouth. He slowly opened his eyes, but his gaze was still blank like a doll, which caused Xian Xianqin's heart to tighten.
However, it was only temporary, as Qian Ying had slept for too long, and her eyes gradually regained their brilliance. "Where am I?"
"Ying."
Hearing her soft call, Qian Ying turned to Xian Xianqin, who had already started crying. "Qin."

Xian Xianqin's body trembled after hearing that, especially since Qian Ying always called her that before she fell into the hands of the demon. The Xian Princess stretched out her right hand and unsteadily walked forward to approach her best friend. "Ying... Ying..."

"Don't come any closer, Qin." Xian Xianqin immediately stopped and looked at Qian Ying, who was trying to get up with difficulty. "My memories have returned, but I can still remember everything. I've turned into a demon, and I tried to kill you over and over again."

"No." Xian Xianq shook her head vigorously and immediately jumped to hug Qian Ying. "I don't care that you've become a demon! I don't care about your past actions! You didn't do it because you wanted to but because those demons ordered you to kill me!"
"But-"
"No buts!" Xian Xianqin shouted and hugged Qian Ying very tightly. "I have lost you once, but you have come back to me now, and I don't want to lose you again."

"Qin." Qian Ying called out softly, and her trembling hands quickly wrapped around Xian Xianqin's body. She immediately closed her eyes and hugged her best friend back, and the two cried in each other's arms.
When Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying finally reunited after decades, it moved Yun Xinyue to tears, but she smiled with joy, feeling happy for them.
Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief because Qian Ying was back to normal, and he didn't need to use his memory manipulation to alter her memories.
'Kid! Try checking the girl's soul to make sure that there is nothing negative left.' Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke to Zhang Fei.
Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately used his demon eyes to check Qian Ying's soul, but he found nothing negative about it other than her hatred for the demon. 'She's fine, Old Ma.'
'It's good if you don't find anything negative in that girl's soul.' Ma Kuangyu then asked him. 'What are your plans for Nalan Yushu's soul? Don't you want to absorb her soul power?'

'No.' Zhang Fei replied with a slight shake of his head. 'I want to try to forge a soul weapon, and I will use her soul as its soul. However, I probably can't use her soul right away, especially since we have no ties other than my slave mark, so I have to do something to her first to be able to turn her into a weapon soul.'

'Isn't that easy?' Ma Kuangyu then conveyed his idea. 'All you need to do is dual soul cultivate with her, and your soul mark on her soul will prevent Nalan Yushu from harming you. Her soul power surpasses that of all the women by your side, including those in the Wasteland Realm.'
Zhang Fei immediately agreed with that. 'Yeah, you're right. I'll do it with Nalan Yushu soon, and I want to reach the Heavenly Soul as soon as possible.'

After some time, the two women finally stopped crying. Xian Xianqin then assisted Qian Ying in getting up, taking into account that her body was still weak due to her prolonged sleep. "You still remember Xinyue, right?"
"Yeah." Qian Ying nodded before saying to Yun Xinyue. "Long time no see."
"Long time no see." Yun Xinyue replied with a nod. "You're back now, so Xianqin can let go of all the burdens in her heart."
Qian Ying then turned to Zhang Fei. "Thank you for helping me remove the Shadow Oblivion Seal from my memories."

"No need." Zhang Fei pointed at Xian Xianqin. "I don't want Qin'er to continue to be sad and feel guilty towards you, and I'm also lucky that Old Ma told me how to get rid of it, or else I wouldn't be able to do it."
"Ying." Qian Ying turned to Xian Xianqin. "Zhang Fei is my future husband."

Qian Ying smiled at that. "I still remember your closeness with him at the Star Tower, so I know that he is your future husband. Anyway, congratulations, you can finally move on from Big Brother Aoxian."
"Hehehe." Xian Xianqin giggled in response. "Actually, Zhang Fei has many secrets, and one of them is that he is a demon."
"Huh?" Qian Ying turned to Zhang Fei in shock. "Are you really a demon? Why can't I sense any demon aura from you?"

Zhang Fei immediately transformed into his lust demon lord form, shocking Qian Ying further when she sensed his demon aura. "Unlike your demon race, which focuses more on assassination, my demon race is a lust demon. Others may not accept your demon identity, but Qin'er and the people around me will accept you with open arms."

Qian Ying released a sigh of relief and hugged Xian Xianqin's arm. "Honestly, I want to go home to my family, but I'm sure they will reject me because they really hate demons from the bottom of their hearts. The demons also kidnapped me, which likely intensified their hatred. Since Qin is your future wife, I hope I can live with you two, and I will help you with anything."

"It's okay if you want to live with us, and Qin'er will be happy with that." Xian Xianqin smiled broadly, listening to Zhang Fei. "Your cultivation is indeed in the seven divine realms, but your demon rank is still low, and your combat ability is below mine. Therefore, you must improve both your demon rank and combat ability before you can assist me. I can assist you in increasing your demon power, but you must work on yourself to enhance your combat abilities."

Zhang Fei then gave Qian Ying some basic pills and his Yang Qi, which embarrassed her after he explained it. He also gave him some demon resources he had obtained from Cain and the bloodstones he had obtained in the Wasteland Realm.

Yun Xinyue wanted to ask Zhang Fei's Yang Qi, especially since Xian Xianqin could break through faster because of it. Moreover, it also helped the Xian Princess to increase her physical strength, but she felt embarrassed to say so.

"Here." Zhang Fei directly gave Yun Xinyue several bottles of his Yang Qi. "If you drink it regularly, you will break through to the Seven Divine Realms faster, and you can adapt to the heavy gravity more easily."
Yun Xinyue shyly accepted them and stored them directly in her storage ring. "Thank you."
"Fei, what are your plans for Ying?" Qian Ying also looked at Zhang Fei curiously.

Zhang Fei immediately told them about the demon fox group. "Qian Ying's demon abilities are related to assassination, so she can join Hua'er and the Wen Twins, and she will make my force stronger. However, my goal is not limited to this realm or other realms within these middle realms, and my goal extends to the upper realms and beyond."
"Upper realms and beyond?" Qian Ying was truly shocked by that.

"My ultimate goal is to become the strongest in this universe, and I will use any means to achieve it." Zhang Fei's words shocked Qian Ying even more. "You may think my ambition is too big, but I have many things to realize my goal. After you live with us, you will know more about me, and you will definitely change your mind."
Qian Ying took a deep breath before nodding. "All right, I will work hard to improve myself, and I will help you with all my might to achieve your ultimate goal."
"That's good." Zhang Fei then sent Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying to the training space, but Yun Xinyue chose to join them, so he also sent her there.
Zhang Fei then went to see Ling Long, asked her to get dressed, and took her out of the Yin-Yang Space afterward.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 Soul Whisper Arts
paragraphs: When they arrived at his residence, Zhang Fei received a voice transmission from Huan Ya, informing him that she had arrived at the Bai Kingdom and had set up half of the teleportation in a safe place.

Since Zhou Shenxin had finished talking with his mother and grandmother, Zhang Fei escorted her and Ling Long to leave their residence. He asked the two women to wait and went to the location where he had installed half of the teleportation device, which was connected to his shop in Xian Capital. He installed the other half of the two teleportation devices: one would connect his residence to the Bai Kingdom, and one would connect him to his shop in the Yun Kingdom.
Then, Zhang Fei took the two women to see Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan. Zhou Shenxin's presence shocked them and made them think that he had a relationship with Zhou Xiaochuan.

Ling Long smirked before standing on tiptoe and kissing Zhang Fei, causing Huangfu Lian to frown. Despite his anger, the Huangfu prince could not do anything to him, mainly because of the slave mark on his soul.

'This woman!' Zhang Fei immediately pulled Ling Long into his embrace, kissed her back, and fumbled her buttocks. He kissed her for a few moments before separating his lips and asking the two men a question. "Has Huangfu Shou contacted you in the past few days?"
"My brother contacted me two days ago, but I told him that we haven't found you." Huangfu Ziyuan replied.
"Did he ask about Xuan Cunhua and Meng Yunjie?"

"No." Huangfu Lian shook his head at Zhang Fei. "My father didn't know that I took them with me, but their masters knew that they went with me to this kingdom. If Yunjie and Cunhua don't return to their sects, they will definitely come looking for them here."
"Are their masters very strong?"

Huangfu Ziyuan promptly provided Zhang Fei with information. "Sect Master He Ya of the Black Fang Sect has cultivation in the 4-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, and Sect Master Du She of the Venomous Serpent has cultivation in the 3-Moon Divine Expansion Realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, and he was not too worried about them. "If Huangfu Shou contacts you again, you guys must immediately report to me about his orders or plans."
"Yes."
After Zhang Fei left, Huangfu Ziyuan asked his nephew. "Why didn't you ever tell your father that he had a relationship with the Zhou Kingdom?"

"Uncle, I didn't know that Zhang Fei had a relationship with them." Huangfu Lian replied with a shake of his head. "Zhou Tong clearly wanted to kill him back in the Star Tower. Furthermore, it's well-known that Zhou Shenxin serves as Zhou Xiaochuan's tool, and I'm uncertain if he has any connection to them. Perhaps, like us, he captured her and used her as a slave."
Huangfu Ziyuan nodded. "Forget it! We can't do anything to tell your father about them, especially since his slave mark will keep stopping us."
Huangfu Lian didn't say anything and stared at the exit. 'That bitch Ling Long! She betrayed me!'
"Where are we going now?" Zhou Shenxin asked.
"Can you teach me the Soul Whisper Arts?"
"Eh?" Zhang Fei's request surprised Zhou Shenxin. "How do you know about my soul technique?"
Zhang Fei told her directly. "Chao Yuanfeng told me about you and your master, Kong Zhi. He also told me about the Soul Whisper Arts, and their effects are quite good, so I want to learn them."
"Oh! I forgot that you joined Senior Chao's disciple in the Star Tower." Zhou Shenxin thought for a moment before touching Zhang Fei's forehead.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Soul Whisper Arts.]

"I have given it to you, but I hope you don't tell anyone else about it. Otherwise, my master won't acknowledge me as his disciple anymore, and he might cripple my cultivation." Zhou Shenxin's words caused Zhang Fei's face to darken. "As I said before, women hold no value or respect in my kingdom. My master is no different from my father, and he will not hesitate to do such a thing to me if he finds out that I gave the technique to you."

After he sent Linghu Yincheng into the Yin-Yang Space, Zhang Fei lifted Zhou Shenxin and Ling Long to their feet and led the three women to Bai Yaowei's room. Zhang Fei nodded at both women. "My demon form does increase my sex drive and libido, but it also increases my raw strength, body strength, and many more. Zhou Shenxin nodded in understanding, especially since she couldn't sense Zhang Fei's beast or demon auras if he didn't use his two forms. "You are the strangest living creature I have ever met in my life, but I also feel that you are truly unique and intriguing. Do all your wives and family members know about your two identities?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "They are the people closest to me, so I didn't hide my three identities from them. In fact, I have many female demons by my side, and they all live together in peace. However, they are training in other realms now, so you didn't meet them before."
"I see." Zhou Shenxin then returned her gaze to Lian Jinshu's house. "Their fight will soon end, and the people from the Alchemy Union will be wiped out."

Zhang Fei smiled in satisfaction when he saw Lao Yao still standing and fighting, but he wouldn't possibly be able to hold on much longer, especially since the other three men had already died at the hands of Xiong Ningwu and the others. "This way, I don't need to take care of them myself, but I have to think of something to prevent future problems."
"Future problems?"

Zhang Fei explained to them directly. "Lao Yao seems to have a high reputation in the Alchemy Union, so I'm sure their higher-ups won't sit idly by over his death. After that, we can attack the Huangfu Kingdom together and liberate the Bai Kingdom from Huangfu Shou's control, and the situation will be truly peaceful if it succeeds."

"Are you also thinking about taking the daughters of Bai Yaowei and Huangfu Shou as your wives?" Zhang Fei turned his head toward Yun Shang. "If you do that, we can stop the war once and for all. With no war, the five kingdoms can achieve balance, and everyone can live in peace."

"Actually, Bai Shouyi is interested in me, but I am not interested in her, so I don't have that intention." Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. "Anyway, I have already freed Linghu Yincheng from Huangfu Shou's control, and I have sent her to her three children. However, I have not been able to free Bai Yaowei, especially since the thing controlling him is extremely deadly. The only way to free him is to defeat the person behind the Huangfu Emperor, but Li Tiannan is going to the upper realms to find a cure for Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying, who are affected by something in the Star Tower."

"What is their purpose in doing that, Senior?"

chapters.title: Chapter 665 Zhang Yue Change
paragraphs: "Has my big sister finished her training?"

"Honestly, I didn't expect Zhang Yue to master everything in such a short time, but she has been relentlessly working hard in the past two weeks, and she has been focusing on herself every day without any distractions." Zhang Fei was satisfied to hear that, but Feng Jinqiu then told him something else. "However, she experienced a lot of changes after she mastered the ice phoenix scripture, and she has become cold now."

Zhang Fei was not surprised to hear that, especially since the ice phoenix was the coldest living creature. He had expected that Zhang Yue would undergo significant changes, and he wasn't too worried about her, especially since he was sure that her character would never change.

"Anyway, you should take Zhang Yue to a place with extremely cold temperatures, especially since it could help her reach the high level of the ice phoenix scripture. Unfortunately, this realm and the Nine Stars Realm have no such place, so you must take her elsewhere." Feng Jinqiu then walked into the cave, and Zhang Fei followed behind her.

Zhang Fei was stunned when they arrived inside the cave, especially since Zhang Yue's appearance was completely different from two weeks ago. Her long, sky-blue hair was cut short above her shoulders, her skin and lips were pale white because of the cold, and the cold aura from her body was bone-chilling.
Sensing their arrival, Zhang Yue opened her eyes, but Zhang Fei could see that her gaze was extremely cold, a result of her ice phoenix bloodline and technique.
"Fei'er." Although Zhang Yue's tone was gentle, it also sounded cold.

Zhang Fei rushed to Zhang Yue and lifted her to her feet, but he felt his hands slowly freezing because of her cold aura. He channeled his fire Qi to fight the cold before embracing her. "I miss you, Big Sis."
"I miss you too." Zhang Yue hugged Zhang Fei back as she looked at Feng Jinqiu. "Can I return to the Nine Stars Realm, Senior?"

"This place is no longer useful to you, so you can go to that realm." Feng Jinqiu granted her permission by nodding. Even though you have mastered all the ice phoenix scripture techniques, you are still at the half-perfection stage, so you must train them constantly to reach perfection. When you ascend to the upper realms, you must train in the Frozen Lotus Basin of the Phoenix Realm, where you will fully comprehend the true power of an ice phoenix."
"Yes, Senior."
Zhang Fei then spoke to Feng Jinqiu. "I will definitely bring my big sister there one day, but it might take a few years."
"I know." Feng Jinqiu nodded in response. "You can take Zhang Yue away now."
"Senior, thank you for your help and guidance. I will never forget it." Feng Jinqiu smiled at Zhang Yue's words.

After their departure, Feng Jinqiu retrieved an interspatial communication device and sent a message to a member of the Ice Phoenix race. "Zhang Yue, the Frozen Lotus Basin will be your first and last trial as a member of our race; whether you will succeed or fail in passing depends on yourself, so you must prepare yourself as best as possible before you go there. If you fail, you will freeze to death like those who failed their trial before you. You have the chance to be the first human with our bloodline to pass it, and you will receive extraordinary blessings if you succeed."
After she said that, Feng Jinqiu immediately left the Fallen Moon Cave and returned to the Blazing Phoenix Sect.

Zhang Fei had already brought his big sister to their residence in the Sky Jade Realm, and the two of them walked side by side in the courtyard, with Zhang Yue hugging his arm while resting her head on his shoulder. "Why did you cut your hair, Big Sis?"
"Do you like my short hair?"
"I like it, but I feel like you look better with long hair."
"I think so." Zhang Yue gave a slight nod. "When I mastered one of the techniques from the ice phoenix scripture, I felt that my hair was interfering with my movements, so I cut it myself."
Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Yue in confusion. "Can you show me all your techniques?"
"Yes." Zhang Yue nodded. "However, I can't use my techniques here, or our residence will freeze to pieces."

Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, and he was even more curious about the power of Zhang Yue's techniques. He then took him to the Southern Region, especially since there were many empty areas far from residential areas there.
Upon their arrival, Zhang Yue immediately activated her Ice Qi. An icy blue aura quickly enveloped her body, and dozens of razor-sharp ice feathers appeared around her.

Zhang Yue waved her hand lightly, but the razor-sharp ice feathers immediately shot toward a large tree in the distance and penetrated through it. However, the tree was not destroyed but frozen, and it had many holes.
After that, the razor-sharp ice feathers formed a storm and attacked the tree, shattering it into ice pieces.
"Wow! Your technique is really good, Big Sis!"
"This is my first technique: The Frozen Feather Tempest." Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Yue, who immediately dispelled her feathers. "The second technique is the Frozen Mirage Steps."
An icy mist quickly enveloped the area around them. Zhang Fei was dumbstruck when he saw Zhang Yue move like she was teleporting, leaving behind illusory ice clones.
Zhang Yue immediately stopped the technique and returned to face Zhang Fei, but huge ice phoenix wings appeared behind her. "Third is the Frost Wing Ascension."
Zhang Yue then shot into the air and disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight, leaving behind a trail of frost that slowed down the pursuers.
Although Zhang Yue's speed was extremely fast, it was not difficult for Zhang Fei to follow his movements, especially since his speed was far above his big sister's.
Minutes later, Zhang Yue landed in front of Zhang Fei, and her phoenix wings disappeared, but a sphere of ice appeared surrounding her body.
Zhang Fei then touched the ice sphere, and the ice quickly covered his hand. He used his fire element to melt it, but it wouldn't melt, so he pulled his hand back. "What technique is this?"

"The Frost Phoenix Barrier." Zhang Yue grabbed Zhang Fei's hand and pulled her ice back from him. "My ice element has reached the peak stage thanks to the help of Senior Jinqiu's ice element, and my ice elemental law has also reached the intermediate stage. My barrier can repel both physical and soul attacks, and it will also freeze anyone who touches it. If they didn't have the fire element, they would freeze in seconds."
Zhang Fei was truly shocked by that. He knew that the phoenix was powerful, but he didn't expect Zhang Yue's techniques to be so powerful. "What other techniques do you have?"

"Actually, there are a lot of sub-techniques in the Ice Phoenix scripture, but many of them are personal techniques, so I can only use them for myself." Zhang Yue immediately jumped away from Zhang Fei, and a wave of freezing Qi appeared around her, causing the area around them to freeze. "This is the Frost Nirvana Strike. My power will continue to regenerate as long as I use it, and it also functions as protection. Try throwing a few large rocks at me, and you will definitely be surprised at the effect."

Zhang Fei immediately used his aura to control several large rocks nearby and threw them at Zhang Yue, but the wave of freezing Qi surrounding her instantly destroyed them. "What an incredible recovery and defense technique! As long as you are in it, no one can hurt you."

"This technique is indeed incredible, but I still can't fight against cultivators whose cultivation is far above mine, so I have to be careful." Zhang Yue canceled the technique and used another one, which resulted in an ice cocoon enveloping her body. "This is the Nirvana Ice Cocoon, and it helps me recover from my injuries. This cocoon can absorb attacks and turn them into ice Qi, but it will be destroyed if a powerful cultivator attacks me."

After all, the enmity between the Xian and Zhou Kingdoms was clear to everyone in their realm, and Zhou Xiaochuan had never stopped trying to annex the Xian Kingdom, but his daughter had a relationship with the Xian Princess and her future husband.

Han Yuanzhi was not interested in interfering in matters between kingdoms; she was more concerned with her Han Clan. Therefore, she didn't inquire about their relationship, but rather about other matters. "Can you tell me what kind of shop you want to open in this kingdom?"
"Have you heard of the Sky Jade shop and restaurant in the Xian Kingdom, Senior?"
"Oh?" Han Yuanzhi looked at Zhang Fei in surprise. "Are you the owner of both?"
"I do own both of them." Zhang Fei answered with a nod.

"I see." Han Yuanzhi then spoke again. "I've been to both, and I like the dishes in the restaurant. Additionally, I purchased several mattresses and various other items, including pills. I can say that your basic pills have much better effects than those of the Alchemy Union, and I plan to buy more for my family. Unfortunately, the distance to the Xian Kingdom is too far from this kingdom, and I don't have time to go there yet. Since you are the owner of the Sky Jade shop, I hope you are willing to sell some basic pills to me. We can calculate their price based on the cost of my building."
"I don't think it's a problem." Zhang Fei then told Han Yuanzhi about his chosen building. "So, how much does the building cost?"
"The location of the building is in the best area in this capital, so I set the price at 500,000 gold coins."

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly as he felt that Han Yuanzhi had raised the price of the building to take advantage of him. Even so, it wasn't a problem for him, especially since the price of basic pills from the system was much cheaper than the prices at his shop.

Zhang Fei immediately took four sets of basic pills from the system inventory and handed them to Han Yuanzhi, which surprised her. "Usually, you can only buy two sets with 500,000 gold coins, but I also want to establish a good relationship with you. Therefore, I specially gifted you two extra sets, and you can give them to the best of your clan."
"Haha." Han Yuanzhi softly laughed and asked someone to send her the building's documents. "So when are you going to open your shop in this capital?"

Zhang Fei thought for a moment before answering Han Yuanzhi. "I want to renovate the building first, and I hope you can help me by sending people to renovate it according to my shop in the Xian capital. After the renovation is complete, I will open my shop directly, and the people in this kingdom can get my items more easily."

"I see." Han Yuanzhi nodded in understanding. "I still remember the layout of your shop there, so I can help you with that. My people can probably finish the renovation in three days, and you can open your shop after that."
Zhang Fei was satisfied with that. "That's good; I also can't wait to open my shop."
"Since you two come from afar, how about spending the night at my Han Clan?" Han Yuanzhi inquired with a hopeful expression in her eyes.

Zhang Fei naturally knew Han Yuanzhi's reasons for inviting them to stay the night, but he immediately rejected her offer. "Please forgive me; I have to decline your offer because I still have many other matters to attend to, and we must return as soon as possible. However, you don't need to worry because I will visit this clan often after my shop opens, and we can talk a lot then."

'This kid seems to be able to read my intentions.' Han Yuanzhi immediately nodded to Zhang Fei. "It's a pity that you are too busy now, so I have to wait to talk to you. If you have free time, you can come here again, and I will entertain you then."

"Sure." A while later, someone had already sent the building's document, and Han Yuanzhi asked him to hand it over to Zhang Fei. "In that case, I will take Shenxin away now, and we will meet again when the building is ready."

"All right, I will look forward to seeing you again." Han Yuanzhi leaned back in her chair and propped her head with her hands after they left. She then contacted several people to meet her. "That kid should have come from another realm, and his potential is extremely high. Moreover, he is Xian Xianqin's future husband, and Zhou Shenxin is obviously interested in him. If I can establish an excellent relationship with him, my Han clan will be the best in this kingdom, so I must use all means to secure him to my side."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Zhou Shenxin had made their way back to the Xian Kingdom, where he escorted the Zhou Princess to her inn. "It seems that Han Yuanzhi is planning something for you."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "I have to go somewhere else now, so I'll see you again tonight."
Zhou Shenxin gave a slight nod. "I'll wait for you."

Upon their arrival outside the residence, the four members of the Natural Races' Kingdom experienced a moment of shock.

The roar of the two tigers startled them.
Despite Lang's superior strength, he instinctively stepped back and hid behind Xian Jinglan.
Moreover, the bodies of the two python-tailed tigresses were already huge, thanks to the flow of time in beast space, which was two times faster than the outside world.
