chapters.title: Chapter 669 Meeting Some People
paragraphs: Zhang Fei entered the Yin-Yang Space and checked on the woman he had captured in the Bai Kingdom. According to the system scan, her name was Wushuang, and her cultivation was at the 4-Moon Divine Expansion Realm.

At first, Zhang Fei intended to lock up Wushuang in the Yin-Yang Space and harvest her Yin Qi, but he was sure that Huangfu Shou would contact her sooner or later. Moreover, the Huangfu Clan in the Nine Stars Realm were direct descendants of the Huangfu Clans in the Grand Royal Realm, and he did not want to add more trouble to his already numerous problems.

Since Zhang Fei had locked Wushuang's subconscious with the dream imprisonment ability, it was simple for him to pull her soul out of her body. However, he discovered another type of Gu insect in her soul, and it was different from the previous two.
"Do you recognize this type of Gu?"

Gu Jinglin dismissed Zhang Fei with a shake of her head. "Master, it appears that this Gu is not controlling her but rather for a different purpose. Unfortunately, I don't recognize its type, so I don't know its abilities."

"I see." Zhang Fei immediately implanted his demon slave mark into Wushuang's soul, but he did not change her memories like his male slaves, especially since he was afraid that Li Tiannan would notice.
After he returned Wushuang's soul to her body, Zhang Fei immediately removed his dream imprisonment from her and brought her back to the Bai Palace, leaving her to Huan Ya.
Zhang Fei then went to the Netherworld Realm to check on Ju Yingzhi's condition. He did not stay long, leaving immediately after ensuring her injuries had slightly improved.

Xin Yanluo, who still didn't like Zhang Fei, felt relieved after he left. She was afraid that he would do something to her and Ju Yingzhi, and they would have a hard time resisting him if he used his lust demon lord abilities on them.

Zhang Fei then went to Arbeola to ask about the situation in the realm. The old demon tree informed him that the other demon kings and queens had not moved significantly, instead concentrating on preparing their troops to face the human cultivators from the Shang Clan.
However, Zhang Fei knew that their efforts would be in vain, especially since Shang Huaqiang and his Shang Clan were simply too powerful for them.

Zhang Fei did not care about the fate of the Netherworld Realm, but he did not want Shang Huaqiang to use them to invade the Sky Jade Realm once again. He racked his brain to prevent that from happening, and his only solution was to take advantage of the other clans of the Red Sun Realm. Therefore, he accelerated his plans to take down Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin as soon as possible through his third clone.

After he spent some time in the Netherworld Realm, Zhang Fei went to Earth to check on the situation there. He first went to his company's warehouse and met Huang Rong's trusted person. He took all the items available there, even though their quantity was not very large, especially since the renovation of his building in the Yun Kingdom was almost complete.

After that, Zhang Fei went to Paris, but Zheng Mohei reported to him that the winged race had not yet descended there. He then looked for the two female winged races, and he found them enjoying his cum.
Zhang Fei immediately sneaked into their apartment, making Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi feel helpless, especially since he could come and go as he pleased.
"Why did you come here again?" Jiang Yinghua asked with a helpless sigh.
"I just wanted to meet you guys." Zhang Fei replied. "How do you feel after swallowing the liquid I gave you for the past two days? You should be able to feel the changes in your bodies, right?"
"Yes." Meng Tianshi answered him first. "Even though the effects of the liquid are quite torturous for us, we feel our bodies are getting better every time we take it. Can it also help us evolve?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I don't have much information about your race, so I can't say whether it can help you evolve. The only way to prove it is for you to continue drinking it, and you can see the results for yourself."
"What exactly is the liquid? Why does it bother us?" Zhang Fei simply smiled at Jiang Yinghua's question, making her and Meng Tianshi suspicious of him. "What is your real purpose in helping us?"
"Hey, you are a smart woman, so you should already know my purpose, right?" Jiang Yinghua frowned as she realized Zhang Fei's goal.
"We—"

"Don't you ever feel bored with your monotonous and emotionless life?" Both women unhesitatingly shook their heads at Zhang Fei, mainly because they were used to that kind of life. "This universe is much more fascinating than you two think, and there are so many things out there. Don't you want to explore them? Do you want to continue living locked up in your useless realm? If you all become mine, I will provide you with two opportunities to become cultivators like myself. If both of you become cultivators, you will become much stronger than Seraph, and you will witness many things you have never imagined before."
"Can we really become cultivators?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to both women. "Not all living beings have cultivation veins, but you two do, so you can become cultivators. However, you cannot cultivate here; you must travel to the cultivation worlds, and you won't be able to do so without me. Anyway, I'm not in a rush with you two, so feel free to consider my offer first."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately disappeared from their sight, especially since the flow of time on Earth was too slow for him.
"He really is like a ghost!" Meng Tianshi then asked her friend. "What do you think about his offer? Honestly, I'm bored with my current life, and I want to see many new things in this universe."

"I have the same desire as you, but I have never thought of exchanging myself for such an opportunity, and I prefer to continue living like this. You can consider his offer and give yourself to him if you want it." Jiang Yinghua returned then to her room, leaving Meng Tianshi, who looked eager to accept Zhang Fei's offer.
Zhang Fei's offer indeed tempted Meng Tianshi, but she didn't want to give herself over to him for such an opportunity. 'I'll think about his offer first.'

Zhang Fei was flying around the Diyu Realm in an invisible state, especially since he still had one pending quest in that realm. He thought that the demon lord seed showed no reaction because only his clone stayed in the realm before, so he tried to search for it using his real body.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's efforts proved futile, particularly as the demon lord seed remained unresponsive even after several hours of flying around.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

'Having many clones is indeed my greatest advantage, so I don't need to bother with these trivial quests.' Since the sun was about to set in all cultivation worlds, Zhang Fei decided to return to the Nine Stars Realm. However, he did not immediately return to his residence and went to a small island not far from the demon island, ordering Ximen Yan to meet him.
After some time, Ximen Yan arrived ahead of him, but he wasn't alone, and Ximen Yueliang came with him.

'Tch! I hate this bastard! He doesn't control me directly, but he uses my cousin to control me!' Ximen Yueliang grumbled inwardly but was taken aback when Zhang Fei hurled several bloodstones at her. She immediately caught them and looked at him in confusion.

"Your demon rank is still at the marchioness rank." Zhang Fei's knowledge of her demon rank left Ximen Yueliang perplexed. "It will take you decades to increase it if you only rely on useless resources in your kingdom, and these bloodstones are much more useful for you to increase your demon power."
"Why do you want to help me?"

"I help you for my interests." Zhang Fei's response caused Ximen Yueliang to clench her teeth. "I have indeed bound your soul to your cousin's soul, but I might change my mind about you if I deem you useful to me. Therefore, you must strive hard to improve yourself, or your situation will never change, and you will probably die soon."
"Humph!" Ximen Yueliang snorted at Zhang Fei. "My father has placed Senior Gui by my side, and he is truly powerful, so no one will be able to harm me."
"Is that so?" Zhang Fei then pointed at Ximen Yan. "Did you forget that you will die if he dies?"
Ximen Yueliang froze in her spot after she remembered that. "You—"

"If you want your freedom back, prove that you're useful to me." Ximen Yueliang's face darkened, but Zhang Fei ignored her and gave Ximen Yan some items, including bloodstones, instructing him to do some things. "Zhou Xiaochuan will come to your kingdom soon, so you must be careful of him and use the thing to attack him if you have the chance."
"Yes, Master."

After Zhang Fei disappeared, Ximen Yan and Ximen Yueliang hurried back to their respective kingdoms to use the bloodstones. However, the Ximen Princess harbored many questions about Zhang Fei's intentions for her.

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei arrived at the Xian Royal Palace and accompanied Xian Xianqin, who was chatting with her family. After all, she would soon be his wife, and her family would also be his family.

Zhang Fei also asked Xian Feng about the people he would send to the Zhou Kingdom, but he and Xian Luo had not yet decided on the right people for it. Their best choices now were Xian Qifeng, Luo Qinglin, and Chao Yuanfeng's ten disciples.

After they talked with Xian Feng and the others, Zhang Fei took Xian Xianqin to the Xian Imperial Sect, where they met Chao Yuanfeng. Several of his disciples, such as Bai Tian'er, Ximen Chuixue, Yuan Luo, and others, were already there.

After they fought together on the first floor of the Star Tower, Zhang Fei had more or less gotten to know their characters, and he liked them. He decided to give them the basic pills, with the exception of Bai Tian'er, who had purchased them directly from his shop.
Yuan Luo and the others were shocked after Xian Xianqin informed them that she would marry Zhang Fei in six days, and she invited them all to attend their wedding.
Most of them were thrilled to hear about Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin's marriage, but Bai Tian'er looked upset, especially since he had remained indifferent to her.
"Hahaha!" Yuan Luo burst out laughing and hugged Xian Xianqin right away. "Princess! I never thought that you would marry him so soon! Anyway, I will also marry Brother Chui soon."
"Eh?" Xian Xianqin was surprised about that. "Have you guys met your parents?"

Yuan Luo nodded her head repeatedly. "They were shocked at first after I told them the truth, but I managed to convince them after coaxing them for a few days, and they finally agreed to our marriage."
"I see." Xian Xianqin nodded in understanding. Congratulations on the continuation of your relationship. When are you two getting married?"
Yuan Luo told her directly. "I'm not a princess like you, so my family still has a lot of preparations to make, and we'll get married next month."
Zhang Fei looked at Ximen Chuixue. "Brother, I think it's time you tell them the truth about your identity."

Moreover, he already told us that my father's situation is not good, and you will fall into Huangfu Shou's hands again if you go there now. My brothers and I also want to save him, but we don't have the ability to do so yet, so we continue to focus on increasing our strength in this realm. Anyway, I forgot to tell you that I met my grandfather's soul imprint when I was trapped in the illusion, and he was the one who freed me."
"Huh?" Linghu Yincheng was shocked by that. "Does that mean your grandfather is still alive now? Did he tell you which realm they live in?"

If only they could return, our family would never have fallen into such disarray as now, and they would definitely be able to defeat Huangfu Shou to turn the situation around."
"Although they can't return yet, at least they are still alive, so I can feel relieved." Linghu Yincheng then asked her daughter. "Do you like Zhang Fei?"

Bai Shouyi sighed heavily upon hearing her mother's question. "Honestly, I like Zhang Fei, but he doesn't like me, and he has always been indifferent to me. He is willing to help us because of Xian Xianqin's request."

"I see." Linghu Yincheng gave a slight nod. "Based on the stories of the three of you and Zhang Fei's ability to save me and bring us here, he should not be an ordinary cultivator. If you really like him, you should not give up too quickly, and you can try talking to him the next time he comes here."

Linghu Yincheng did not say anything in response to her daughter, but she was still a mother, and she could not bear to let her suffer. 'I have to talk to Zhang Fei when he comes to this realm again.'

sentences.text: "What are you doing here, Old Kong Zhi?"
"Hehehe." Kong Zhi laughed mockingly in response.
"You wanted to do something festive, but you didn't invite me to join you, so I came here by myself.
Furthermore, I have a deeper understanding of Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Moyue than you do, and you underestimated them too much if you want to take over their kingdom with such a small group."
Although Zhou Xiaochuan was confident in his abilities, he did not dare underestimate Kong Zhi.
Instead, he was deeply afraid of Kong Zhi and constantly worried that he might rebel against him in the future.
"What do you mean by that?"
"Do you think they could have established their kingdom without support?" Zhou Xiaochuan frowned at Kong Zhi.
"Ximen Changtian has Ximen Gui by his side, and he is the strongest demon at the moment.
That old demon should have been able to force Ximen Gongfu to reunite the two demon kingdoms, but he never tried to do it, right?"
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately realized the strangeness of the situation, particularly considering his familiarity with Ximen Gui's strength.
The old demon had lived much longer than him, and he had existed since his grandfather's era.
"Is it because of the Zheng Clan?"
Kong Zhi nodded to Zhou Xiaochuan.
"I don't know the exact depth of the Zheng Clan's power, but I know they are far stronger than they appear from the outside, rendering even an old demon like Ximen Gui to act.
Ximen Gongfu may be the emperor of the Dark Demon Kingdom, but I can tell you that Zheng Moyue is the true ruler of the kingdom.
Her husband serves as a mere puppet for her and her clan, and he never dares to defy her wishes, including her desire to have fun with Xian Hong.
In fact, the three of them often do it together."
"How did you know that?" Zhou Xiaochuan asked with a suspicious look.
"Do you think I will tell all my secrets to my rival?" Kong Zhi simply smiled.
"Even if we join forces, we may not necessarily be able to defeat the Zheng Clan, and we will die at their hands.
I don't know why you suddenly want to take over their kingdom, but I think you should cancel your intention and return."
Zhou Xiaochuan's expression became solemn.
"Do you think the two of us can defeat Ximen Gui by combining our strengths?"
"Hmm?" Kong Zhi considered several options.
"We can defeat Ximen Gui if we join forces, but we need someone to support us."
"Who?"
"Zhou Shenxin." Kong Zhi looked back.
"However, I can't find her in your kingdom, and she did not reply to my messages."
"I sent Zhou Shenxin and Zhou Hanling to the Xian Kingdom to capture someone important." Kong Zhi was surprised by Zhou Xiaochuan's answer.
"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is Xian Xianqin's lover.
I suspect he came from another realm, and he managed to lead a group from the Xian Imperial Sect to pass the first floor of the Star Tower with his cultivation at the 2-Star Earth Realm.
He even managed to compete with Zhou Tong to light the 10 crystals on the stone obelisk."
"Huh?" Kong Zhi looked shocked.
"Are you serious?"
Zhou Xiaochuan directly touched Kong Zhi's forehead, sharing the memories he had gotten from Zhou Tong with him.
"You can see the results for yourself."
Kong Zhi closed his eyes for a moment before opening them again.
"That kid is indeed no ordinary kid, and I've never heard of the Zhang Clan in this realm, so I'm sure he did come from another realm.
Since you sent Zhou Shenxin to him, I'm sure she can control him with my soul technique.
However, you better order her to delay it and meet us on the demon island, or we won't be able to defeat Ximen Gui with just the two of us."
Zhou Xiaochuan concurred and contacted Zhou Shenxin, but she did not respond immediately.
He then contacted Zhou Hanling and ordered him to take his daughter away from the Xian Kingdom, to which he agreed only in words.
"I've contacted them, and they will meet us there."
"That's good!" Kong Zhi replied with a satisfied nod.
"This way, our chances of defeating Ximen Gui are wide open, and we can use him to fight the Zheng Clan.
Anyway, you can ask Zhou Fanzhi to follow us, especially since we need more people to face that clan."
Zhou Xiaochuan unhesitatingly followed Kong Zhi's wishes and contacted Zhou Fanzhi, ordering him to follow them.
"He is still outside the sect, and he will meet us there in 5 days."
"That's fine."
Zhang Fei let the tailor measure his body while listening to Zhou Shenxin explain her father's message.
"Does that mean your father will shift his target to the Ximen Demon Kingdom first?"
"Yes." Zhou Shenxin nodded.
"I didn't expect that my master would join my father, and I'm sure he had the idea to ask me to join them, especially since my father won't change his mind so easily once he decides something."
Zhang Fei agreed with that.
"Did your father tell you the reason?"
"No." Zhou Shenxin thought for a while, trying to recall some details.
"I don't know their exact reasons, but I think it might have something to do with the Zheng Clan."

Zhang Fei contemplated a few things before reaching some conclusions.

Unfortunately, the Ximen Prince did not know much about the clan because they had always acted secretively, including toward his father.
"Let's talk after this."
A while later, the tailor had finished measuring Zhang Fei's body size.

He then went to Earth and took Zheng Mohei with him, surprising Xian Xianqin and the other young women.
Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, and Xian Changyue had long known that Zheng Mohei had fallen into Zhang Fei's hands, so they weren't surprised by that.
"Tell us about your Zheng Clan." Zheng Mohei promptly provided a detailed explanation to Zhang Fei and the others, but he was unaware of certain details that only Zheng Moyue was aware of.
"Who are the people behind your sister?"
Zheng Mohei immediately answered him.
"They are the three ancestors of our clan, Master.

Zheng Qinghong, Zheng Gaoyun, and Zheng Shiqiang were not as strong as Ximen Gui when they fought separately, but they were stronger when they fought together, which is why he never dared to fight them head-on."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned at that.
"Does that mean they have a combined technique?"
"Yes." Zheng Mohei nodded.
"I don't know the exact name of their technique, but they can combine their powers and summon a powerful demon, which is no less powerful than Ximen Gui.
Moreover, the demon has its own will, and its demon power is much stronger than all the demons I know."
Zhang Fei once again left them and went to the Netherworld Realm, and he took Xin Yanluo to the Xian royal palace.
However, her presence put strong pressure on Xian Feng and the others, especially since she was much stronger than them.
"Why did you bring me here?" Xin Yanluo asked in a rude tone, but she quickly suppressed her aura, relieving everyone in the room.
"Have you ever seen or met the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan before?"
"Hmm?" Xin Yanluo glanced at Zheng Mohei for a moment before shaking her head.
"If you are asking about the ancestors of this weak demon, I do not know about them.
They are too weak to be of any concern to me."
"Yanluo, I can't send anyone else to the demon island, and I need Zheng Mohei to protect my home realm.

Therefore, I hope you are willing to help me deal with the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan." Xin Yanluo wanted to reject Zhang Fei's request, but he had already helped Ju Yingzhi, so she immediately agreed to his request.
"You don't need to attack them directly, and you only need to move if they suddenly come out of hiding."
"All right." Xin Yanluo immediately disappeared from their sight.
"Who exactly is that female demon?" Xian Feng inquired after Zhang Fei had sent Zheng Mohei back to earth.
"Her name is Xin Yanluo, and she is the demon behind Zhou Xiaochuan." Zhou Shenxin was shocked to hear Zhang Fei's answer.
"She and her master, Ju Yingzhi, came from the upper realms.
They forced your father to submit to them, and they were also the ones who helped him to establish relations with the two demon kingdoms."
"So my father had a relationship with Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu not because of his own will?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei shook his head before explaining.
"Your father already had the idea to establish their relationship, and he wanted to get demon bloodlines to increase his strength, but he didn't have a solution to start it.
However, the situation changed after Ju Yingzhi arrived in this realm, and she ordered Xin Yanluo to help him.

Zhou Xiaochuan eventually managed to establish a relationship with them and obtained some demon bloodlines from them, but he did not share them with you or his other daughters; he only shared them with his sons."
"Huh?" Zhou Shenxin was once again shocked.
"Do my father and all my half-brothers really have demon bloodlines in their bodies?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"I suspected they had demon bloodlines the first time I met them, and fighting Zhou Fang confirmed my suspicion.
If Zhou Tong didn't have a demon bloodline in his body, he wouldn't be able to compete with you."
"I see." Zhou Shenxin sighed heavily, but they could hear the disappointment in her voice.
Zhang Fei then spoke to Xian Feng.
"Zhou Xiaochuan is on his way to Demon Island, so we must send those people as soon as possible.
We will gradually weaken the troops of the Zhou Kingdom before attacking them."
"I will go see my brother now." Xian Feng immediately left them and went to the Xian Imperial Palace.
They also left the meeting, and Shi Qingzhuang took her daughter and sister-in-law with her.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei took Yun Xinyue, Ling Long, and Zhou Shenxin to walk around Xian Capital, looking for things.
In the Zhou Kingdom, a middle-aged woman with long, wavy black hair sits alone under a peach tree.
Her face is charming for her age, but her most attractive feature is her wide, clear eyes, which have bright black pupils.
Behind her simple green dress, her figure still looks attractive and sexy.
*Tap...
Tap...*
"Hmm?" The woman turned to the person walking towards her.

Didn't my husband order you to follow my daughter?"
"My master sent me to you, Concubine Jiang Tingxi."
"Oh?" Jiang Tingxi momentarily felt astonished.

What is his relationship with my daughter?"

"Why did Yumei suddenly decide to leave? Hasn't your relationship with her improved since yesterday?" Murong Qianying asked as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes.

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled and sat Murong Qianying on his lap. "Why are you reacting like this, Aunt? Big Sis has already accepted me as her man, so you don't need to be like this. She has to help her master nourish her soul, and I can help her reform her body faster. However, my soul power is still too low, so she went to other realms to find resources for our souls."
After hearing that, Murong Qianying felt a sense of relief, but Hong Xinxin immediately spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "We have been having fun for the past three days, so we must start your training."
"All right."
After he told Wu Lanzhi that he had to practice, Zhang Xiaolong [3] led the two women to the bathroom, and Hong Xinxin poured several bottles of her liquid into the wooden tub after he got in.

After sleeping for a few hours, Shang Yumei finally opened her eyes. She suddenly heard a loud noise outside, the sound of women's voices echoing all around. She hurried out of bed and left the main building, but she was stunned when she arrived outside and saw so many women, both old and young, in the residence.
"Finally awake?"
Shang Yumei turned to Zhang Chen, who was approaching her. "Who are you?"
"Haha." Zhang Chen softly laughed and took Shang Yumei's arm. "My name is Zhang Chen, and your man is my grandson."
"Eh?" Zhang Chen's similar appearance to a woman in her twenties or thirties took Shang Yumei aback for a moment. "Are you really Zhang Fei's grandmother?"

"I am his grandmother, and my youthful appearance is a result of his pills." Zhang Chen took Shang Yumei to walk. "Fei'er must not have told you about us, given that you two were originally enemies. All of us are his wives, partners, and families. Although your cultivation and status are higher than ours, you are his future wife, so you are part of this big family now. Therefore, I hope you can familiarize yourself with them, and you will like them."

"Yeah." Shang Yumei then looked at the people in the residence, and Zhang Chen told her about their identities one by one. Unlike her usual cold and rude attitude, she looked gentle and listened attentively. "Honestly, they are much better than my family, Grandma."
"Why is that?"

Shang Yumei let out a heavy sigh before telling Zhang Chen. "My family is cold, and I have never felt the warmth of a family like theirs. My father's and mother's clans only care about their ambitions. In their eyes, children are just political tools to develop their clans, and they will not hesitate to use us to fulfill their ambitions. My mother even considered giving me to Shang Huaqiang, given his significant power and influence within our realm. That's why I fled from our realm, and I was fortunate to meet my master during my escape."

"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding and took Shang Yumei to sit on a garden bench. "Such a life does not only occur in cultivator clans, but such things often occur in ordinary human families."
"Hmm?" Shang Yumei turned to Zhang Chen. "Were all of you ordinary humans before, Grandma?"

Zhang Chen nodded and pointed at some people in the distance, and Shang Yumei followed the direction. "All of them are our main family, and we came from a realm without Qi. In fact, we never knew that cultivators were real, and we only know them from fictional stories. However, many things changed after Fei'er died, and—"
"Huh? Did Zhang Fei really die before? How could he come back to life?" Shang Yumei was shocked to hear that.
Zhang Chen explained directly. "Fei'er died once because of someone, but that person brought him back to life. However, he came back to life not only as a human, but he had two other identities."
"A heavenly fox and a lust demon."

"Yes." Zhang Chen then continued. "Fei'er doesn't know the identity of that person or how that person was able to revive him and make him have three identities, but the incident was a blessing for all of us. From then on, we started to know cultivators and cultivation, and we eventually became cultivators."
"If there is no Qi in your realm, how can you all become cultivators, Grandma?" Shang Yumei curiously asked.

"Has Fei'er told you about the Sky Jade Realm?" Shang Yumei nodded to Zhang Chen. "Fei'er's beast identity gave him the ability to move realms, and he went to that realm to begin his path of cultivation. At first, he ventured there by himself, and he started bringing us there after he met some of his wives from the Chu Clan."
Zhang Chen then shared a few more details with Shang Yumei at Zhang Fei's request, particularly because he wanted his future wife to know them.
After Zhang Chen finished telling her story, Shang Yumei asked her. "How long has Zhang Fei been a cultivator, Grandma?"

"Eight months based on the time flow in the cultivation world." Zhang Chen's answer shocked Shang Yumei and Huli Yaohu. After all, they were both experienced cultivators and had seen much in the universe; Zhang Fei'er's cultivation speed was simply too unbelievable to them. "I don't know about other cultivators' cultivation speeds, but Fei'er became strong so quickly thanks to his wives and partners, who are deeply loyal to him."

"Grandma, I know too many dual cultivators, but none of them can cultivate as fast as Zhang Fei, who could reach the 3-Star Earth Realm in just 8 months." Shang Yumei once again let out a heavy sigh. "Moreover, all of you previously lived in the lower realms, and I know for sure that the quality of Qi there is poor, so his cultivation is extremely fast. If he stayed in the upper realms, he would probably have reached the Seven Divine Realms by now. However, he will provoke the jealousy of too many people, and they will kill him."

"You're right." Zhang Chen nodded in agreement. "Fei'er could have taken us to the upper realm now, but he is fully aware of his abilities. That's why he didn't rush to take us there and instead brought us here, and he will take us there when she is truly ready."

"Actually, the Qi in these middle realms is still beneficial to cultivators at his level, so Zhang Fei doesn't need to rush to the upper realms. If he tries to force his way there with his current strength, he won't be able to do anything. The harsh situation there will force him to live in hiding, just as he did in the Wasteland Realm." Shang Yumei's gaze suddenly shifted to a woman who had just arrived, and her expression turned to shock after she realized her identity. "Grandma, isn't she the princess of the phoenix race, Feng Yao? How did he know her? Is she also one of his wives?"

"Hehe." Zhang Chen chuckled. "She is indeed Feng Yao, but she is not his wife yet. Fei'er knew her from Zhang Lingxue, and she has helped us a lot up until today. If it weren't for her help, Fei'er wouldn't have been able to stop Shang Huaqiang, and he would have successfully invaded the Sky Jade Realm with the help of those demons."
'That kid is indeed lustful! He even targeted the Phoenix Princess as his wife!' Shang Yumei murmured in her heart, but Feng Yao abruptly moved in front of them, making her feel anxious and tense.
Zhang Chen then stood up from her seat. "I have to prepare some things for Fei'er's marriage with Xian Xianqin, so I'll leave you guys to talk."
"Princess Feng, I—"

"You don't have to say anything." Feng Yao interrupted Shang Yumei with a shake of her head. "Since Zhang Fei brought you here, it means that he has already trusted you and chosen you as his woman. You should not betray his trust, or you will suffer yourself, especially since he is far more vicious than many people, even surpassing Shang Huaqiang."
"Is he really that vicious?" After all, Shang Yumei didn't know Zhang Fei at all, and she only knew his sexual abilities.

Feng Yao nodded at her. "He's not only vicious, but he's also extremely cunning, and he doesn't hesitate to use any means to achieve his goals, including exploiting all his enemies. Even you and your mother fell into his trap, right?"

"Haha." Shang Yumei laughed bitterly after Feng Yao mentioned it. "You are right, Princess Feng. Zhang Fei is indeed extremely cunning; he managed to deceive experienced cultivators like my mother and Hong Xinxin, and I also foolishly fell into his trap. Can you tell me more about him?"

"Honestly, I still don't know Zhang Fei very well, so I can only give you a little bit of an idea about him. If you want to know more about him, you can talk to all his wives and partners." Feng Yao then sat down next to Shang Yumei. "He will be kind and gentle to those who choose to be his friends, but he will show his cruel and merciless side to his enemies. In the Sky Jade Realm, he had destroyed several clans that were hostile to him; he did not even hesitate to ask his people to slaughter all the heretics there, especially since they threatened the safety of those closest to him."
"How many people have died at his hands?"

"Thousands." Feng Yao's answer stunned Shang Yumei, especially since Zhang Fei was still so young and had not been a cultivator for long. "When he is ready, he will definitely go to the Red Sun Realm, and the Shang Clan will probably be wiped out by then."
"Is he really going to kill them all?" Shang Yumei inquired, her expression filled with disbelief.

"One hundred percent." Feng Yao replied with a serious nod. "Zhang Fei's principles are very strict; he will never compromise against his enemies, and he will destroy them down to their roots so that their descendants will not bring him trouble in the future."
Shang Yumei took a deep breath after hearing Feng Yao say that. "Does Zhang Fei also want to destroy the Murong and Hong Clans?"

"I don't think Zhang Fei will destroy both clans, especially since he is enjoying his time with your mother and Hong Xinxin." Shang Yumei felt strange hearing that, as she did not expect that Zhang Fei would tell Feng Yao that. "He has the ambition to build his organization in all three realms, so he needs many strong cultivators by his side. In my opinion, he will use the two women to control the two clans, and he will merge them into his organization. His ambition may be too lofty for others, but I believe he will succeed in realizing it, and the situation in all realms will change greatly by then."

"You're right." Shang Yumei did not deny it. "Even though I still don't know clearly about his character and abilities, I have experienced quite a bit of his schemes, so I believe he can do that. The Murong and Hong clans may not be as big as the Shang Clan, but they are still strong, and they will be useful to his organization. Moreover, he is Hun Di's disciple, and his support is one of the best."
"Yeah." Feng Yao then pushed Shang Yumei to her feet. "You are Zhang Fei's future wife, so you should join his wives, and you can learn a lot about him from them."

Shang Yumei nodded and walked over to Zhang Lin and the others. Despite their prior knowledge of her intention to control their husband, Zhang Fei's decision to include her in his main harem had changed the situation, leading them to welcome her with open arms, much to her relief.
After a week of flying, the group of cultivators from the Wasteland Realm finally arrived at the Blossom Heaven Realm, and the arrival of the two flying artifacts alerted the residents of the realm.

Ma Mingxin, who was sitting outside her house, immediately looked up at them. "What actually happened? Why did so many cultivators from the upper realm suddenly flock to this realm? What was really hidden in the Sun Tower? Why did they all go there?"

After she considered it for a while, Ma Mingxin immediately gathered the strongest female cultivators in her Ma Clan. However, she did not immediately lead them to the Sun Tower, waiting for the two groups to enter first.
Meanwhile, the two flying artifacts had landed in front of the Sun Tower. Hun Di immediately led his group to descend from his flying artifact, with the second group following closely behind.
However, Hun Di suddenly sensed an aura, no less powerful than his own, moving rapidly into the realm from outside. "Your master has arrived, Little Mengxin."

"Senior Hun, my master rushed over here because he didn't want you to leave him behind." Murong Mengying smiled as she saw a small flying artifact that looked like a flying capsule, but its speed was extremely fast, surpassing the speed of Hun Di's flying artifact.

In a few minutes, the small flying capsule landed in front of them, and a black-haired man in his thirties stepped out of it. The man was Murong Mengying's master, Xia Tian. Despite his young appearance, he was actually an old monster like Hun Di, and his aura even forced young cultivators like Qiao Liangren and the others to hold their breath.

Unlike the calm Hun Di, Xia Tian looked serious and fierce, and the look in his eyes was as sharp as an eagle's. His body was tall and muscular, yet numerous scars, including those on his face, accentuated his terrifying appearance.
"Old Tian, you—"

Xia Tian ignored Hun Di and moved directly in front of Murong Mengying before picking her up like a little girl and throwing her into the air several times. "Hahaha! I missed you so much, little daughter."

"Why are you reacting like this, Aunt?

She has to help her master nourish her soul, and I can help her reform her body faster.
However, my soul power is still too low, so she went to other realms to find resources for our souls."
After hearing that, Murong Qianying felt a sense of relief, but Hong Xinxin immediately spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"We have been having fun for the past three days, so we must start your training."
"All right."
After he told Wu Lanzhi that he had to practice, Zhang Xiaolong [3] led the two women to the bathroom, and Hong Xinxin poured several bottles of her liquid into the wooden tub after he got in.
After sleeping for a few hours, Shang Yumei finally opened her eyes.
She suddenly heard a loud noise outside, the sound of women's voices echoing all around.
She hurried out of bed and left the main building, but she was stunned when she arrived outside and saw so many women, both old and young, in the residence.
"Finally awake?"
Shang Yumei turned to Zhang Chen, who was approaching her.
"Who are you?"
"Haha." Zhang Chen softly laughed and took Shang Yumei's arm.
"My name is Zhang Chen, and your man is my grandson."
"Eh?" Zhang Chen's similar appearance to a woman in her twenties or thirties took Shang Yumei aback for a moment.
"Are you really Zhang Fei's grandmother?"
"I am his grandmother, and my youthful appearance is a result of his pills." Zhang Chen took Shang Yumei to walk.
"Fei'er must not have told you about us, given that you two were originally enemies.
All of us are his wives, partners, and families.
Although your cultivation and status are higher than ours, you are his future wife, so you are part of this big family now.
Therefore, I hope you can familiarize yourself with them, and you will like them."
"Yeah." Shang Yumei then looked at the people in the residence, and Zhang Chen told her about their identities one by one.
Unlike her usual cold and rude attitude, she looked gentle and listened attentively.
"Honestly, they are much better than my family, Grandma."
"Why is that?"
Shang Yumei let out a heavy sigh before telling Zhang Chen.
"My family is cold, and I have never felt the warmth of a family like theirs.
My father's and mother's clans only care about their ambitions.
In their eyes, children are just political tools to develop their clans, and they will not hesitate to use us to fulfill their ambitions.
My mother even considered giving me to Shang Huaqiang, given his significant power and influence within our realm.
That's why I fled from our realm, and I was fortunate to meet my master during my escape."
"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding and took Shang Yumei to sit on a garden bench.
"Such a life does not only occur in cultivator clans, but such things often occur in ordinary human families."
"Hmm?" Shang Yumei turned to Zhang Chen.
"Were all of you ordinary humans before, Grandma?"
Zhang Chen nodded and pointed at some people in the distance, and Shang Yumei followed the direction.
"All of them are our main family, and we came from a realm without Qi.
In fact, we never knew that cultivators were real, and we only know them from fictional stories.
However, many things changed after Fei'er died, and—"
"Huh?
Did Zhang Fei really die before?
How could he come back to life?" Shang Yumei was shocked to hear that.
Zhang Chen explained directly.
"Fei'er died once because of someone, but that person brought him back to life.
However, he came back to life not only as a human, but he had two other identities."
"A heavenly fox and a lust demon."
"Yes." Zhang Chen then continued.
"Fei'er doesn't know the identity of that person or how that person was able to revive him and make him have three identities, but the incident was a blessing for all of us.
From then on, we started to know cultivators and cultivation, and we eventually became cultivators."
"If there is no Qi in your realm, how can you all become cultivators, Grandma?" Shang Yumei curiously asked.
"Has Fei'er told you about the Sky Jade Realm?" Shang Yumei nodded to Zhang Chen.
"Fei'er's beast identity gave him the ability to move realms, and he went to that realm to begin his path of cultivation.
At first, he ventured there by himself, and he started bringing us there after he met some of his wives from the Chu Clan."
Zhang Chen then shared a few more details with Shang Yumei at Zhang Fei's request, particularly because he wanted his future wife to know them.
After Zhang Chen finished telling her story, Shang Yumei asked her.
"How long has Zhang Fei been a cultivator, Grandma?"
"Eight months based on the time flow in the cultivation world." Zhang Chen's answer shocked Shang Yumei and Huli Yaohu.
After all, they were both experienced cultivators and had seen much in the universe; Zhang Fei'er's cultivation speed was simply too unbelievable to them.
"I don't know about other cultivators' cultivation speeds, but Fei'er became strong so quickly thanks to his wives and partners, who are deeply loyal to him."
"Grandma, I know too many dual cultivators, but none of them can cultivate as fast as Zhang Fei, who could reach the 3-Star Earth Realm in just 8 months." Shang Yumei once again let out a heavy sigh.
"Moreover, all of you previously lived in the lower realms, and I know for sure that the quality of Qi there is poor, so his cultivation is extremely fast.
If he stayed in the upper realms, he would probably have reached the Seven Divine Realms by now.
However, he will provoke the jealousy of too many people, and they will kill him."
"You're right." Zhang Chen nodded in agreement.
"Fei'er could have taken us to the upper realm now, but he is fully aware of his abilities.
That's why he didn't rush to take us there and instead brought us here, and he will take us there when she is truly ready."
"Actually, the Qi in these middle realms is still beneficial to cultivators at his level, so Zhang Fei doesn't need to rush to the upper realms.
If he tries to force his way there with his current strength, he won't be able to do anything.

The harsh situation there will force him to live in hiding, just as he did in the Wasteland Realm." Shang Yumei's gaze suddenly shifted to a woman who had just arrived, and her expression turned to shock after she realized her identity.
"Grandma, isn't she the princess of the phoenix race, Feng Yao?
How did he know her?
Is she also one of his wives?"
"Hehe." Zhang Chen chuckled.
"She is indeed Feng Yao, but she is not his wife yet.
Fei'er knew her from Zhang Lingxue, and she has helped us a lot up until today.
If it weren't for her help, Fei'er wouldn't have been able to stop Shang Huaqiang, and he would have successfully invaded the Sky Jade Realm with the help of those demons."
'That kid is indeed lustful!
He even targeted the Phoenix Princess as his wife!' Shang Yumei murmured in her heart, but Feng Yao abruptly moved in front of them, making her feel anxious and tense.
Zhang Chen then stood up from her seat.
"I have to prepare some things for Fei'er's marriage with Xian Xianqin, so I'll leave you guys to talk."
"Princess Feng, I—"
"You don't have to say anything." Feng Yao interrupted Shang Yumei with a shake of her head.
"Since Zhang Fei brought you here, it means that he has already trusted you and chosen you as his woman.
You should not betray his trust, or you will suffer yourself, especially since he is far more vicious than many people, even surpassing Shang Huaqiang."
"Is he really that vicious?" After all, Shang Yumei didn't know Zhang Fei at all, and she only knew his sexual abilities.
Feng Yao nodded at her.
"He's not only vicious, but he's also extremely cunning, and he doesn't hesitate to use any means to achieve his goals, including exploiting all his enemies.
Even you and your mother fell into his trap, right?"
"Haha." Shang Yumei laughed bitterly after Feng Yao mentioned it.
"You are right, Princess Feng.
Zhang Fei is indeed extremely cunning; he managed to deceive experienced cultivators like my mother and Hong Xinxin, and I also foolishly fell into his trap.
Can you tell me more about him?"
"Honestly, I still don't know Zhang Fei very well, so I can only give you a little bit of an idea about him.
If you want to know more about him, you can talk to all his wives and partners." Feng Yao then sat down next to Shang Yumei.
"He will be kind and gentle to those who choose to be his friends, but he will show his cruel and merciless side to his enemies.

In the Sky Jade Realm, he had destroyed several clans that were hostile to him; he did not even hesitate to ask his people to slaughter all the heretics there, especially since they threatened the safety of those closest to him."
"How many people have died at his hands?"
"Thousands." Feng Yao's answer stunned Shang Yumei, especially since Zhang Fei was still so young and had not been a cultivator for long.
"When he is ready, he will definitely go to the Red Sun Realm, and the Shang Clan will probably be wiped out by then."
"Is he really going to kill them all?" Shang Yumei inquired, her expression filled with disbelief.
"One hundred percent." Feng Yao replied with a serious nod.

"Zhang Fei's principles are very strict; he will never compromise against his enemies, and he will destroy them down to their roots so that their descendants will not bring him trouble in the future."
Shang Yumei took a deep breath after hearing Feng Yao say that.
"Does Zhang Fei also want to destroy the Murong and Hong Clans?"

"I don't think Zhang Fei will destroy both clans, especially since he is enjoying his time with your mother and Hong Xinxin." Shang Yumei felt strange hearing that, as she did not expect that Zhang Fei would tell Feng Yao that.
"He has the ambition to build his organization in all three realms, so he needs many strong cultivators by his side.
In my opinion, he will use the two women to control the two clans, and he will merge them into his organization.
His ambition may be too lofty for others, but I believe he will succeed in realizing it, and the situation in all realms will change greatly by then."
"You're right." Shang Yumei did not deny it.

The Murong and Hong clans may not be as big as the Shang Clan, but they are still strong, and they will be useful to his organization.
Moreover, he is Hun Di's disciple, and his support is one of the best."

Shang Yumei nodded and walked over to Zhang Lin and the others.

Despite their prior knowledge of her intention to control their husband, Zhang Fei's decision to include her in his main harem had changed the situation, leading them to welcome her with open arms, much to her relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 Hun Di - Xia Tian
paragraphs: Murong Mengying just smiled at Xia Tian's words, neither denying nor agreeing. "Instead of worrying about my future husband, you should focus on finding your partner. Despite being as old as Senior Hun, you haven't started a family."

"You little daughter!" Xia Tian responded, caressing Murong Mengying's head affectionately. "You know yourself that I always go out on adventures, and most of those places are dangerous places, so I have never thought about having a family. Moreover, I have a little daughter like you, and I feel that you are enough to accompany me."
"Hey! Old Tian!" Xia Tian immediately turned to Hun Di. "We haven't seen each other for a thousand years, but you ignore me for Little Mengying."

"Hahaha!" Xia Tian laughed out loud before moving in front of Hun Di, giving him a strong hug while patting his back a few times. "A thousand years have passed, but you haven't changed at all, Old Hun."

Hun Di shrugged in response. "Unlike you, I live a leisurely life in my realm with my family and disciples, so my life is much more peaceful than that of an adventurer like you. In this regard, Little Mengying is right, and it would be beneficial for you to consider starting a family."

"I don't want to have a family because it's troublesome." Xia Tian then looked at the Sun Tower. "I haven't finished exploring the three realms, but we've found the keys to go to those new places, and there are many new things there. That's why I don't want to be tied down to anyone for now, and I want to explore all those places before settling down."
"You are such a stupid man!" Hun Di then told Xia Tian something else. "Regarding your future son-in-law, he is my new disciple."
"Senior Hun." Murong Mengying called out while shaking her head helplessly.
Shang Yaolin immediately realized who Hun Di was referring to, which made her wonder. 'Is Senior Sister Mengying really in love with Long'er?'

Shang Yingyue was also filled with astonishment and disbelief upon discovering that Murong Mengying had fallen in love with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'No wonder she wants to swallow his Yang Qi! It turns out she has fallen in love with him!'

Miao Miao and the cultivators were also shocked, considering that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was only a 10-year-old child in their eyes. They found it strange that Murong Mengying would fall in love with him.

Unfortunately, they misunderstood their relationship, and Murong Mengying had not yet fallen in love with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, the seed of love had indeed grown in her heart, which came from her curiosity about him.

Qiao Liangren, who had known Murong Mengying since they were children, just smiled when he heard that. He believed that she would fall to Zhang Xiaolong [3] sooner or later, but it would not happen anytime soon.

Xia Tian briefly glanced at Murong Mengying before returning his gaze to Hun Di. The latter immediately touched his forehead and shared Zhang Fei's image with him, surprising him. "How could my little daughter fall in love with such a young man?"

"Do you think I would take him as my disciple if he were just an ordinary cultivator?" Xia Tian answered Hun Di with a shake of his head. "That kid is still too young, but his cultivation has already reached the 3-Star Earth Realm, and his soul power is at the Earthly Soul Level. Moreover, he is also a blacksmith, alchemist, and array master."

Murong Mengying massaged her forehead when Xia Tian glanced at her with a playful smile. "Old Father! Senior Hun! We've wasted a lot of time, so we should enter the tower now, but first, we need to test our strength on the stone obelisk."

"Hahaha!" Xia Tian laughed before running to Murong Mengying's side, embracing her and pulling her to the stone obelisk. Little daughter, you must introduce me to that kid after we return from this tower. I will personally test him to see if he is worthy of being my son-in-law."

Murong Mengying chose not to say anything because she was familiar with Xia Tian's character, and he would never stop nagging her. Hun Di and the others immediately followed behind the two, but the Soul Emperor repeatedly glanced at the floating island.
"Hmm? It's weird." Xia Tian then asked Hun Di. "Shouldn't the Nameless One and the others have arrived? Where are they now?"

"I think they couldn't wait and went in first, so we should start testing our strength on this stone obelisk and follow them in." Hun Di then pressed his palm on the stone obelisk, and the ten crystals lit up in a flash.
Xia Tian followed Hun Di's example, successfully lighting up the ten crystals without any issues. "Hey! Isn't this test too easy? It makes me doubt that this tower is the key."

"You jump to conclusions too quickly, Old Father." Murong Mengying immediately touched the stone obelisk. "The real challenges lie inside the tower, and someone is controlling it from the top floor. I don't know if the challenges in this tower will be the same as those in the Star Tower, especially since that person can change them at will, so we should be prepared for the toughest challenges."

After she said that, Murong Mengying immediately channeled her Qi into the stone obelisk, igniting ten crystals. Shang Yingyue, Qiao Liangren, and Tie Xuan, who followed after her, also managed to ignite the ten crystals.
However, Shang Guangming could only light seven crystals, and Shang Yaolin could light eight. Meanwhile, the four people from the Murong and Hong Clans could only light six to seven crystals.

After they were done, Miao Miao led the second group to run the first test. As a result, she and several cultivators of her generation managed to light up nine and ten crystals, but those of the generation below them could only light up a maximum of seven crystals.

A while later, they arrived inside the tower, where they were faced with ten different doors. Xia Tian and Hun Di did not hesitate to approach the black door. Both of them were certain that Feng Jiu's group had selected that challenge as the first, so they were eager to challenge the test behind it.

"Wait!" Murong Mengying immediately stopped the two. "Old Father! Senior Hun! The challenges in this tower are completely different compared to those in the Star Tower. That guy didn't encounter any doors like this, and a portal descended from above once in a while."
"What do you think, Old Tian?" Hun Di asked.

Xia Tian smirked in response. "Are you afraid of facing a mysterious challenge, Old Hun? As an adventurer, I am accustomed to confronting mysterious challenges, and the challenges in this tower ignite my adrenaline."

"Hahaha!" Hun Di laughed and opened the black door directly, making Murong Mengying and the others sigh helplessly. "What are we waiting for? Since the door is open, we can go inside and start the challenge, and we might meet the others inside."
"Let's go in." Xia Tian immediately walked into the black door, followed by Hun Di and the others.

Just as they disappeared behind the door, the old woman appeared on the first floor, her expression gloomy. "That foolish old man! Why did he tell anyone about our realms? Because of his foolishness, many people know about our realms now, and they are racing to go there."

However, an old man suddenly appeared beside the old woman and spoke to her. "That guy is not as foolish as you think, and he must have a special reason for telling someone about our realms. If my guess is correct, these people appear to have a special relationship with that person, and some of them possess good talents. However, we have to watch them first to determine whether they are worthy to set foot in our realms or not."

They suddenly sensed movement outside the tower, which caused them to frown. "Those weak women are overconfident in themselves and think they are worthy of challenging this tower; in reality, they are too weak to challenge it, and they will definitely die here."
"Are you going to stop them from entering, Old Lady?"
"Isn't that certain?" The old woman waved her hand, and a barrier instantly covered the Sun Tower, preventing Ma Mingxin and her group from taking the strength test. "Let's go back."

Outside the tower, Ma Mingxin furiously continued to attack the barrier, but her actions were futile, especially since it was simply too powerful for a cultivator at her level. In the end, she ordered her female subordinates to return to the floating island, but she did not return there and left the Blossom Heaven Realm instead. "Tch! Since I can't enter the tower, and those people will be busy inside, I will go to the Sky Jade Realm to look for Meng Qi there."

After she was unconscious for some time, Wushuang finally woke up. However, she frowned when she saw Huan Ya, who was sitting on the edge of the sofa. "How did you sneak in here? Where is Linghu Yincheng?"

"Rather than thinking about Lingyu Yingcheng, you should think about yourself." Wushuang instantly became furious and moved toward Huan Ya, but her body froze as soon as she arrived in front of her. "You don't need to waste energy attacking me, especially since you'll never be able to do it."
"What do you mean by that? Who are you really?" Wushuang asked in a high tone.

"Hehe." Huan Ya chuckled. "My name is Huan Ya, and my master assigned me to watch over this kingdom. Oh, my master has implanted his slave mark into your soul when you were unconscious, so you are his slave now."
"What?" Wushuang let out a cry of shock and examined her soul, discovering Zhang Fei's slave mark within. "This... how is this possible? Who is your master? What is his purpose in enslaving me?"

"You don't need to know my master's identity, but I can tell you that he is more vicious than Huangfu Shou or Li Tiannan." Wushuang was shocked to hear the last name and looked at Huan Ya in horror. "My master knows you are their subordinate, so you should know his purpose in enslaving you, right?"

Huan Ya's words caused Wushuang's face to turn deathly pale, and she immediately threatened her. "Heh! I don't know who your master is, but he has made a fatal mistake by enslaving me. Master Tiannan will definitely find his slave mark in my soul after he returns, and he will hunt him down and kill him."

"Do you think my master hasn't considered that?" Wushuang frowned at Huan Ya. "Li Tiannan came from the Li Clan in the Grand Royal Realm, and it was a subsidiary clan of the Huangfu Clan there. They were the ancestors of Huangfu Shou, and they sent him here to protect their descendants."
"How... how could your master know all that? Did... did he come from the upper realms?" Wushuang asked in a stutter.
Huan Ya immediately rose from her seat and lifted Wushuang's chin. "The Huangfu Clan may be strong, but there are still many clans that are stronger than them, such as the Phoenix Race."
Wushuang's eyes widened even wider after Huan Ya mentioned the Phoenix Race, and her body visibly trembled at the thought of having to fight with people from that race.

"My master deliberately did not change your memories so that Li Tiannan would not be suspicious of you." Huan Ya caressed Wushuang's cheek. "Even though you won't be able to tell him anything about him, you better behave yourself because my master is keeping a close eye on you, and you will experience hellish suffering if he gets angry."

Following her statement, Huan Ya swiftly exited the room, leaving Wushuang alone. 'Tch! This matter is really serious! Master Tiannan will die if people from the Phoenix Race attack him! Furthermore, I'm uncertain about the person's intentions toward me, and it's possible that he could use me to kill him. If he dies here, his clan will kill my family, but I can't warn him not to return to this realm.'

It was already evening when Zhang Fei finished purchasing some items, especially various herb seeds to plant in the Sealed World Pearl.
"Why are you smiling to yourself?" Yun Xinyue suddenly asked.
Zhang Fei turned to her directly. "The building in the Yun Kingdom has been renovated, so I can start opening my second shop and restaurant tomorrow."
"That's great!" Yun Xinyue said in a slightly louder tone. "You can earn more gold by opening both, and I can return to my kingdom more easily if I miss my family."

Zhang Fei nodded to her. "My building in the Natural Races' kingdom has also been renovated, and I will open both on the same day. After that, I will retreat into seclusion in the Guo Clan's lightning pond for a few days. However, I must stop before my wedding day with Qin'er, and I will resume after our wedding night."
"I see." Yun Xinyue nodded in understanding. "I haven't trained at the lightning pond for quite a while, so I'll join you and the others."
"Hey, Fei!" Zhang Fei turned to Ling Long. "How are you going to have a honeymoon with Xian Xianqin? Are you going to do it through her butthole?"
"Ling Long!" Zhou Shenxin and Yun Xinyue immediately shouted at her.

"Hahaha." Ling Long laughed and moved a little away from them. "Hey, you two didn't hear what I heard last night! Shang Yumei asked Zhang Fei to have sex with her through her butthole, and they actually did it for a few hours."
Upon hearing that, Zhou Shenxin and Yun Xinyue also moved away from Zhang Fei, staring at him and covering their buttholes with their hands.

"You are so perverted and shameless! You even peeked at me with Yumei!" Ling Long responded to Zhang Fei by sticking her tongue out, causing him to shake his head helplessly. However, he suddenly received a voice transmission from Xian Feng, informing him that the people to be sent to the Zhou Kingdom were ready. "Emperor Xian just contacted me, and he asked me to meet you, so we will go to the Xian Imperial Sect now."
A while later, Zhang Fei had already brought the three women to the sect. They hurried to the sect's main hall, where dozens of people were already waiting for them.
Ximen Chuixue led his eight sect sisters and brothers. Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin led the same people who had joined them at the Star Tower back then.
Back in the tower, the third group was led by Xian Yu and Xian Mu, but both of them were already crippled, and Xian Feng and Xian Luo had also eliminated their loyal followers.
Xian Luo eventually formed three new groups for their latest mission to infiltrate and weaken the forces of the Zhou Kingdom, and three male elders led all three groups.
