Zhang Lin, Ye Lian, Zhou Ziqin, Ming Yanyu, and several women from the demon fox group focused on serving the diners.
On the second floor, Tang Ziyu, with the help of Guo Lan, Wang Zhuxian, and several women from the demon fox group, serves the shop visitors.
Fortunately, the visitors were cultivators, so they didn't have to bother to pack their purchases, and they only needed to store them in their respective storage rings.

Like their shop in the Xian capital, mattresses and other goods from Earth became the best sellers, especially since Zhang Fei decided not to sell pills there due to the presence of the Alchemy Union's shop in the next building.
In addition to mattresses, a variety of sex equipment is also in high demand, with sex dolls being the most popular item.
Unlike the opening of their shop and restaurant in the Yun Kingdom, the opening of the two in the Natural Races kingdom did not run smoothly.
After all, they were not familiar with the Sky Jade restaurant or shop, and they had never known about dishes or goods from Earth.
The situation changed slightly when Xian Lianghua, Xue Jingling, and Xian Jinglan visited the restaurant.
The natural races who had known Zhang Fei in the Star Tower also brought their respective family members to taste the dishes and look at the items from Earth.
Xin Xianzi also brought many people from the fairy race, which slowly made the situation in the restaurant and shop lively.
In the end, the residents of the kingdom's capital decided to taste those dishes, and some of them even tried to explore the goods from Earth.
Janette focuses in the kitchen on cooking dishes for the diners.
Yuhe, Sabina, and Shen Xueyi assisted her, especially since Zhang Fei couldn't bring the members of the Demon Fox group to the kingdom.
Meanwhile, Shen assisted Lillea in the shop, and the natural races from the Sky Jade Realm focused on serving shop buyers.
Zhang Fei decided to sell various types of pills in his shop in the Natural Races' Kingdom.
Although many other types of pills also sold well, the basic pills were the best sellers among them, and their sales volume surpassed Earth's goods.
After ensuring that the opening of his restaurant and shop's two branches went smoothly, Zhang Fei took Yun Xinyue, Zhong Yan, and Angela to the Guo Clan, which was quite far from the Yun capital.
With Yun Xinyue by their side, they could enter the Guo Clan with ease.
However, Zhang Fei felt a little disturbed when he noticed several men repeatedly glancing at Zhong Yan and Angela, both old and young.
Noticing their gazes at Zhong Yan and Angela, Yun Xinyue immediately ordered them to stop their actions.
After all, Zhang Fei had a bad reputation for dealing with those he considered his enemies.
He was truly cruel and did not hesitate to destroy them, so she did not want her clan members to have problems with him, which would only harm them.
Zhong Yan and Angela also noticed the glances the people from the Guo Clan were giving them, so they hugged both of Zhang Fei's arms intimately, which only fueled their jealousy toward him.
Yun Xinyue then led the three of them to the area behind the Guo Clan, which was the location of their lightning pond.
Zhang Fei was a little surprised when they arrived at the area, especially since it still looked natural, with many plants and rocks surrounding it.
However, countless purple lightning bolts continued to strike from the sky into that area, and there was a fairly large pond filled with purple lightning.

"Usually, only our clan members use this pond to train their lightning elements, so you three are the first outsiders to use it." Yun Xinyue then used a token to unlock the barrier, allowing them to enter.
"As my mother has explained to you, Zhong Yan and Angela can only train in this pond once every six hours, and they have to rest for six hours before continuing their training again."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and summoned Lei Que out of the beast's space.
Immediately, the thunderbird shrank his body because it was too big for that area.
Wasting no time, Lei Que immediately flew high above the lightning pond, but countless purple lightning bolts that fell from the sky immediately struck his body, causing him to grimace.
"Master!
These lightning bolts are quite powerful, but they are not as powerful as the lightning from your lightning tribulations."
"How long can you last there?"
Lei Que shook his head at Zhang Fei.
"Even though their attacks weren't very strong, they kept striking my body.
Perhaps I can only withstand their attacks and absorb them for a day, after which I need some time to rest and recuperate."
"All right, train there until your limit, then rest in the beast space." Lei Que nodded to Zhang Fei and flew higher into the sky.
"Yan'er and Angela, you two can enter the pond.
Lei Que will prevent those lightning bolts from striking you two directly so you can focus on absorbing the lightning element in it."
"Yes." Zhong Yan and Angela rushed into the lightning pond.
Although the lightning bolts could not strike their bodies directly, they still felt pain from the lightning in the pond.
Even so, the two women did not want to give up because the lightning could help them become strong, especially to help them break through in their Heavenly Lightning Body cultivation techniques.
"What about you?
Are you going to join Zhong Yan and Angela?" Yun Xinyue asked.
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Yun Xinyue.
"The lightning in the pond is too weak for me, and I will join Lei Que up there.
That way, I can protect them from the lightning bolts, and my Heavenly Lightning Body cultivation technique might be able to break through to the fourth stage faster."
Before Yun Xinyue could stop Zhang Fei, he had already moved onto Lei Qui's back and sat there, absorbing the lightning bolts that struck the two of them.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]

After he completed the daily quest and Hong Xinxin woke up from her sleep, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked her to use the liquid on him again, especially considering its potential usefulness when combined with the effects of the lightning bolts in the lightning pond.
Like yesterday, Hong Xinxin immediately poured a large amount of the liquid into the wooden tub, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly soaked in it to absorb it.
After that, Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying left the secluded house, especially after they learned from their people that Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan had left the Red Sun Realm.
Before they left, Hong Xinxin told Zhang Xiaolong [3] that they would be gone for one to two days.
She also left a large amount of liquid for him to temper his body.
After that, they immediately returned to their realm to meet the leaders of the other clans to discuss their next plans against the Shang Clan.
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
Since Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] worked together to complete the daily quest, it wasn't difficult for them to complete it quickly.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought all his partners back to the portable mansion, where they were engaged in dual cultivation and soul cultivation.
After all, most of his partners were still too weak because he couldn't use harem sharing with them, so he wanted them to focus on their cultivation first before taking them to live somewhere else.
Feltia [2] didn't bring Eve, Asreth, Leora, Fyr, the Amaris Twins, and Nadea to the portable mansion.
Instead, he took them to the demon island, especially since he wanted to test their abilities to fight the demons there.
After all, Eve, Leora, and Fyr's demon ranks had gone up several levels to the Countess Rank in the past few months.
They were also no longer ordinary demons but demon cultivators, and their cultivation had reached the core realm.
Despite reaching the same level of cultivation as them, Ashreth's demon rank remains at Marchioness.

Although the Amaris Twins and Nadea were not demon cultivators, they were already much stronger than the demons in the Diyu Realms, especially since they had spent a lot of time in the Netherworld Realm and absorbed the demon aura there.
"Master, why have you never brought us to this island before?" Nadea asked him.
The Black Amaris inhaled the demon aura on the island before speaking.
"My lord, the demon aura on this island is much stronger than in the Diyu Realm, but it is slightly weaker than in the Netherworld Realm."
"That's true." The White Amaris nodded in agreement with her twin sister.
"My lord, I want to train on this island so our demon rank can increase faster, and we might be able to rise to become demon queens soon."
"I can't wait to become a demon duchess." Ashreth agreed with the three of them, and her eyes looked far away, excited about the adventure on the island.
"Hehe." Leora giggled and jumped onto Feltia [2]'s back, hugging him from behind.
"Fei, let's train here for a few days.
That way, Eve, Fyr, and I can become demon marchionesses soon."
"Please, Fei.
Let us train on this island." Eve and Fyr begged Feltia [2].
"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed, seeing them like that.
"Are you still unaware of the reason I brought you here?
Since we haven't been in this realm for a long time and you are still too weak to cultivate demons, I decided to allow you to cultivate in the training space.
However, you guys are already strong enough now, so I purposely brought you here to train and increase your demon power.
Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, and Balena will also join you all so you guys can protect each other."
"That's great!"
Suddenly, Zhang Fei [4] appeared in front of them, bringing Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, and Balena with him.
After Feltia [2] determined their training location, she immediately brought the female demons to that area, where they began their training while absorbing the demon aura.
However, he refrained from taking them to the area of the two demon kingdoms, primarily because he didn't want to clash with the demons of those two kingdoms just yet.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] entered the training space because there were three new recipes in the alchemy shop, and he must successfully concoct one of them in order to unlock the level four alchemy feature.
Several hours passed quickly, and the sun was already beginning to set.

However, the Sky Jade restaurant and shop in the Natural Races' Kingdom were getting busier as news of their opening quickly spread to other areas of the island, and people from other towns flocked to the capital to check them out.
Even so, the situation was relatively relaxed and calm, and the natural races were much neater when visiting the restaurant and shop.
"Can we go now?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately turned to Aqua.
"Oh, that's right!
I almost forgot that you invited me to your underwater city.
Since the situation here is under control, we can go there now, and I want to know what is hidden in your forbidden place."
"I'll come with you two." Yuhe said this as she approached Zhang Fei [5] and Aqua.
Zhang Fei [5] hugged their waists, making Aqua feel awkward.
"Show me the direction of your city."
"Over there." Aqua responded by pointing in a specific direction.
"My underwater city is deep under the sea in that area."
Zhang Fei [5] looked in that direction for a moment before taking the two women away from the capital.
In a few minutes, they had already arrived above sea level in the area pointed out by Aqua, causing her to be stunned.
"Hehe." Yuhe giggled at Aqua's reaction.
"Sister, you don't have to be surprised by his abilities.
He has extraordinary movement techniques, and his raw speed has already surpassed cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms like us."
"I see." Aqua nodded in understanding before breaking away from Zhang Fei [5]'s embrace.
"Since you lack the water element, the seabed pressure will be too much for you, so I'll carry you there."
"All right." Aqua enveloped Zhang Fei [5] and Yuhe with her aura, and she also used her water element to create water bubbles.
"Let's go."
*Splash*
On the way to the seabed, five giant sea beasts in the Seven Divine Realms tried to approach them because they were attracted by Zhang Fei [5]'s heavenly fox aura.
Zhang Fei [5] deliberately used his heavenly fox aura to lure them to him.
After all, he had several other women with water elements, and they did not have beast contracts yet, so he wanted to find some for them.
However, the five sea beasts did not dare to get too close, especially since the pressure from Zhang Fei [5]'s aura was too terrifying for them.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately read the information about the five sea beasts after Mei displayed them.
Although the five sea beasts were powerful, he felt that none of them were worthy of being the contract beasts of his women, so he ignored them.
After a while of swimming, they finally reached the seabed.
However, Aqua took them into her underwater city through another path—not through the water whirlpool like Yuhe experienced when she went there the first time.
"Welcome to my underwater city." Aqua then led them to a forbidden place, which was located far at the back.
She explained several things to Zhang Fei [5].
"As you can see, the residents of this city are natural races from my undine race and several other races.
This city also hosts numerous aquatic beasts that have undergone transformation into humans.
However, no land beasts have ever come here, so you are the first to come here."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at that.
"Miss Aqua, I may be a heavenly fox, but I am basically human because I was born as one."
"Well, that's true." Aqua then told Zhang Fei [5] about every race among the natural races that lived in her underwater city, such as Nereid, Oceanid, Mermaid, and many more.
Zhang Fei [5] listened to Aqua's story as he observed the people of all races who crossed their paths, especially the female ones.
He also checked their status one by one, and many of them had high cultivation levels, but none of them attracted him.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Mei to check every female beast in the underwater city, especially those with cultivation in the Seven Divine Realms.
A while later, they reached the vicinity of the forbidden area, where a giant three-headed sea beast lay in front of the entrance.

However, Zhang Fei [5]'s expression turned serious after he sensed the aura of the thing inside the place. 'The thing inside is clearly related to the ten-tailed fox, yet its aura is different from the old fox, and it feels more evil.'

chapters.title: Chapter 678 Evil Ten-Tailed Fox
paragraphs: Upon sensing Zhang Fei [5]'s beast aura, the beast immediately opened his eyes and shifted to a standing position. He possessed three serpent heads, each adorned with fish gills, and the purplish-black scales covered his entire body.
'Scan the beast, Mei.'
Name: Jiu Shui
Gender: Male
Race: Nine-Headed Serpent
Rank: Quasi-Divine Beast
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Expansion
Elements: Water + Poison
Core: Advanced-Rank Water Core, Advanced-Rank Poison Core
Physique: Serpent Beast
Abilities: Regeneration, Venomous Bite, Toxic Breath, Poisonous Blood, Water Control, and so on.
Strong: Water + Poison
Weak: Earth + Fire

'Another serpent! I already have three serpents by my side!' Zhang Fei [5] stared at the beast with a faint grin. "In my home realm, hydras are creatures from myths, and they don't exist, but I didn't expect to meet a real one here. Moreover, he is not yet perfect because he only has three heads, and he will become perfect after reaching nine heads."
"Nine heads?" Aqua and Yuhe were surprised to hear that.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to them. "According to mythology, hydras are one of the strongest sea beasts, and they can have nine heads. Their heads will continue to regenerate every time we behead them, and their ninth head can never be destroyed, so they can never die."
"Doesn't that mean this beast is immortal?" Yuhe asked in shock.

"Yes and no." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused Aqua and Yuhe. "Hydras' ninth head is indeed indestructible, but we can still cut it off. Separating the head from the body prevents it from reconnecting, killing the beast. As for this guy, he can still die because he doesn't have his ninth head yet."
*Roar... Roar... Roar...*

Jiu Shui's three heads let out an angry roar after he said all that, and he immediately spat out his poison from his three mouths toward him. Zhang Fei [5] immediately bounced Aqua and Yuhe backward right before the beast's poison hit him.
Yuhe and Aqua panicked and screamed. "Zhang Fei!"

"Haha!" Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he expelled the poison from his body without being affected in the slightest by its effects, leaving Jiu Shui and the two women dumbfounded. "Hey! I didn't come here to find trouble with you, but I will beat you to a pulp if you dare attack me one more time. Besides, your poison does not affect me, so you don't need to waste your energy attacking me and go back to sleep."
Instead, one of Jiu Shui's heads shot toward him, eager to devour him alive, but Zhang Fei [5] instantly vanished from his position, causing his head to slam into the ground.
*Boom*
Jiu Shui's other two heads looked up after he sensed Zhang Fei [5]'s presence there, but both heads immediately fell to the ground as soon as he released his heavenly fox aura.
*Bam... Bam...*

"I admit that you are powerful, especially since your cultivation has already reached the 5-Moon Divine Expansion. However, we are both beasts, and our bloodlines significantly influence our level of power." Zhang Fei [5] immediately transformed into his full fox form and released his aura further, causing Jiu Shu to tremble. "Do you think a mere quasi-divine rank beast like you can fight a mythical rank beast like me?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword. He also took out the moonlit whisper sword and the abyss demon halberd. Wasting no time, he threw the three of them toward Jiu Shu, pierced his three serpent mouths, and nailed them to the ground.
Zhang Fei [5] didn't stop there. He took out the heaven creation furnace, enlarged it as big as possible, and threw it at the beast's body.
*Roar... Roar... Roar...*

Jiu Shu roared in pain because of the wounds on his three mouths, but the pressure of Zhang Fei [5]'s heavenly fox aura plus the weight of the heaven creation furnace rendered him unable to move an inch.

Zhang Fei [5]'s actions caused Aqua to fall dumbstruck, especially since Jiu Shu was much stronger than him, yet he managed to immobilize the beast in a matter of seconds. Moreover, the Undine could see that the moonlit whisper sword and the Heaven Creation furnace were divine-grade equipment, and the demon extermination sword was a heaven-grade soul weapon. 'Where did he get so much extraordinary equipment?'
When Zhang Fei [5] floated down in front of Jiu Shui and returned to his human form, Yuhe spoke to Aqua. "Sister, it seems this city will lose one of its guardians."
Aqua nodded. "It's fine as long as Zhang Fei [5] doesn't kill him."
[Are you going to contract this beast forcibly, Master?]

'Do you really need to ask that question, Mei? This beast is much stronger than all the beasts by my side, and he will become much stronger after he evolves into nine heads, so it will be a waste if I kill him. Unfortunately, he is a male beast, which means I cannot give him to Hua'er.' Mei laughed out loud inside Zhang Fei [5]'s mind after he said that, especially since he was too possessive regarding all his women. "If you were an ordinary beast, I would have killed you by now. Fortunately, you are a quasi-divine beast, and you are also a powerful beast, so I will force you to follow me forever."
*Roar... Roar... Roar...*
Jiu Shui roared and struggled as Zhang Fei [5] touched one of his heads, but his struggle was in vain because of all the pressure pressing down on his body and bloodline.
With Mei's help, Zhang Fei [5] made a forced contract with Jiu Shui, and three fox symbols quickly appeared on the beast's three heads.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the third beast contract.]
[The Beast Feature has been upgraded to level 3.]
After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei [5] stored the furnace and the two weapons in the system inventory. The demon extermination sword then entered his forehead, transforming into a tattoo.

Zhang Fei [5] smirked faintly before sending the helpless Jiu Shui into the beast space, shocking all the beasts inside, including Boitata. He then spoke to Aqua and Yuhe. "You guys wait here, and I'll go inside myself, especially since the thing inside is truly evil."
"What exactly is inside, Zhang Fei?" Yuhe and Aqua asked in unison.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at them. "I can't check it from here, but I can feel its evil aura. You guys better not follow me lest you guys be affected by it, and it will only bring trouble to the three of us."
"All right! We will wait here, but you have to be careful because we don't know what's inside."
"Yeah."

After entering the forbidden area, Zhang Fei [5] found himself on a narrow path with countless rainbow coral reefs on both sides. He could sense the evil aura, which originated at the end of the place, getting stronger.

Zhang Fei [5] could feel that his heavenly fox bloodline was trembling in fear due to the pressure of the evil aura, and he had never felt such a thing before, making him certain that it was indeed related to the ten-tailed fox.

As he walked deeper, Zhang Fei [5] could not help but wonder about the evil aura. After all, the soul of the ten-tailed fox he had met in the fairy forest did not have the slightest evil aura, and his aura was soothing.

A while later, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the end of the forbidden place, but he froze with wide eyes, staring at the figure in front of him. 'What the hell is this? A black ten-tailed fox? Why didn't the old fox inform me about it?'

Unlike the soul of the ten-tailed fox he met in the fairy forest, the soul of the ten-tailed fox in front of him was completely black, except for his blood-red eyes. His evil aura caused the temperature within the place to become extremely cold, and Zhang Fei [5] continued to feel a chill down his spine, even suffocating him.
Ever since he walked into the world of cultivation, Zhang Fei [5] had never felt such overwhelming fear in his heart, causing cold sweat to begin to wet his body.

Even when he faced the heavenly foxes, Hun Di, or other cultivators from the upper realms, Zhang Fei [5] had never felt that kind of fear, and he felt that he could die at any moment if he had to face the black ten-tailed fox.

[Master, this black ten-tailed fox is only a soul and does not have a real body, but his soul is intact and not divided like the old fox. His soul is in a weak condition, especially since he has not had a body for long. Despite this, his soul power remains significantly greater than yours, so you should exercise caution if he uses soul techniques to attack you.]
Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] wouldn't dare take Mei's warning lightly, especially since she and the system had helped him advance in the cultivation world this far.
Zhang Fei [5] didn't dare approach the black ten-tailed fox and kept his distance from him. He also summoned the demon extermination sword, gripping the hilt very tightly.

Ma Kuangyu, residing within Zhang Fei [5]'s soul space, sensed his fear and immediately warned him. 'Kid! Don't ever approach that fox soul with your current soul power! I've never met a ten-tailed fox before, and I don't know how he got confined here, but he's truly powerful. If his soul manages to possess you, he will destroy your soul and take over your body. If that happens, the people closest to you and all living creatures from the lower to upper realms will be in danger.'
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] responded with a nod before turning to leave.

"Hey, brat! Are you that scared of me?" The black ten-tailed fox suddenly asked. "I didn't expect that a heavenly fox would come to this place today, and you already got a little soul from my other half."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately stopped and faced the black ten-tailed fox. "What do you mean by your other half?"
"Hahahaha." The black ten-tailed fox laughed heartily before replying. "If you want to know everything, you can release me from this prison, and I will tell you everything afterward."
"Do you really think I'm naive and innocent?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in question. "Since you mentioned your other half, I have one guess about you."
The black ten-tailed fox smirked in response. "What's your guess, Brat?"

"You and the old fox are one, but you are his evil side, and he deliberately discarded you and imprisoned you in this place because you were too evil." After Zhang Fei [5] said that, the black ten-tailed fox became serious, and his blood-red eyes turned vicious. "Heh! My guess is right on target, right? Honestly, I wanted to absorb your soul to strengthen mine, but I wouldn't be foolish enough to approach you at this time. Once my soul power reaches the divine soul level, I will return to see you again, and your soul will become mine."

"Hey, Brat! Release me! I promise! I won't do anything to you! I just want to be free from this place!" The black ten-tailed fox's words naturally wouldn't fool Zhang Fei [5], so he ignored him and continued to walk away from that place. "Tch! That brat may still be young, but he is not naive. Since he already got a little soul from my other half, he is destined to become the next nine-tailed fox. If he succeeds in becoming one, he will surely devour my soul, and I will disappear forever. Fortunately, this won't happen anytime soon because he still needs to gather the souls of my other half and the hearts of those two heavenly foxes, giving me ample time to escape from this place. Once I manage to escape, I will hunt him down and take over his body. But how can I escape? Only he or the other heavenly foxes can free me."
"How did it go? Did you manage to find the source of the evil aura?" Yuhe and Aqua immediately asked as soon as Zhang Fei [5] came out.
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled heavily. "The source of the evil aura is the soul of the ten-tailed fox."
"What?" Both women cried out in shock.
Yuhe then asked. "Isn't the soul of the ten-tailed fox residing in the fairy forest? Moreover, his soul has merged with yours, right?"

"You are wrong, Yuhe." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. "The soul of the ten-tailed fox in their fairy forest is only a fragment of his soul, and some of his other soul fragments are scattered out there. As for the soul in this place, it was half of his original soul, but it was his evil soul."
"The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to the two women. "The ten-tailed fox didn't want his evil soul to influence him, so he deliberately discarded it and locked him up here. Fortunately, no one could free him except the members of the heavenly fox races, so I'm sure everything will be fine. However, we still have to monitor this place and not let anyone come here, especially since his evil aura will affect everyone who gets close to him."
Aqua nodded in understanding. "Since you have taken the guardian beast away, I will order my people to capture anyone who dares to approach this place."
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Jiu Shui out of the Beast Space. "Guard this place well and kill anyone who intends to enter it."
Jiu Shui nodded helplessly, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was his master now, and he couldn't possibly refuse his orders.

"Doesn't that mean the ten-tailed fox should be much more powerful than in the legend?" Aqua turned to Yuhe directly. "He deliberately discarded his evil soul, so his soul shouldn't be intact, right? In the past, he was already powerful without half of his soul, so I'm sure he would have been much stronger if he had never discarded his evil soul."

"You're right." Aqua replied with a nod of approval. "Our souls are our most important part, and we'll be weakened if we lose even a little bit of it. If the ten-tailed fox never discarded his evil soul, he would have stood above all beasts, and he probably would have never died."

Zhang Fei [5] just smiled upon hearing that, especially since he knew that the ten-tailed fox already stood above other beasts even without his evil soul, proven by the existence of his statue in that mysterious place.

In the first room of the Era of the Beginning, a statue of the ten-tailed fox stands tall in the middle of the room. Statues of the other mythical beasts, including the golden dragon, stand on the sides, surrounding his statue.

However, the ten-tailed fox was clearly not the ultimate beast, especially since Zhang Fei [5] found information about two primordial beasts that existed long ago in the last room of that place. One is a light beast, and the other is a dark beast. "Since I can't do anything about the evil soul now, I'll return to the surface, especially since I still have many things to do."
"I'll go with you, and you can send me back to the natural races' capital." Yuhe then asked Aqua. "Do you want to go back there too, Sister?"
"No." Aqua refused with a shake of her head. "I've been away from this city for a while, so I'll stay here to take care of some things, and you can come back here whenever you want."
Yuhe nodded. "After I finish helping my friends, I will definitely come back to this city again, and we will talk more then."

After Zhang Fei [5] took Yuhe away, Aqua looked towards the forbidden area. "I didn't expect this place to hold such a secret. I must defend this realm with all my might; otherwise, the evil soul will escape and cause chaos across the realms."
Aqua looked at the beast for a moment before walking away, and Jiu Shui curled up in his original spot, lamenting his fate of being Zhang Fei [5]'s contract beast.

"Zhang Fei!"
"Haha!" Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he expelled the poison from his body without being affected in the slightest by its effects, leaving Jiu Shui and the two women dumbfounded.
"Hey!
I didn't come here to find trouble with you, but I will beat you to a pulp if you dare attack me one more time.
Besides, your poison does not affect me, so you don't need to waste your energy attacking me and go back to sleep."
Instead, one of Jiu Shui's heads shot toward him, eager to devour him alive, but Zhang Fei [5] instantly vanished from his position, causing his head to slam into the ground.
*Boom*
Jiu Shui's other two heads looked up after he sensed Zhang Fei [5]'s presence there, but both heads immediately fell to the ground as soon as he released his heavenly fox aura.
*Bam...
Bam...*
"I admit that you are powerful, especially since your cultivation has already reached the 5-Moon Divine Expansion.

However, we are both beasts, and our bloodlines significantly influence our level of power." Zhang Fei [5] immediately transformed into his full fox form and released his aura further, causing Jiu Shu to tremble.
"Do you think a mere quasi-divine rank beast like you can fight a mythical rank beast like me?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword.
He also took out the moonlit whisper sword and the abyss demon halberd.
Wasting no time, he threw the three of them toward Jiu Shu, pierced his three serpent mouths, and nailed them to the ground.
Zhang Fei [5] didn't stop there.
He took out the heaven creation furnace, enlarged it as big as possible, and threw it at the beast's body.
*Roar...
Roar...
Roar...*

Jiu Shu roared in pain because of the wounds on his three mouths, but the pressure of Zhang Fei [5]'s heavenly fox aura plus the weight of the heaven creation furnace rendered him unable to move an inch.
Zhang Fei [5]'s actions caused Aqua to fall dumbstruck, especially since Jiu Shu was much stronger than him, yet he managed to immobilize the beast in a matter of seconds.

Moreover, the Undine could see that the moonlit whisper sword and the Heaven Creation furnace were divine-grade equipment, and the demon extermination sword was a heaven-grade soul weapon. 'Where did he get so much extraordinary equipment?'
When Zhang Fei [5] floated down in front of Jiu Shui and returned to his human form, Yuhe spoke to Aqua.
"Sister, it seems this city will lose one of its guardians."
Aqua nodded.
"It's fine as long as Zhang Fei [5] doesn't kill him."
[Are you going to contract this beast forcibly, Master?]
'Do you really need to ask that question, Mei?
This beast is much stronger than all the beasts by my side, and he will become much stronger after he evolves into nine heads, so it will be a waste if I kill him.

Unfortunately, he is a male beast, which means I cannot give him to Hua'er.' Mei laughed out loud inside Zhang Fei [5]'s mind after he said that, especially since he was too possessive regarding all his women.
"If you were an ordinary beast, I would have killed you by now.
Fortunately, you are a quasi-divine beast, and you are also a powerful beast, so I will force you to follow me forever."
*Roar...
Roar...
Roar...*
Jiu Shui roared and struggled as Zhang Fei [5] touched one of his heads, but his struggle was in vain because of all the pressure pressing down on his body and bloodline.
With Mei's help, Zhang Fei [5] made a forced contract with Jiu Shui, and three fox symbols quickly appeared on the beast's three heads.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the third beast contract.]
[The Beast Feature has been upgraded to level 3.]
After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei [5] stored the furnace and the two weapons in the system inventory.
The demon extermination sword then entered his forehead, transforming into a tattoo.
Zhang Fei [5] smirked faintly before sending the helpless Jiu Shui into the beast space, shocking all the beasts inside, including Boitata.
He then spoke to Aqua and Yuhe.
"You guys wait here, and I'll go inside myself, especially since the thing inside is truly evil."
"What exactly is inside, Zhang Fei?" Yuhe and Aqua asked in unison.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at them.
"I can't check it from here, but I can feel its evil aura.
You guys better not follow me lest you guys be affected by it, and it will only bring trouble to the three of us."
"All right!
We will wait here, but you have to be careful because we don't know what's inside."
"Yeah."
After entering the forbidden area, Zhang Fei [5] found himself on a narrow path with countless rainbow coral reefs on both sides.
He could sense the evil aura, which originated at the end of the place, getting stronger.

Zhang Fei [5] could feel that his heavenly fox bloodline was trembling in fear due to the pressure of the evil aura, and he had never felt such a thing before, making him certain that it was indeed related to the ten-tailed fox.
As he walked deeper, Zhang Fei [5] could not help but wonder about the evil aura.
After all, the soul of the ten-tailed fox he had met in the fairy forest did not have the slightest evil aura, and his aura was soothing.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the end of the forbidden place, but he froze with wide eyes, staring at the figure in front of him. 'What the hell is this?
A black ten-tailed fox?
Why didn't the old fox inform me about it?'
Unlike the soul of the ten-tailed fox he met in the fairy forest, the soul of the ten-tailed fox in front of him was completely black, except for his blood-red eyes.
His evil aura caused the temperature within the place to become extremely cold, and Zhang Fei [5] continued to feel a chill down his spine, even suffocating him.
Ever since he walked into the world of cultivation, Zhang Fei [5] had never felt such overwhelming fear in his heart, causing cold sweat to begin to wet his body.

Even when he faced the heavenly foxes, Hun Di, or other cultivators from the upper realms, Zhang Fei [5] had never felt that kind of fear, and he felt that he could die at any moment if he had to face the black ten-tailed fox.
[Master, this black ten-tailed fox is only a soul and does not have a real body, but his soul is intact and not divided like the old fox.
His soul is in a weak condition, especially since he has not had a body for long.
Despite this, his soul power remains significantly greater than yours, so you should exercise caution if he uses soul techniques to attack you.]
Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] wouldn't dare take Mei's warning lightly, especially since she and the system had helped him advance in the cultivation world this far.
Zhang Fei [5] didn't dare approach the black ten-tailed fox and kept his distance from him.
He also summoned the demon extermination sword, gripping the hilt very tightly.
Ma Kuangyu, residing within Zhang Fei [5]'s soul space, sensed his fear and immediately warned him. 'Kid!
Don't ever approach that fox soul with your current soul power!
I've never met a ten-tailed fox before, and I don't know how he got confined here, but he's truly powerful.
If his soul manages to possess you, he will destroy your soul and take over your body.
If that happens, the people closest to you and all living creatures from the lower to upper realms will be in danger.'
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] responded with a nod before turning to leave.
"Hey, brat!
Are you that scared of me?" The black ten-tailed fox suddenly asked.
"I didn't expect that a heavenly fox would come to this place today, and you already got a little soul from my other half."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately stopped and faced the black ten-tailed fox.
"What do you mean by your other half?"
"Hahahaha." The black ten-tailed fox laughed heartily before replying.
"If you want to know everything, you can release me from this prison, and I will tell you everything afterward."
"Do you really think I'm naive and innocent?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in question.
"Since you mentioned your other half, I have one guess about you."
The black ten-tailed fox smirked in response.
"What's your guess, Brat?"

"You and the old fox are one, but you are his evil side, and he deliberately discarded you and imprisoned you in this place because you were too evil." After Zhang Fei [5] said that, the black ten-tailed fox became serious, and his blood-red eyes turned vicious.
"Heh!
My guess is right on target, right?
Honestly, I wanted to absorb your soul to strengthen mine, but I wouldn't be foolish enough to approach you at this time.
Once my soul power reaches the divine soul level, I will return to see you again, and your soul will become mine."
"Hey, Brat!
Release me!
I promise!
I won't do anything to you!
I just want to be free from this place!" The black ten-tailed fox's words naturally wouldn't fool Zhang Fei [5], so he ignored him and continued to walk away from that place.
"Tch!
That brat may still be young, but he is not naive.
Since he already got a little soul from my other half, he is destined to become the next nine-tailed fox.
If he succeeds in becoming one, he will surely devour my soul, and I will disappear forever.
Fortunately, this won't happen anytime soon because he still needs to gather the souls of my other half and the hearts of those two heavenly foxes, giving me ample time to escape from this place.
Once I manage to escape, I will hunt him down and take over his body.
But how can I escape?
Only he or the other heavenly foxes can free me."
"How did it go?
Did you manage to find the source of the evil aura?" Yuhe and Aqua immediately asked as soon as Zhang Fei [5] came out.
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled heavily.
"The source of the evil aura is the soul of the ten-tailed fox."
"What?" Both women cried out in shock.
Yuhe then asked.
"Isn't the soul of the ten-tailed fox residing in the fairy forest?
Moreover, his soul has merged with yours, right?"
"You are wrong, Yuhe." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head.
"The soul of the ten-tailed fox in their fairy forest is only a fragment of his soul, and some of his other soul fragments are scattered out there.
As for the soul in this place, it was half of his original soul, but it was his evil soul."
"The evil soul of the ten-tailed fox?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to the two women.
"The ten-tailed fox didn't want his evil soul to influence him, so he deliberately discarded it and locked him up here.
Fortunately, no one could free him except the members of the heavenly fox races, so I'm sure everything will be fine.
However, we still have to monitor this place and not let anyone come here, especially since his evil aura will affect everyone who gets close to him."
Aqua nodded in understanding.
"Since you have taken the guardian beast away, I will order my people to capture anyone who dares to approach this place."
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Jiu Shui out of the Beast Space.
"Guard this place well and kill anyone who intends to enter it."
Jiu Shui nodded helplessly, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was his master now, and he couldn't possibly refuse his orders.
"Doesn't that mean the ten-tailed fox should be much more powerful than in the legend?" Aqua turned to Yuhe directly.
"He deliberately discarded his evil soul, so his soul shouldn't be intact, right?
In the past, he was already powerful without half of his soul, so I'm sure he would have been much stronger if he had never discarded his evil soul."
"You're right." Aqua replied with a nod of approval.
"Our souls are our most important part, and we'll be weakened if we lose even a little bit of it.
If the ten-tailed fox never discarded his evil soul, he would have stood above all beasts, and he probably would have never died."

Zhang Fei [5] just smiled upon hearing that, especially since he knew that the ten-tailed fox already stood above other beasts even without his evil soul, proven by the existence of his statue in that mysterious place.
In the first room of the Era of the Beginning, a statue of the ten-tailed fox stands tall in the middle of the room.
Statues of the other mythical beasts, including the golden dragon, stand on the sides, surrounding his statue.
However, the ten-tailed fox was clearly not the ultimate beast, especially since Zhang Fei [5] found information about two primordial beasts that existed long ago in the last room of that place.
One is a light beast, and the other is a dark beast.
"Since I can't do anything about the evil soul now, I'll return to the surface, especially since I still have many things to do."
"I'll go with you, and you can send me back to the natural races' capital." Yuhe then asked Aqua.
"Do you want to go back there too, Sister?"
"No." Aqua refused with a shake of her head.
"I've been away from this city for a while, so I'll stay here to take care of some things, and you can come back here whenever you want."
Yuhe nodded.
"After I finish helping my friends, I will definitely come back to this city again, and we will talk more then."
After Zhang Fei [5] took Yuhe away, Aqua looked towards the forbidden area.
"I didn't expect this place to hold such a secret.
I must defend this realm with all my might; otherwise, the evil soul will escape and cause chaos across the realms."
Aqua looked at the beast for a moment before walking away, and Jiu Shui curled up in his original spot, lamenting his fate of being Zhang Fei [5]'s contract beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 Recruit A New Cook
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei [5] sent her back to the shop, Yuhe immediately informed Oliver and the others about their discovery in the underwater city. She told them through voice transmission, especially since the shop was still packed with customers, and the existence of the black ten-tailed fox had shocked them greatly.
'Can Zhang Fei do something about the evil soul?' Oliver asked.

Yuhe shook her head at him. 'Zhang Fei stated that he must wait for his soul power to reach the divine soul level before he can absorb the evil soul, as it is too strong for him at this moment. What do you think we should do?'

'I think you should go back to the underwater city to watch over the place yourself.' Yuhe turned to Sabina. 'I'm afraid that those heavenly foxes will come to this realm one day, and they might be able to detect the existence of the evil soul, especially since they are the direct descendants of the ten-tailed fox. Moreover, Zhang Fei said that they could free the evil soul, and the situation would become very dangerous if they managed to do so.'

'I agree with Sabina.' Gravir said with a nod. 'Unfortunately, we are not an aquatic race like you, so we cannot go to the underwater city to protect it. Thus, we can only trust you to monitor and protect the area and report any unwanted incidents to us.'

Persix and the others concurred with their friends' opinions. Yuhe nodded to them. 'In that case, I will return to the underwater city right now, and I will immediately notify you if anything happens.'
Zhang Fei [5] was on Earth to retrieve more goods from his company's warehouse, especially since his three shops were quite busy, and his supplies were dwindling rapidly.
Unfortunately, the flow of time on Earth was much slower than in the Nine Stars Realm, so Huang Rong's people had difficulty providing so many goods to meet the needs of the three shops.

Zhang Fei [5] decided to bring Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er back to Earth. He instructed Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er to reach out to their acquaintances in other countries, asking them to rent a large warehouse in each country for the purpose of storing the goods he wanted to buy in those countries.

Although the prices of goods in those countries were slightly more expensive, Zhang Fei [5] did not mind it. After all, he no longer needed Earth's money and instead needed more resources for cultivation. Furthermore, he planned to open his fourth shop and restaurant in the Bai Kingdom in the near future, which left him with no alternative but to buy them from other countries.

With their extensive business relationships, Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er had no difficulty carrying out Zhang Fei [5]'s wishes. However, some of them requested specific rewards for their assistance, particularly items that were sold at the Sky Jade Shop on Earth.

The two women did not mind their requests and agreed to them immediately, especially since those items were only ordinary in the Sky Jade Realm or the Nine Stars Realm, but they were extremely valuable to earthlings.

In two hours, Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er had finished everything, including paying the rent for the warehouses through their acquaintances. The two women asked their subordinates to send the goods requested by their acquaintances as soon as possible, and they also asked their subordinates in each country to take care of everything.

Once they obtained copies of the lease documents for all the warehouses, Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent Huang Rong back to his residence in the Nine Stars Realm. Since the two women's subordinates would take care of everything for him, he just had to wait and take the goods from those warehouses when they were ready.

Since Zhang Fei [5] was impatient to have the two women from the winged race as his wives, he intended to meet Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianzhi at their apartment in Paris. However, he couldn't find them anywhere, and he guessed that they had returned to the Tian Realm, so he decided to return to the Nine Stars Realm.

A while later, Zhang Fei [5] stood above the sky in the Bai Kingdom, and he found that members of the Han Clan had finished renovating his building. "This way, my fourth shop and restaurant are ready to open, but I have to wait for the stock of goods on Earth, or I won't be able to meet the market demand in this kingdom. Moreover, I still don't have a chef for my restaurant here, so I must postpone the opening of both for a few days."
Zhang Fei [5] then checked the Han Clan on his map and found Han Yuanzhi talking to some people. Instead of meeting her, he went to see Huan Ya at the Bai royal palace.

Wushuang became tense as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of her and Huan Ya, but he paid no attention to her. "Wei Chou sent Qu Qiuxue to this kingdom to look for you, and she will arrive in three days."
"Hmm?" Huan Ya was surprised about that. "What does Wei Chou want from me? He asked others to contact me and force me to meet him, and he is now sending Qu Qiuxue after I refused to return."

"What else? Wei Chou and Qu Qiuxue have a special relationship, and he seems to want you to be his woman." Zhang Fei [5] then gave the Heart Rupturing Pill to Huan Ya. "I don't need the two of them so you can capture the woman and force her to swallow it, but you can let her go after that."

"What is the effect of this pill?" Zhang Fei [5] promptly informed Huan Ya, causing Wushuang, who was standing next to them, to shiver in fear. "Hehe! You are truly wicked, Master. Qu Qiuxue will suffer after she swallows this pill, and she won't be able to do anything to neutralize it."
Zhang Fei [5] then pointed at Wushuang. "You won't be able to beat Qu Qiuxue, but she can do it, so let her help you."
Huan Ya nodded and then asked. "Do you want to have fun with Wushuang, Master?"
"She is only a pawn to face Li Tiannan." Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused. "Report to me if Huangfu Shou gives Wushuang any orders."

After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Huan Ya turned to Wushuang. "Do you understand now? Huangfu Shou and Li Tiannan may be vicious, but my master is much more vicious than them. If you don't want to suffer, you'd better carry out your duties properly."
Wushuang clenched her fists tightly without saying anything, and Huan Ya hurriedly left her. 'Damn it! What can I do to tell Master Tiannan about that man?'

When it was late at night, all the women in the three kingdoms immediately closed their shops and restaurants. They returned to their residences through the teleportation devices installed in the three shops.

Although the results were not as outstanding as in the Xian Kingdom, Zhang Fei [5] was still satisfied with the results of opening the two restaurants and shops in the Yun and Natural Races Kingdoms. Furthermore, he acquired a wide variety of herbs from the natural races, many of which were not yet available at the Sealed World Pearl.

After spending some time with everyone, Zhang Fei [5] sent them to the training space to practice and cultivate. However, Zhang Fei was in seclusion at the Guo Clan's lightning pond together with Yun Xinyue, Zhong Yan, and Angela. Liu Qingyu and his other women did manual cultivation in the Cloud Mansion.

Zhang Fei [5] first took Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu to the Sealed World Pearl, where they planted herbs and herb seeds. He then asked the two Dryads to join Liu Hua and the others, but he asked Shi Wu to join Xian Xianqin and the others to train because she still hadn't adapted to two times gravity. Additionally, he asked Shang Yumei to join the others in the training space, starting her training from the basics.

Zhang Fei [5] then accompanied Hong Yao and the six women from Earth to look around the many areas around the residence. Although they could not have sex with him because he was a clone, they were still pleased that he took the time to accompany them.

Feltia [2] did not bring Fyr and the other female demons back to the portable mansion, and she let them train on the demon island for the next few days. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] focused on his partners, and Zhang Fei [4] focused on alchemy.
With Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin gone, Zhang Xiaolong [3] enjoyed his time with Wu Lianzhi and Shang Xinyu, and he repeatedly teased Shang Yifen.
After this day, nothing significant occurred for the next two days, and they carried out their respective activities in the three kingdoms without any disturbance.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

Since he was going to marry Xian Xianqin tomorrow, Zhang Fei decided to use his fifth clone to replace him at the Guo Clan's lightning pond. He detected ill intentions from some of the clan members, so he couldn't possibly leave Zhong Yan and Angela there unguarded.
Despite Yun Xinyue's status as the princess and a prominent member of the Guo Clan, Zhang Fei doubted her ability to prevent her clan members from harming Zhong Yan and Angela.

Zhang Fei's worries were unfounded, as Guo Xuehua had already firmly threatened the Guo Clan members to severely punish anyone who dared to disturb Zhong Yan and Angela, even if it meant crippling their cultivation.

Due to her high cultivation, Shang Yumei's progress was the most significant compared to that of people from the Sky Jade Realm, like the Hai Twins and others, or the Nine Stars Realm, like Zhou Shenxin and others.
In just a few days of training in the training space, Shang Yumei had almost adapted to two times gravity, and Zhang Fei was confident that she could fully adapt in the next few days.
Zhang Fei, who had been neglecting his official wives for the past three days due to his seclusion, decided to accompany all of them first, leading to an orgy that lasted until dawn.
In the morning, Zhang Fei brought them all out of the training space, except for Shang Yumei, Ling Long, Zhou Shenxin, and several cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm.
Before Zhang Fei took them out, Feng Yao informed him that the Alchemy Union sent Nanfeng Yunxi specially to meet him, and she would arrive in their realm in a week.
Qian Ying decided to stop practicing because Xian Xianqin was going to marry Zhang Fei soon, and she wanted to help her best friend make the final preparations before their wedding.

Once they finished their breakfast, each went immediately to their respective activities. Zhang Fei brought Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying to the Xian royal palace, especially since Shi Qingzhuang was waiting for them.

Qian Ying felt awkward and afraid of meeting Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang again after several decades. Furthermore, she had transformed into a demon, and the Xian emperor was well-known to dislike demons. However, her worries disappeared immediately, especially since both of them welcomed her warmly.

Shi Qingzhuang then took Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying away so her daughter could try on her wedding dress. She also ordered several female servants to help Zhang Fei try on his wedding attire, which looked luxurious and in accordance with the customs of the Xian kingdom.
While trying on his wedding attire, Zhang Fei monitored the system map, and he found that Qu Qiuxue had already arrived at the Bai Kingdom.
However, Wushuang immediately moved to capture Qu Qiuxue. After Huan Ya forced her to swallow the Heart Rupture Pill, she took her away from the kingdom and left her in a distant village.

Since Shi Qingzhuang still needed Xian Xianqin for some other things, Zhang Fei left her and Qian Ying in the Xian royal palace. He then went to Earth and took all the items already available in the warehouses. He immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm to distribute them to Zhang Lingxue, Tang Zhiyu, and Lillea.
After that, Zhang Fei met Xin Yanluo on the edge of the demon island. She told him that the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan had not yet appeared, and she could not find their whereabouts either.

Zhang Fei immediately checked the Zheng Clan through the system map, but he couldn't find the three old demons, which convinced him that they were hiding in a special place covered by a concealment formation.

Next, Zhang Fei checked the Ximen Demon Kingdom, and he found Ximen Gui standing guard not far from Ximen Yueliang's room. Additionally, he discovered several powerful demons from the Nu Clan surrounding Ximen Yueliang's room.

'Ximen Changtian and Nu Huangjin should have known about the Zheng Clan, and they were worried that the clan would capture their daughter, so they assigned that old demon specifically to protect her.' Zhang Fei then looked far away as his eyes fell on the map. 'Zhou Xiaochuan will arrive here tonight, but he is still unaware of his situation. Ximen Chuixue and the others have infiltrated deeper into his kingdom, and they managed to capture some of his subordinates. He will definitely wait for Zhou Shenxin and Zhou Hanling before making his move, but I won't send them both to him, and they probably won't dare to go against Ximen Gui.'

Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, so he immediately went to their sect. However, they were on a mission with Ning Wu, Ting Ting, Duan Hui, and Hang Yihong. He did not meet the two women directly but sent them a voice transmission asking them to go to the Xian capital after they completed the mission.

"Oh?" Han Yuanzhi was surprised when Zhang Fei suddenly appeared in front of him. "I didn't expect you to have such amazing abilities, and I couldn't detect your presence before you appeared. What brought you here all of a sudden? Are you ready to open your shop and restaurant in this kingdom?"
Zhang Fei simply smiled and returned the question. "Do you know a good cook?"
"Yes." Han Yuanzhi immediately called someone to meet them. "The chef I know doesn't know your dishes, so you have to teach her to cook them before she can work for you."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I will take her to my restaurant in the Xian capital, and Zhu Yan can teach her about our dishes."
"I think that's a great idea." Han Yuanzhi then asked again. "What about your shop? Are you in need of assistance?"
"No need." Zhang Fei immediately refused. "I already have some people for my shop, and I'll bring them here when I'm ready to open it."

Before long, a woman in her thirties walked up to them, and Han Yuanzhi immediately introduced her to Zhang Fei. "Han Bingxing is my niece, and her cooking is delicious, even though her dishes are not comparable to the ones in your restaurant. She wants to learn how to cook your dishes, so I'll let her work with you."

'This old woman! She deliberately sent her niece to me with hidden intentions.' Zhang Fei then watched Han Bingxing for a moment. "I will take her away now so she can learn our dishes faster, and I will open my restaurant once she is ready."
'Does this kid not like Bingxing?' Han Yuanzhi then spoke to her niece. "You can pack first."
"Yes, Auntie."
After Han Bingxing left, Han Yuanzhi asked Zhang Fei. "How about you spend the night here today?"
"I can't do it." Han Yuazhi appeared disheartened due to Zhang Fei's second rejection. "I will marry Xian Xianqin tomorrow, so I have to return to my residence today."
"I see." Han Yuanzhi nodded in understanding. "If that's the case, I won't force you to stay. I hope you can make the time to talk to me, and we can have a better relationship in the future."
"Sure."
