Since the two women's subordinates would take care of everything for him, he just had to wait and take the goods from those warehouses when they were ready.
Since Zhang Fei [5] was impatient to have the two women from the winged race as his wives, he intended to meet Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianzhi at their apartment in Paris.
However, he couldn't find them anywhere, and he guessed that they had returned to the Tian Realm, so he decided to return to the Nine Stars Realm.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] stood above the sky in the Bai Kingdom, and he found that members of the Han Clan had finished renovating his building.
"This way, my fourth shop and restaurant are ready to open, but I have to wait for the stock of goods on Earth, or I won't be able to meet the market demand in this kingdom.
Moreover, I still don't have a chef for my restaurant here, so I must postpone the opening of both for a few days."
Zhang Fei [5] then checked the Han Clan on his map and found Han Yuanzhi talking to some people.
Instead of meeting her, he went to see Huan Ya at the Bai royal palace.
Wushuang became tense as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of her and Huan Ya, but he paid no attention to her.
"Wei Chou sent Qu Qiuxue to this kingdom to look for you, and she will arrive in three days."
"Hmm?" Huan Ya was surprised about that.
"What does Wei Chou want from me?
He asked others to contact me and force me to meet him, and he is now sending Qu Qiuxue after I refused to return."
"What else?
Wei Chou and Qu Qiuxue have a special relationship, and he seems to want you to be his woman." Zhang Fei [5] then gave the Heart Rupturing Pill to Huan Ya.
"I don't need the two of them so you can capture the woman and force her to swallow it, but you can let her go after that."
"What is the effect of this pill?" Zhang Fei [5] promptly informed Huan Ya, causing Wushuang, who was standing next to them, to shiver in fear.
"Hehe!
You are truly wicked, Master.
Qu Qiuxue will suffer after she swallows this pill, and she won't be able to do anything to neutralize it."
Zhang Fei [5] then pointed at Wushuang.
"You won't be able to beat Qu Qiuxue, but she can do it, so let her help you."
Huan Ya nodded and then asked.
"Do you want to have fun with Wushuang, Master?"
"She is only a pawn to face Li Tiannan." Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused.
"Report to me if Huangfu Shou gives Wushuang any orders."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Huan Ya turned to Wushuang.
"Do you understand now?
Huangfu Shou and Li Tiannan may be vicious, but my master is much more vicious than them.
If you don't want to suffer, you'd better carry out your duties properly."
Wushuang clenched her fists tightly without saying anything, and Huan Ya hurriedly left her. 'Damn it!
What can I do to tell Master Tiannan about that man?'
When it was late at night, all the women in the three kingdoms immediately closed their shops and restaurants.
They returned to their residences through the teleportation devices installed in the three shops.
Although the results were not as outstanding as in the Xian Kingdom, Zhang Fei [5] was still satisfied with the results of opening the two restaurants and shops in the Yun and Natural Races Kingdoms.
Furthermore, he acquired a wide variety of herbs from the natural races, many of which were not yet available at the Sealed World Pearl.
After spending some time with everyone, Zhang Fei [5] sent them to the training space to practice and cultivate.
However, Zhang Fei was in seclusion at the Guo Clan's lightning pond together with Yun Xinyue, Zhong Yan, and Angela.
Liu Qingyu and his other women did manual cultivation in the Cloud Mansion.
Zhang Fei [5] first took Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu to the Sealed World Pearl, where they planted herbs and herb seeds.
He then asked the two Dryads to join Liu Hua and the others, but he asked Shi Wu to join Xian Xianqin and the others to train because she still hadn't adapted to two times gravity.
Additionally, he asked Shang Yumei to join the others in the training space, starting her training from the basics.
Zhang Fei [5] then accompanied Hong Yao and the six women from Earth to look around the many areas around the residence.
Although they could not have sex with him because he was a clone, they were still pleased that he took the time to accompany them.
Feltia [2] did not bring Fyr and the other female demons back to the portable mansion, and she let them train on the demon island for the next few days.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] focused on his partners, and Zhang Fei [4] focused on alchemy.
With Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin gone, Zhang Xiaolong [3] enjoyed his time with Wu Lianzhi and Shang Xinyu, and he repeatedly teased Shang Yifen.
After this day, nothing significant occurred for the next two days, and they carried out their respective activities in the three kingdoms without any disturbance.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
Since he was going to marry Xian Xianqin tomorrow, Zhang Fei decided to use his fifth clone to replace him at the Guo Clan's lightning pond.
He detected ill intentions from some of the clan members, so he couldn't possibly leave Zhong Yan and Angela there unguarded.
Despite Yun Xinyue's status as the princess and a prominent member of the Guo Clan, Zhang Fei doubted her ability to prevent her clan members from harming Zhong Yan and Angela.

Zhang Fei's worries were unfounded, as Guo Xuehua had already firmly threatened the Guo Clan members to severely punish anyone who dared to disturb Zhong Yan and Angela, even if it meant crippling their cultivation.

Due to her high cultivation, Shang Yumei's progress was the most significant compared to that of people from the Sky Jade Realm, like the Hai Twins and others, or the Nine Stars Realm, like Zhou Shenxin and others.
In just a few days of training in the training space, Shang Yumei had almost adapted to two times gravity, and Zhang Fei was confident that she could fully adapt in the next few days.
Zhang Fei, who had been neglecting his official wives for the past three days due to his seclusion, decided to accompany all of them first, leading to an orgy that lasted until dawn.
In the morning, Zhang Fei brought them all out of the training space, except for Shang Yumei, Ling Long, Zhou Shenxin, and several cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm.
Before Zhang Fei took them out, Feng Yao informed him that the Alchemy Union sent Nanfeng Yunxi specially to meet him, and she would arrive in their realm in a week.
Qian Ying decided to stop practicing because Xian Xianqin was going to marry Zhang Fei soon, and she wanted to help her best friend make the final preparations before their wedding.
Once they finished their breakfast, each went immediately to their respective activities.
Zhang Fei brought Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying to the Xian royal palace, especially since Shi Qingzhuang was waiting for them.
Qian Ying felt awkward and afraid of meeting Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang again after several decades.
Furthermore, she had transformed into a demon, and the Xian emperor was well-known to dislike demons.
However, her worries disappeared immediately, especially since both of them welcomed her warmly.
Shi Qingzhuang then took Xian Xianqin and Qian Ying away so her daughter could try on her wedding dress.
She also ordered several female servants to help Zhang Fei try on his wedding attire, which looked luxurious and in accordance with the customs of the Xian kingdom.
While trying on his wedding attire, Zhang Fei monitored the system map, and he found that Qu Qiuxue had already arrived at the Bai Kingdom.
However, Wushuang immediately moved to capture Qu Qiuxue.
After Huan Ya forced her to swallow the Heart Rupture Pill, she took her away from the kingdom and left her in a distant village.
Since Shi Qingzhuang still needed Xian Xianqin for some other things, Zhang Fei left her and Qian Ying in the Xian royal palace.
He then went to Earth and took all the items already available in the warehouses.
He immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm to distribute them to Zhang Lingxue, Tang Zhiyu, and Lillea.
After that, Zhang Fei met Xin Yanluo on the edge of the demon island.
She told him that the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan had not yet appeared, and she could not find their whereabouts either.

Zhang Fei immediately checked the Zheng Clan through the system map, but he couldn't find the three old demons, which convinced him that they were hiding in a special place covered by a concealment formation.
Next, Zhang Fei checked the Ximen Demon Kingdom, and he found Ximen Gui standing guard not far from Ximen Yueliang's room.
Additionally, he discovered several powerful demons from the Nu Clan surrounding Ximen Yueliang's room.

'Ximen Changtian and Nu Huangjin should have known about the Zheng Clan, and they were worried that the clan would capture their daughter, so they assigned that old demon specifically to protect her.' Zhang Fei then looked far away as his eyes fell on the map. 'Zhou Xiaochuan will arrive here tonight, but he is still unaware of his situation.
Ximen Chuixue and the others have infiltrated deeper into his kingdom, and they managed to capture some of his subordinates.
He will definitely wait for Zhou Shenxin and Zhou Hanling before making his move, but I won't send them both to him, and they probably won't dare to go against Ximen Gui.'
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, so he immediately went to their sect.
However, they were on a mission with Ning Wu, Ting Ting, Duan Hui, and Hang Yihong.
He did not meet the two women directly but sent them a voice transmission asking them to go to the Xian capital after they completed the mission.
"Oh?" Han Yuanzhi was surprised when Zhang Fei suddenly appeared in front of him.
"I didn't expect you to have such amazing abilities, and I couldn't detect your presence before you appeared.
What brought you here all of a sudden?
Are you ready to open your shop and restaurant in this kingdom?"
Zhang Fei simply smiled and returned the question.
"Do you know a good cook?"
"Yes." Han Yuanzhi immediately called someone to meet them.
"The chef I know doesn't know your dishes, so you have to teach her to cook them before she can work for you."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I will take her to my restaurant in the Xian capital, and Zhu Yan can teach her about our dishes."
"I think that's a great idea." Han Yuanzhi then asked again.
"What about your shop?
Are you in need of assistance?"
"No need." Zhang Fei immediately refused.
"I already have some people for my shop, and I'll bring them here when I'm ready to open it."
Before long, a woman in her thirties walked up to them, and Han Yuanzhi immediately introduced her to Zhang Fei.
"Han Bingxing is my niece, and her cooking is delicious, even though her dishes are not comparable to the ones in your restaurant.
She wants to learn how to cook your dishes, so I'll let her work with you."
'This old woman!
She deliberately sent her niece to me with hidden intentions.' Zhang Fei then watched Han Bingxing for a moment.
"I will take her away now so she can learn our dishes faster, and I will open my restaurant once she is ready."
'Does this kid not like Bingxing?' Han Yuanzhi then spoke to her niece.
"You can pack first."
"Yes, Auntie."
After Han Bingxing left, Han Yuanzhi asked Zhang Fei.
"How about you spend the night here today?"
"I can't do it." Han Yuazhi appeared disheartened due to Zhang Fei's second rejection.
"I will marry Xian Xianqin tomorrow, so I have to return to my residence today."
"I see." Han Yuanzhi nodded in understanding.
"If that's the case, I won't force you to stay.
I hope you can make the time to talk to me, and we can have a better relationship in the future."
"Sure."

chapters.title: Chapter 680 Han Yuanzhi's Suspicion
paragraphs: After Han Bingxing finished packing, Zhang Fei took her away from the Han Clan, leaving Han Yuanzhi disappointed.
*Tap... Tap...*
Four people approached Han Yuanzhi: a middle-aged man, a middle-aged woman, a young man, and another young woman.
"Big Sis, why did you send my daughter to that kid?" The middle-aged man asked her.
The middle-aged woman also asked. "Can you tell me your reason for doing so, sister-in-law?"
The young man and young woman looked at Han Yuanzhi with a questioning look. 'What exactly was our mother thinking when she handed Han Bingxing over to an unknown man?'

"I know you guys will question my decision, but I am doing this for the future of our Han Clan." Han Yuanzhi then turned to face them. "Have you ever heard of a man having relationships with the princesses of the five kingdoms, Han Zhimin and Jiao Jingyu?"
"Huh?" Han Yuanzhi's question surprised the four of them.

"I can't believe he has relationships with those five princesses, considering the relationship between kingdoms is too chaotic, except for the Xian and Yun Kingdoms." The young man expressed his disbelief by shaking his head.
The young woman then asked. "Mother-in-law, does that man really have a relationship with them?"
"Do I need to lie to all of you, Han Yuanwen and Fang Xuanling?" The four were at a loss for words to answer Han Yuanzhi. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he will marry Princess Xian Xianqin tomorrow."
"Eh?" The news shocked them.

Han Yuanzhi then continued. "Zhang Fei also has a relationship with Princess Yun Xinyue, and they entered into seclusion together in the Guo Clan in recent days. Five days ago, he came here with Princess Zhou Shenxin, and Ling Long was also with them."

The four people were even more shocked when they heard the names Yun Xinyue and Zhou Shenxin from Han Yuanzhi's mouth, but they were confused when they heard the third woman's name. "Ling Long is Prince Huangfu Lian's fiancée, right? How could she be with Zhang Fei?"

"I don't know, but I can see that their relationship is quite intimate." Han Yuanzhi's statement caused the four people to exchange confused glances. "I've heard about that kid from Bai Shushi before, and she told me that her daughter, Bai Tian'er, had fallen in love with him. They went to the Star Tower together some time ago, and they managed to get past the first floor. Regrettably, he did not reciprocate her feelings, and his repeated rejection left her heartbroken. By the way, Princess Bai Shouyi and her siblings disappeared after the Star Tower, and I suspect that he hid them somewhere else."

The four had heard about Bai Shouyi, Bai Chongxi, and Bai Renfu's disappearance. However, they found it difficult to believe that Zhang Fei was hiding them, especially since their parents were under Huangfu Shou's control. If he were to protect them, it would be no different from looking for trouble with the Huangfu Emperor.

They suddenly remembered Ling Long by Zhang Fei's side, which instantly changed their previous opinions. After all, she was Huangfu Lian's fiancée, but she was traveling with another man, and they had never heard the Huangfu Prince make a fuss about their relationship.

A white owl beast suddenly flew towards them and perched on Han Yuanzhi's shoulder. "Master, your guess is correct. Zhang Fei took Linghu Yincheng away and placed a woman named Hua Ya in the Bai royal palace to monitor the situation. Additionally, he enslaved Huangfu Shou's subordinate, Wushuang, whom the evil emperor used to control Bai Yuwen and his wife."
"Are you serious about that, Xiao Bai?" Han Zhimin asked in shock.

Xiao Bai nodded. "I heard Zhang Fei's conversation with Huan Ya with my ears, so I can't be wrong. I heard them mention a man named Li Tiannan, but I didn't get much information about him, and I guessed that he was the person behind Huangfu Shou."

"What else did you hear?" Xiao Bai shared several details with Han Yuanzhi and the others, including information about the members of the Alchemy Union in the Yun Kingdom. "Lian Jinshu was their representative in the Xian Kingdom, but they suddenly decided to withdraw from the kingdom. Not long after that, Zhang Fei opened the Sky Jade Shop in their former shop, and he sold many pills with extraordinary effects, which made me believe that he was the mastermind behind their decisions."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei deliberately used you and the others to kill Lian Jinshu and his friends, sister-in-law?" Jiao Jingyu inquired.

"Yes." Han Yuanzhi replied with an affirmative nod. "From the beginning, I harbored suspicions about Zhang Fei due to his abrupt arrival in our clan, which occurred just two days after we had killed Lian Jinshu and the others. His problem with the Alchemy Union in the Xian and Yun Kingdoms has proven that he is using us to get rid of them, and he plundered the warehouse of their organization in our kingdom. Given his actions against Qu Qiuxue, I am confident that their organization in the Yun Kingdom will soon vanish as well, and he will gain control over the alchemy market across three kingdoms."
All of them were shocked to the point of speechlessness, especially since Zhang Fei's actions were too terrifying, and no one had noticed his actions before.
"How could he do all that, mother-in-law?" Fang Xuanling asked again.

"I don't know how Zhang Fei could do all that, but we should not stand against him, especially since it will only harm our Han, Fang, and Jiao clans. Instead, we should establish a positive relationship with him. I chose Han Bingxing as our intermediary due to her gentle and kind nature." Han Yuanzhi then spoke to the owl beast. "Xiao Bai, please return to the Bai royal palace and keep an eye on the two women. You must report to me again if there is any change in the situation."
"Yes, Master." After Xiao Bai flew away, Han Yuanzhi also left the four people, who were still wondering about Zhang Fei.
Jiao Jingyu then asked her husband, Han Zhimin. "Do you think our daughter will be okay? I'm afraid Zhang Fei will do something awful to her, so I think we should send someone to protect her."
"No need." Han Zhimin refused with a shake of his head. "Our daughter is a kind and gentle woman, and she will never offend Zhang Fei, so I'm sure she will be fine."
"I hope so." Jiao Jingyu replied with a soft sigh before leaving with her husband. Han Yuanwen also brought his wife, Fang Xuanling, back to their private quarters.

After they arrived in the Xian capital, Zhang Fei immediately took the shocked Han Bingxing to the Sky Jade Restaurant. He asked Zhu Yan to teach her how to cook their dishes, especially since she would be the chef of his fourth restaurant.
Han Bingxing did not ask Zhang Fei anything, and she followed Zhu Yan, who led her to the kitchen.

Zhang Fei continued to wonder why Han Yuanzhi had sent her niece to him, but he showed no interest in Han Bingxing. He then went to the second floor to meet Liu Hua and the Wen Twins. 'Open the two medium gift packs, Mei.'
[You obtained a Spirit Merchant Token.]
[You obtained a Universal Key.]
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before taking the two items.
[Spirit Merchant Token: A pass to trade with mysterious merchants who appear only in the Forgotten Land.]
[Universal Key: A key that fits into many locks, but its true purpose is unknown.]
'The Forbidden Land? Do you have any information about it, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, the system does not have any information about that location, Master. You can try asking Feng Yao first, but if she doesn't know about it, I think it might be located in those realms.]

Zhang Fei nodded before observing the black key in his hand, but he then took out the old map fragment. 'A key that fits all locks, but its purpose is unclear. The other one is a fragment of a mysterious map, but we have no information about the Temple of Forgotten Flames. Do you think this key has any connection to that place?'
[These two may be related to each other, Master. However, we need to find the other five map fragments first to be sure, but I don't have any clues about their locations.]
Zhang Fei stored both of them in the system inventory again. "Hua'er, you can choose five other members from the Demon Fox Group, and I will prepare them for our new shop in the Bai Kingdom."

"Haha." Liu Hua softly laughed in response. She pulled Zhang Fei to a chair, then climbed onto his lap and gave him a warm hug. "I have already chosen the best five among the rest, so you can bring them to the Bai Kingdom when everything is ready. You've appointed Han Bingxing as the cook, but you haven't yet selected someone to manage the shop, correct? What do you think if I go to that kingdom? Wushuang is your slave, and she can protect me with her high cultivation. Moreover, you will install the teleportation device, so I think we don't need to be too afraid of Huangfu Shou."

"I think it's fine if you want to go there to manage our shop and organization." Zhang Fei then turned to Wen Yuan and Wen Xuan. "They have mastered the Vanishing Mirage Steps and are no less powerful than you, making them sufficient to manage our organization here. Once Qian Ying adapts to the first level of gravity, I will let her help them."
"Leave the matters here to us." The Wen Twins answered in unison.
After he accompanied the three women, Zhang Fei left his restaurant for his shop. 'What are the level 3 Beast features?'
[I will show them to you, Master.]
1. Soul Connect III: By using it, the master can increase his power by 100% of the beast's power, and vice versa.
2. Mind Connect: The Master can see and hear what beasts see and hear, and both can communicate with each other from great distances.

3. Beast Space II: A special space for beasts. If the beasts stay in it, they can recover their qi quickly, and all the wounds they suffered during battle can also heal very quickly. Time flow: 2 times faster. Affect their lifespans.
4. Soul Link: Similar to Soul Connect, the host can borrow the power of all the beasts in the Beast Space. The greater the number of beasts, the higher the power that the host can borrow.
5. Beast Sanctuary I: Increase the speed of the recovery process by two-fold.

Zhang Fei was taken aback for a moment. 'I believed Soul Connect III to be the final stage, especially since it enables me to harness the full power of my beasts. The beast sanctuary will also prove beneficial to me, given that I am a beast myself. Are there any new beast pills?'
[Unfortunately, the beast shop hasn't changed, master.]
Zhang Fei was a little disappointed by that, but he didn't think too much about it, especially since all the beast contracts had already become quite strong thanks to the previous six pills.

Since Shi Qingzhuang forbade him from seeing Xian Xianqin before their wedding tomorrow, and all his wives were busy with their three shops and restaurants, Zhang Fei chose to visit Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou.

Zhang Fei discussed formation arrays and blacksmithing with them for quite some time. After leaving their shop, he went to Duan Zhao's residence and discussed the latest design of the weapon he had requested.
However, both Zhang Fei and Duan Zhao were not satisfied with the design, so the old blacksmith decided to redesign the weapon.

A few minutes later, Zhang Fei arrived at the Yun royal capital. For quite some time, he accompanied his wives, who handled their shop and restaurant there. The Yun Kingdom was smaller than the Xian Kingdom, so shoppers and diners were few.
Fortunately, the Yun Kingdom directly borders the Zhou Kingdom, and many people from that kingdom visit Zhang Fei's shop and restaurant, making both quite lively.
Afterward, Zhang Fei went to his shop and restaurant in the Natural Race Kingdom, and both were much busier than those in the Yun Kingdom.
"Zhang Fei!"
Zhang Fei looked at Xin Xianzi and Zefyr, who were flying toward him at high speed. Both women immediately sat on his shoulders. "Why are you two in such a hurry?"
"Hahaha." Xin Xianzi laughed before answering him. "After waiting for you for days, I wanted to take you to my race's forest."
Zefyr also answered Zhang Fei. "That place is much more beautiful than the Fairy Forest in the Sky Jade Realm, and I really want to stay there forever."
Curious about it, Zhang Fei immediately agreed with them. "All right, you can lead me there, Xianzi."
"Where are you three going?" Xian Jinglan, who had just arrived with Lang, inquired immediately.
"Jinglan! I will take Zhang Fei to our forest, so you should come with us." Xin Xianzi then gestured toward the distance. "The entrance to our forest is about 10 miles that way."
Zhang Fei then led the two women there. "Do you want to join us, Princess Jinglan?"
"Sure." As soon as Xian Jinglan agreed, Lang immediately walked beside Zhang Fei. "I haven't been there in a while, especially the Fairy Glades."
"What is the Fairy Glades?" Zhang Fei inquired.

Xin Xianzi immediately told Zhang Fei. "The Fairy Glades is actually no different from an ordinary plain, but it is the best place to listen to the whispers of nature, and we natural races often go there to seek guidance from nature. Since you are a heavenly fox, I believe you can hear those whispers, and you might be able to gain some guidance in your cultivation path. Apart from that place, we still have the fairy fountain, the fairy shrine, and the spiritual herb gardens."

"Oh? What are the functions of the Fairy Fountain and the Fairy Shrine?" However, Zhang Fei was more interested in the spiritual herb gardens, especially since spiritual herbs were different from ordinary herbs, and their effects were much more potent. Unfortunately, their prices were exorbitant, and they were scarce.

"All cultivators, including you, must have swallowed pills to remove impurities from our bodies." Zhang Fei nodded to Xin Xianzi. "Even though we have swallowed them before, our impurities have not been completely clean, and the celestial water in the Fairy Fountain will completely cleanse them not only from our bodies but also our souls. The water will also help us heal our injuries, both external and internal. Additionally, you can soak there to seek enlightenment from the fairy ancestors, and you will get a fairy blessing if they accept you."
"Fairy ancestors?" That shocked Zhang Fei.

"When natural races like us die, our bodies will be destroyed, but our souls will return to nature." Zhang Fei turned to Xian Jinglan directly. "The fairy ancestors are fairies who died thousands of years ago, but their souls still live in the Fairy Fountain. Although their memories have faded, their souls retain all their experiences, and they will assist anyone with a pure heart."
"Hahaha. I suppose my heart is not pure and too dark to meet the fairy ancestors," Zhang Fei said with a bitter laugh. "What about the fairy shrine?"

Xin Xianzi informed him. "Only fairies can enter the Fairy Shrine, and it is a testing ground for us when we first awaken our abilities. If we have a dirty heart, we will not be able to pass all the tests inside, and we will die inside. If we succeed in passing all the tests, we will receive the blessings of nature, which will become our strength."
"Did you go through those processes too, Zefyr?"
Zefyr shook her head. "When I was born, I already had my abilities."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and enveloped them with his aura. "Let's go there now; I'm curious about that place."

Not long after that, Zhang Fei opened the Sky Jade Shop in their former shop, and he sold many pills with extraordinary effects, which made me believe that he was the mastermind behind their decisions."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei deliberately used you and the others to kill Lian Jinshu and his friends, sister-in-law?" Jiao Jingyu inquired.
"Yes." Han Yuanzhi replied with an affirmative nod.
"From the beginning, I harbored suspicions about Zhang Fei due to his abrupt arrival in our clan, which occurred just two days after we had killed Lian Jinshu and the others.
His problem with the Alchemy Union in the Xian and Yun Kingdoms has proven that he is using us to get rid of them, and he plundered the warehouse of their organization in our kingdom.
Given his actions against Qu Qiuxue, I am confident that their organization in the Yun Kingdom will soon vanish as well, and he will gain control over the alchemy market across three kingdoms."
All of them were shocked to the point of speechlessness, especially since Zhang Fei's actions were too terrifying, and no one had noticed his actions before.
"How could he do all that, mother-in-law?" Fang Xuanling asked again.
"I don't know how Zhang Fei could do all that, but we should not stand against him, especially since it will only harm our Han, Fang, and Jiao clans.
Instead, we should establish a positive relationship with him.
I chose Han Bingxing as our intermediary due to her gentle and kind nature." Han Yuanzhi then spoke to the owl beast.
"Xiao Bai, please return to the Bai royal palace and keep an eye on the two women.
You must report to me again if there is any change in the situation."
"Yes, Master." After Xiao Bai flew away, Han Yuanzhi also left the four people, who were still wondering about Zhang Fei.
Jiao Jingyu then asked her husband, Han Zhimin.
"Do you think our daughter will be okay?
I'm afraid Zhang Fei will do something awful to her, so I think we should send someone to protect her."
"No need." Han Zhimin refused with a shake of his head.
"Our daughter is a kind and gentle woman, and she will never offend Zhang Fei, so I'm sure she will be fine."
"I hope so." Jiao Jingyu replied with a soft sigh before leaving with her husband.
Han Yuanwen also brought his wife, Fang Xuanling, back to their private quarters.
After they arrived in the Xian capital, Zhang Fei immediately took the shocked Han Bingxing to the Sky Jade Restaurant.
He asked Zhu Yan to teach her how to cook their dishes, especially since she would be the chef of his fourth restaurant.
Han Bingxing did not ask Zhang Fei anything, and she followed Zhu Yan, who led her to the kitchen.
Zhang Fei continued to wonder why Han Yuanzhi had sent her niece to him, but he showed no interest in Han Bingxing.
He then went to the second floor to meet Liu Hua and the Wen Twins. 'Open the two medium gift packs, Mei.'
[You obtained a Spirit Merchant Token.]
[You obtained a Universal Key.]
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before taking the two items.
[Spirit Merchant Token: A pass to trade with mysterious merchants who appear only in the Forgotten Land.]
[Universal Key: A key that fits into many locks, but its true purpose is unknown.]
'The Forbidden Land?
Do you have any information about it, Mei?'
[Unfortunately, the system does not have any information about that location, Master.
You can try asking Feng Yao first, but if she doesn't know about it, I think it might be located in those realms.]
Zhang Fei nodded before observing the black key in his hand, but he then took out the old map fragment. 'A key that fits all locks, but its purpose is unclear.
The other one is a fragment of a mysterious map, but we have no information about the Temple of Forgotten Flames.
Do you think this key has any connection to that place?'
[These two may be related to each other, Master.
However, we need to find the other five map fragments first to be sure, but I don't have any clues about their locations.]
Zhang Fei stored both of them in the system inventory again.
"Hua'er, you can choose five other members from the Demon Fox Group, and I will prepare them for our new shop in the Bai Kingdom."
"Haha." Liu Hua softly laughed in response.
She pulled Zhang Fei to a chair, then climbed onto his lap and gave him a warm hug.
"I have already chosen the best five among the rest, so you can bring them to the Bai Kingdom when everything is ready.
You've appointed Han Bingxing as the cook, but you haven't yet selected someone to manage the shop, correct?
What do you think if I go to that kingdom?
Wushuang is your slave, and she can protect me with her high cultivation.
Moreover, you will install the teleportation device, so I think we don't need to be too afraid of Huangfu Shou."
"I think it's fine if you want to go there to manage our shop and organization." Zhang Fei then turned to Wen Yuan and Wen Xuan.
"They have mastered the Vanishing Mirage Steps and are no less powerful than you, making them sufficient to manage our organization here.
Once Qian Ying adapts to the first level of gravity, I will let her help them."
"Leave the matters here to us." The Wen Twins answered in unison.
After he accompanied the three women, Zhang Fei left his restaurant for his shop. 'What are the level 3 Beast features?'
[I will show them to you, Master.]
Soul Connect III: By using it, the master can increase his power by 100% of the beast's power, and vice versa.
Mind Connect: The Master can see and hear what beasts see and hear, and both can communicate with each other from great distances.
Beast Space II: A special space for beasts.
If the beasts stay in it, they can recover their qi quickly, and all the wounds they suffered during battle can also heal very quickly.
Time flow: 2 times faster.
Affect their lifespans.
Soul Link: Similar to Soul Connect, the host can borrow the power of all the beasts in the Beast Space.
The greater the number of beasts, the higher the power that the host can borrow.
Beast Sanctuary I: Increase the speed of the recovery process by two-fold.
Zhang Fei was taken aback for a moment. 'I believed Soul Connect III to be the final stage, especially since it enables me to harness the full power of my beasts.
The beast sanctuary will also prove beneficial to me, given that I am a beast myself.
Are there any new beast pills?'
[Unfortunately, the beast shop hasn't changed, master.]
Zhang Fei was a little disappointed by that, but he didn't think too much about it, especially since all the beast contracts had already become quite strong thanks to the previous six pills.

Since Shi Qingzhuang forbade him from seeing Xian Xianqin before their wedding tomorrow, and all his wives were busy with their three shops and restaurants, Zhang Fei chose to visit Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou.
Zhang Fei discussed formation arrays and blacksmithing with them for quite some time.
After leaving their shop, he went to Duan Zhao's residence and discussed the latest design of the weapon he had requested.
However, both Zhang Fei and Duan Zhao were not satisfied with the design, so the old blacksmith decided to redesign the weapon.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei arrived at the Yun royal capital.
For quite some time, he accompanied his wives, who handled their shop and restaurant there.
The Yun Kingdom was smaller than the Xian Kingdom, so shoppers and diners were few.
Fortunately, the Yun Kingdom directly borders the Zhou Kingdom, and many people from that kingdom visit Zhang Fei's shop and restaurant, making both quite lively.
Afterward, Zhang Fei went to his shop and restaurant in the Natural Race Kingdom, and both were much busier than those in the Yun Kingdom.
"Zhang Fei!"
Zhang Fei looked at Xin Xianzi and Zefyr, who were flying toward him at high speed.
Both women immediately sat on his shoulders.
"Why are you two in such a hurry?"
"Hahaha." Xin Xianzi laughed before answering him.
"After waiting for you for days, I wanted to take you to my race's forest."
Zefyr also answered Zhang Fei.
"That place is much more beautiful than the Fairy Forest in the Sky Jade Realm, and I really want to stay there forever."
Curious about it, Zhang Fei immediately agreed with them.
"All right, you can lead me there, Xianzi."
"Where are you three going?" Xian Jinglan, who had just arrived with Lang, inquired immediately.
"Jinglan!
I will take Zhang Fei to our forest, so you should come with us." Xin Xianzi then gestured toward the distance.
"The entrance to our forest is about 10 miles that way."
Zhang Fei then led the two women there.
"Do you want to join us, Princess Jinglan?"
"Sure." As soon as Xian Jinglan agreed, Lang immediately walked beside Zhang Fei.
"I haven't been there in a while, especially the Fairy Glades."
"What is the Fairy Glades?" Zhang Fei inquired.
Xin Xianzi immediately told Zhang Fei.
"The Fairy Glades is actually no different from an ordinary plain, but it is the best place to listen to the whispers of nature, and we natural races often go there to seek guidance from nature.
Since you are a heavenly fox, I believe you can hear those whispers, and you might be able to gain some guidance in your cultivation path.
Apart from that place, we still have the fairy fountain, the fairy shrine, and the spiritual herb gardens."
"Oh?

What are the functions of the Fairy Fountain and the Fairy Shrine?" However, Zhang Fei was more interested in the spiritual herb gardens, especially since spiritual herbs were different from ordinary herbs, and their effects were much more potent.
Unfortunately, their prices were exorbitant, and they were scarce.
"All cultivators, including you, must have swallowed pills to remove impurities from our bodies." Zhang Fei nodded to Xin Xianzi.

"Even though we have swallowed them before, our impurities have not been completely clean, and the celestial water in the Fairy Fountain will completely cleanse them not only from our bodies but also our souls.
The water will also help us heal our injuries, both external and internal.
Additionally, you can soak there to seek enlightenment from the fairy ancestors, and you will get a fairy blessing if they accept you."
"Fairy ancestors?" That shocked Zhang Fei.
"When natural races like us die, our bodies will be destroyed, but our souls will return to nature." Zhang Fei turned to Xian Jinglan directly.
"The fairy ancestors are fairies who died thousands of years ago, but their souls still live in the Fairy Fountain.
Although their memories have faded, their souls retain all their experiences, and they will assist anyone with a pure heart."
"Hahaha.
I suppose my heart is not pure and too dark to meet the fairy ancestors," Zhang Fei said with a bitter laugh.
"What about the fairy shrine?"
Xin Xianzi informed him.
"Only fairies can enter the Fairy Shrine, and it is a testing ground for us when we first awaken our abilities.
If we have a dirty heart, we will not be able to pass all the tests inside, and we will die inside.
If we succeed in passing all the tests, we will receive the blessings of nature, which will become our strength."
"Did you go through those processes too, Zefyr?"
Zefyr shook her head.
"When I was born, I already had my abilities."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and enveloped them with his aura.
"Let's go there now; I'm curious about that place."

chapters.title: Chapter 681 Intermediate Wind Law
paragraphs: Similar to the fairy forest in the Sky Jade Realm, Zhang Fei and the others had to pass through many tree formations to enter the fairy forest in the Nine Stars Realm. However, due to the difference in quality between the two realms, those formations were much more complicated and stronger.

A while later, they arrived inside the fairy forest. As Zefyr had told him before, Zhang Fei also felt that the place was much more beautiful than the one in the Sky Jade Realm. Countless small wooden houses were scattered neatly, and several small rivers flowed across several areas with sparkling clear green water; even small aquatic beasts swam happily in it. Various types of colorful flower plants, fruit trees, and spiritual herbs grow abundantly across the area. "I've seen many realms, but this forest is the most beautiful."

"Hehehe." Xin Xianzi laughed as she floated in front of Zhang Fei's face, placing her two small hands on his waist. "Are you interested in staying here? Unfortunately, you cannot bring the people by your side here, especially those female demons. Though they may not harm humans, my race will harm demons."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I like this forest, but I have no intention of staying here. I will definitely visit again if I have free time, and I will spend a few days here."
"Yay! That's great!" Xin Xianzi cheered excitedly.
*Zap... Zap...*

A bolt of lightning suddenly struck the ground in front of them, and a female fairy with long purple hair appeared in front of them. Despite her tiny form, her oval face looks mature and alluring, and her figure is quite sexy in her purple sleeveless dress. She has two purple eyes, thin lips covered in purple, D-cup breasts, a slim waist, and wide but big hips. "I have been waiting for you to come, Zhang Fei. Although you do not have the lightning element, I can feel that the lightning inside your body is thick. If my guess is accurate, one of your clones is training in the Guo Clan's lightning pond, and one of your goals in coming to this realm is to go to Cyanwood Mountain."

"Zhang Fei, she is the leader of our fairy race, Big Sis Lei Ting." Xin Xianzi introduced them. "Her lightning element has reached the peak rank, and her understanding of the lightning elemental law has reached the half-perfection stage, so her understanding is already close to perfection."

Xin Xianzi actually didn't need to say all that, especially since Mei had already displayed Lei Ting's data to Zhang Fei. Her cultivation was on par with Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. "You're right about both."

Lei Ting released a soft sigh. "Unfortunately, you will never be able to go to Cyanwood Mountain without the lightning element. Even if you have it and master the lightning elemental law, you will never be able to get there."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei inquired with a relaxed smile. "I know you're saying that for my good, but you don't know anything about me or all the stories I've been through to reach this stage. I may not be able to go to Cyanwood Mountain now, but I will definitely go there in the future, and I will prove to all of you that I can conquer its peak."
"How can you be so confident?" Lei Ting curiously asked.

Zhang Fei shook his head at Lei Ting. "We just met today, so I won't tell you my secrets. However, I can tell you that I used to be an ordinary human born in a world without Qi, and I never knew that cultivators and cultivation worlds existed. Since I started my cultivation path, eight months have passed, and I have been living in this realm, which is located in the middle realms."
"Eight... eight months?" Lei Ting stuttered.

Zhang Fei's confession also shocked Xin Xianzi, Xian Jinglan, and Lang. All this time, they thought he had been cultivating for several years, and his cultivation speed was already extremely fast, considering he was only 20 years old. However, he said that he had only cultivated for eight months, which made his cultivation speed too absurd and defied common sense.
Zhang Fei remained relaxed, observing their reactions. "That's right, eight months. Can any of you reach my level in eight months?"
"You... you..." Xin Xianzi stuttered as she pointed at Zhang Fei's face. "You are too absurd! It took me ten years to reach the Earth Realm, yet you achieved it in just eight months."

Xian Jinglan agreed with Xin Xianzi. "All this time, people have always called me a genius, but your rapid cultivation speed made me feel that their praise was overly exaggerated. In this kingdom, there are countless experienced dual cultivators, many of whom have many wives like you, but none of them can reach that level as quickly as you."

"Princess Jinglan, I wouldn't dare to claim that I am superior to other dual cultivators, especially considering the numerous advantages I possess over them." Xian Jinglan and the two women looked at Zhang Fei with curious gazes. "You guys already know my three identities, right? My three identities are my main advantage, and you can say that I am similar to three cultivators in one body. My human form is my main identity, and it holds my basic strength. My demon and beast forms give me many other advantages over others, and my power increases severalfold every time both of my forms reach high ranks and evolve. Moreover, I haven't reached the maximum yet, and both of my forms have the potential to increase and evolve several more times."

"I don't know about demon ranks or their evolution, but I know a lot about beasts, especially since I've been with Lang since we were little." Xian Jinglan stroked the brown wolf's head. "As his beast rank rises, he gains a significant boost in both his cultivation and physical strength. As he evolves, both his cultivation and physical strength will significantly increase, particularly his physical strength. Since you are a heavenly fox, and your beast rank is much higher than his, I think your improvement should be much more significant than his."
"Howl... Howl..." Lang let out a howl in agreement with his master.

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "Actually, demon ranks and evolution are not different from beasts. However, each demon race will experience different advancements every time their demon ranks increase, and their evolutions will provide different benefits as well."
"Hey, what exactly is your demon form?" Xin Xianzi asked as she flew around Zhang Fei.

"Zhang Fei is a lust demon lord." After Zefyr said that, Xin Xianzi immediately stopped flying and looked at Zhang Fei in shock. Xian Jinglan and Lei Ting also directed their strange gazes toward him, instinctively retreating a few steps. "Hehe! That's why he has so many women by his side, especially since no woman can handle him alone."

On the other hand, Xin Xianzi seemed curious about Zhang Fei's demon form, but he couldn't possibly use it in the fairy forest, or her race members would immediately turn hostile toward him. "Shall we go to the fairy fountain first?"
"I want to test something on him, so we should go to the fairy glades first." Zhang Fei had no objections to that, and he had already guessed what Lei Ting wanted to do to him.
Soon, they arrived at the spacious fairy glades. Numerous vibrant plants and a variety of small creatures were present, emitting sounds akin to singing.

Zhang Fei was looking around the area when he sensed something unusual. Then, he took a deep breath and closed his eyes to calm himself. Soon, a multitude of whispers reached his ears, initially unclear but gradually becoming clearer.

"Hmm?" The wind engulfed Zhang Fei's body, shocking Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and Xian Jinglan. The wind slowly lifted him into midair, and he sat there with the wind gathering and spinning in place to form a chair beneath him.
"How is this possible?" Lei Ting muttered as she stared at Zhang Fei in astonishment.

"This guy has consistently given me surprises since we were in the tower." Xian Jinglan was also muttering to herself. "We haven't even been here for five minutes, but he has already merged with nature, and he has heard the whispers."
Xin Xianzi pouted her lips after seeing that. "It took me a month to be able to hear the whispers clearly."

'Hahaha!' Zefyr laughed inwardly, listening to the three women. 'They don't know that Zhang Fei's comprehension is so terrifying, and he is used to being one with nature since I made a contract with him. Moreover, he has already mastered the wind elemental law, and it will probably break through after this.'
A while later, more wind moved toward Zhang Fei, wrapping his body like a wind sphere that became thicker with each passing moment.

Time flew by quickly, and three hours had passed since Zhang Fei was in that position. However, the wind slowly subsided before disappearing completely a moment later, followed by the appearance of three notifications.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's light elemental law has reached the intermediate stage.]
[The clone illusion steps have advanced to level six.]
[The Nine Cloud Steps have advanced to level five.]

"Phew." Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and landed on the ground. Without using his movement technique or wind element, he ran around the fairy glades, leaving the three women from the fairy race dumbfounded at his speed.

In just a minute, Zhang Fei had circled the fairy glades more than ten times, which caused Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and Xian Jinglan to be shocked beyond words. After all, he ran without using anything, and they were sure that their eyes or senses would not be able to follow his speed if he used his wind elements or movement techniques.
"Jinglan, not even your father can keep up with Zhang Fei's movements if he uses his full speed."

Xian Jinglan nodded in agreement with Lei Ting. "My father's speed is already very fast, but Zhang Fei's speed is several levels above him. Moreover, his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, and he has not yet used his full speed, so my father will never be able to follow his movements, let alone catch up to him."
A while later, Zhang Fei had returned to their presence, and he spoke directly to Lei Ting. "Use your full lightning power to attack me."
"Zhang Fei, you—"
"Stop it, Xianzi." Xian Jinglan stopped her best friend. "Zhang Fei has already experienced lightning tribulation several times, so you don't need to worry about him."
"But—"
"It's okay, Xianzi. My lightning tribulations are very strong, so I'll be fine." Zhang Fei then jumped back some distance. "Please attack me."

Lei Ting nodded and took out her staff, pointing it high into the sky. In a few moments, the sky above them turned dark with many lightning flashes, but Zhang Fei looked up at them with a relaxed expression.
Unlike Zhang Fei and the others, Xin Xianzi was so tense that her tiny hands were clasped in front of her chest.
"Zhang Fei, I will use one powerful attack, and I will enhance it with my lightning elemental law, so you better be prepared." Lei Ting spoke to him.
'Lei Ting's lightning power pales in comparison to Hong Xinxin's, especially since the difference in their cultivation is too great.' Zhang Fei then nodded to Lei Ting. "I'm ready."
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

As soon as Lei Ting swung his staff down, a lightning dragon immediately descended from the sky toward Zhang Fei. The lightning dragon struck Zhang Fei directly within seconds, causing a loud bang that echoed throughout the fairy forest.
*Boom*
"Zhang Fei!" Xin Xianzi screamed as she flew forward, but Zefyr immediately blocked in front of her, shaking her head. "What—"
Xin Xianzi swallowed her words back after Zhang Fei appeared before her eyes again. Although his appearance was messy, and his clothes were tattered and burnt, he didn't seem to suffer any injuries.

On the other hand, Lei Ting took a deep breath because she used all her lightning power to summon the lightning dragon just now, but Zhang Fei was still able to stand at his spot with a relaxed smile on his face.

On Lei Ting's side, Xian Jinglan was at a loss for words to comment on Zhang Fei's absurdity. 'This guy! How did he manage to withstand the lightning dragon just now without suffering any injuries? Did he use something to protect his body without us realizing it? That's impossible, right? If he had used an artifact, his appearance and clothing wouldn't have been messed up like that.'

In fact, Zhang Fei was injured because of Lei Ting's attack just now, but his regenerative healing factor quickly healed the external injury. 'The lightning dragon's attack just now wasn't bad, and it caused me quite a bit of pain. However, it is still inferior to the lightning wolf summoned by Hong Xinxin, let alone compared to my lightning tribulation.' "Do you still doubt that I have the ability to reach the top of Cyanwood Mountain?"

"Yes and no." Lei Ting replied with a heavy sigh. "I acknowledge your amazing ability to withstand my lightning dragon, but the power of the lightning at Cyanwood Lightning's peak surpasses my lightning by a hundred or even a thousand times. You might be able to reach the peak, but you will never be able to do so before you reach the high level of the Seven Divine Realms."

Zhang Fei nodded repeatedly as a sign of agreement with Lei Ting's remarks. "Well? I'm not in a rush to go there either, and I'll probably go there in the next few years. At that time, I'm sure my cultivation has reached the Seven Divine Realms, and I will conquer the lightning at its peak."
"I hope you can really be patient, or you will die and become ashes up there." Lei Ting then turned to Xin Xianzi. "You can take Zhang Fei to the fairy mountain, and I will go see Emperor Xian."
"I will go back with you to see my father, Sister Ting."
"All right." After that, Lei Ting, Xian Jinglan, and Lang hurriedly left the fairy forest.
Xin Xianzi had brought Zhang Fei and Zefyr to the fairy fountain, but it was more like a bathing pool than a fountain.
"Hehehe." Zefyr laughed as she took off her green dress, and she immediately flew to the fairy fountain before diving into it.
"It seems that Zefyr is as shameless as you." Xin Xianzi said to Zhang Fei with a shake of her head. "You should take off your clothes and clean yourself before you go in there."
"Aren't you going to join us?" Zhang Fei asked Xin Xianzi.
Xin Xianzi thought for a moment before nodding. "Close your eyes first, and don't peek at me."
'Haha! This shy fairy! You definitely won't be shy anymore after I take you into my arms.' Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes.
Xin Xianzi hurriedly took off her pink dress and joined Zefyr inside the fairy fountain, leaving her small head above the surface.

"You can come in now." Xin Xianzi covered her face with both hands as Zhang Fei took off his clothes, but her eyes peeked out from between her fingers, making her face turn bright red as she saw his dick. 'Zefyr said that it was big, but it was much bigger.'
After that, Zhang Fei immediately soaked in the fairy fountain. "What should I do next, Xianzi?"

"Hmm?" Xin Xianzhi immediately told him. "You only need to close your eyes and calm your mind, and the fairy ancestors will appear in front of you if they deem you have a pure heart. Otherwise, they will not show any reaction, and you will not gain any benefit from them."
"All right, whether it works or not, I'll try it first." Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and followed Xin Xianzi's instructions just now.

"As his beast rank rises, he gains a significant boost in both his cultivation and physical strength.
As he evolves, both his cultivation and physical strength will significantly increase, particularly his physical strength.
Since you are a heavenly fox, and your beast rank is much higher than his, I think your improvement should be much more significant than his."
"Howl...
Howl..." Lang let out a howl in agreement with his master.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled.
"Actually, demon ranks and evolution are not different from beasts.
However, each demon race will experience different advancements every time their demon ranks increase, and their evolutions will provide different benefits as well."
"Hey, what exactly is your demon form?" Xin Xianzi asked as she flew around Zhang Fei.
"Zhang Fei is a lust demon lord." After Zefyr said that, Xin Xianzi immediately stopped flying and looked at Zhang Fei in shock.
Xian Jinglan and Lei Ting also directed their strange gazes toward him, instinctively retreating a few steps.
"Hehe!
That's why he has so many women by his side, especially since no woman can handle him alone."
On the other hand, Xin Xianzi seemed curious about Zhang Fei's demon form, but he couldn't possibly use it in the fairy forest, or her race members would immediately turn hostile toward him.
"Shall we go to the fairy fountain first?"
"I want to test something on him, so we should go to the fairy glades first." Zhang Fei had no objections to that, and he had already guessed what Lei Ting wanted to do to him.
Soon, they arrived at the spacious fairy glades.
Numerous vibrant plants and a variety of small creatures were present, emitting sounds akin to singing.
Zhang Fei was looking around the area when he sensed something unusual.
Then, he took a deep breath and closed his eyes to calm himself.
Soon, a multitude of whispers reached his ears, initially unclear but gradually becoming clearer.
"Hmm?" The wind engulfed Zhang Fei's body, shocking Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and Xian Jinglan.
The wind slowly lifted him into midair, and he sat there with the wind gathering and spinning in place to form a chair beneath him.
"How is this possible?" Lei Ting muttered as she stared at Zhang Fei in astonishment.
"This guy has consistently given me surprises since we were in the tower." Xian Jinglan was also muttering to herself.
"We haven't even been here for five minutes, but he has already merged with nature, and he has heard the whispers."
Xin Xianzi pouted her lips after seeing that.
"It took me a month to be able to hear the whispers clearly."

'Hahaha!' Zefyr laughed inwardly, listening to the three women. 'They don't know that Zhang Fei's comprehension is so terrifying, and he is used to being one with nature since I made a contract with him.
Moreover, he has already mastered the wind elemental law, and it will probably break through after this.'
A while later, more wind moved toward Zhang Fei, wrapping his body like a wind sphere that became thicker with each passing moment.
Time flew by quickly, and three hours had passed since Zhang Fei was in that position.
However, the wind slowly subsided before disappearing completely a moment later, followed by the appearance of three notifications.
[Ding]
[Congratulations!
The host's light elemental law has reached the intermediate stage.]
[The clone illusion steps have advanced to level six.]
[The Nine Cloud Steps have advanced to level five.]
"Phew." Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and landed on the ground.
Without using his movement technique or wind element, he ran around the fairy glades, leaving the three women from the fairy race dumbfounded at his speed.
In just a minute, Zhang Fei had circled the fairy glades more than ten times, which caused Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and Xian Jinglan to be shocked beyond words.
After all, he ran without using anything, and they were sure that their eyes or senses would not be able to follow his speed if he used his wind elements or movement techniques.
"Jinglan, not even your father can keep up with Zhang Fei's movements if he uses his full speed."
Xian Jinglan nodded in agreement with Lei Ting.
"My father's speed is already very fast, but Zhang Fei's speed is several levels above him.
Moreover, his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, and he has not yet used his full speed, so my father will never be able to follow his movements, let alone catch up to him."
A while later, Zhang Fei had returned to their presence, and he spoke directly to Lei Ting.
"Use your full lightning power to attack me."
"Zhang Fei, you—"
"Stop it, Xianzi." Xian Jinglan stopped her best friend.
"Zhang Fei has already experienced lightning tribulation several times, so you don't need to worry about him."
"But—"
"It's okay, Xianzi.
My lightning tribulations are very strong, so I'll be fine." Zhang Fei then jumped back some distance.
"Please attack me."
Lei Ting nodded and took out her staff, pointing it high into the sky.
In a few moments, the sky above them turned dark with many lightning flashes, but Zhang Fei looked up at them with a relaxed expression.
Unlike Zhang Fei and the others, Xin Xianzi was so tense that her tiny hands were clasped in front of her chest.
"Zhang Fei, I will use one powerful attack, and I will enhance it with my lightning elemental law, so you better be prepared." Lei Ting spoke to him.
'Lei Ting's lightning power pales in comparison to Hong Xinxin's, especially since the difference in their cultivation is too great.' Zhang Fei then nodded to Lei Ting.
"I'm ready."
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*
As soon as Lei Ting swung his staff down, a lightning dragon immediately descended from the sky toward Zhang Fei.
The lightning dragon struck Zhang Fei directly within seconds, causing a loud bang that echoed throughout the fairy forest.
*Boom*
"Zhang Fei!" Xin Xianzi screamed as she flew forward, but Zefyr immediately blocked in front of her, shaking her head.
"What—"
Xin Xianzi swallowed her words back after Zhang Fei appeared before her eyes again.
Although his appearance was messy, and his clothes were tattered and burnt, he didn't seem to suffer any injuries.

On the other hand, Lei Ting took a deep breath because she used all her lightning power to summon the lightning dragon just now, but Zhang Fei was still able to stand at his spot with a relaxed smile on his face.
On Lei Ting's side, Xian Jinglan was at a loss for words to comment on Zhang Fei's absurdity. 'This guy!
How did he manage to withstand the lightning dragon just now without suffering any injuries?
Did he use something to protect his body without us realizing it?
That's impossible, right?
If he had used an artifact, his appearance and clothing wouldn't have been messed up like that.'

In fact, Zhang Fei was injured because of Lei Ting's attack just now, but his regenerative healing factor quickly healed the external injury. 'The lightning dragon's attack just now wasn't bad, and it caused me quite a bit of pain.

However, it is still inferior to the lightning wolf summoned by Hong Xinxin, let alone compared to my lightning tribulation.' "Do you still doubt that I have the ability to reach the top of Cyanwood Mountain?"
"Yes and no." Lei Ting replied with a heavy sigh.
"I acknowledge your amazing ability to withstand my lightning dragon, but the power of the lightning at Cyanwood Lightning's peak surpasses my lightning by a hundred or even a thousand times.
You might be able to reach the peak, but you will never be able to do so before you reach the high level of the Seven Divine Realms."
Zhang Fei nodded repeatedly as a sign of agreement with Lei Ting's remarks.
"Well?
I'm not in a rush to go there either, and I'll probably go there in the next few years.
At that time, I'm sure my cultivation has reached the Seven Divine Realms, and I will conquer the lightning at its peak."
"I hope you can really be patient, or you will die and become ashes up there." Lei Ting then turned to Xin Xianzi.
"You can take Zhang Fei to the fairy mountain, and I will go see Emperor Xian."
"I will go back with you to see my father, Sister Ting."
"All right." After that, Lei Ting, Xian Jinglan, and Lang hurriedly left the fairy forest.
Xin Xianzi had brought Zhang Fei and Zefyr to the fairy fountain, but it was more like a bathing pool than a fountain.
"Hehehe." Zefyr laughed as she took off her green dress, and she immediately flew to the fairy fountain before diving into it.
"It seems that Zefyr is as shameless as you." Xin Xianzi said to Zhang Fei with a shake of her head.
"You should take off your clothes and clean yourself before you go in there."
"Aren't you going to join us?" Zhang Fei asked Xin Xianzi.
Xin Xianzi thought for a moment before nodding.
"Close your eyes first, and don't peek at me."
'Haha!
This shy fairy!
You definitely won't be shy anymore after I take you into my arms.' Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes.
Xin Xianzi hurriedly took off her pink dress and joined Zefyr inside the fairy fountain, leaving her small head above the surface.

"You can come in now." Xin Xianzi covered her face with both hands as Zhang Fei took off his clothes, but her eyes peeked out from between her fingers, making her face turn bright red as she saw his dick. 'Zefyr said that it was big, but it was much bigger.'
After that, Zhang Fei immediately soaked in the fairy fountain.
"What should I do next, Xianzi?"
"Hmm?" Xin Xianzhi immediately told him.
"You only need to close your eyes and calm your mind, and the fairy ancestors will appear in front of you if they deem you have a pure heart.
Otherwise, they will not show any reaction, and you will not gain any benefit from them."
"All right, whether it works or not, I'll try it first." Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and followed Xin Xianzi's instructions just now.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 Darkness
paragraphs: Lei Ting and Xian Jinglan were already sitting opposite Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling, informing them about Zhang Fei's results in the Fairy Glades.
Xian Lianghua nodded in understanding before posing the question. "Do you think Zhang Fei is capable of going to the top of Cyanwood Mountain, Lei Ting?"

"Not now, but maybe in the future." Lei Ting let out a soft sigh before continuing. "Emperor, you are aware of the power of my lightning, yet my attack on Zhang Fei resulted in no injuries whatsoever. I haven't inquired further, but it's evident that he has learned a lightning body cultivation technique. He used his lightning tribulations to temper his body; otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to visit the Guo Clan's lightning pond."
"Is it possible to learn a lightning body cultivation technique without the lightning element?" Xue Jingling asked.

"In fact, the difference between a lightning body cultivation technique and an ordinary one is only in the elements, Empress." Lei Ting replied with a nod. "Zhang Fei can still learn a lightning body cultivation technique, but he cannot use any lightning techniques within it. The technique's effect is beneficial to his body, enabling him to withstand lightning attacks."
"I see." Xue Jingling then turned to her husband and inquired. "Will you grant Zhang Fei permission to visit Cyanwood Mountain?"
"I will wait to see Zhang Fei's progress before making a decision." Xian Lianghua answered his wife before asking both women, "Is there anything else about him that you two haven't told us?"

"Father, Zhang Fei has only cultivated for eight months, but his cultivation has already reached the Earth Realm." Xian Jinglan's revelation shocked Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling. "He is a genius among geniuses, and his potential is limitless, especially with his three identities. Everything about him makes me feel inferior, and he will definitely surpass me in the next few years. Anyway, I'm going into seclusion now, and I won't be getting out any time soon."

After she said that, Xian Jinglan took Lang away with her. Xue Jingling wanted to follow her daughter to comfort her, but Xian Lianghua stopped her. "Our daughter's competitive nature has always been strong, and she is not weak-minded, so I'm sure she will be fine. Instead, her feelings of inferiority to Zhang Fei will spur her spirit on, and she will be overall stronger when she comes out."
"Yeah, you're right."
After she discussed some other matters with Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling, Lei Ting immediately left the capital and returned to the Fairy Forest.

Xian Jinglan had already reached her room, but she didn't immediately begin her cultivation. Instead, she lay down on her bed with Lang by her side, hugging the brown wolf's neck. "Do you think I can catch up with Zhang Fei?"
"Howl..." Lang howled softly and licked Xian Jinglan's face.
"Do you really believe I can do it?"
"Howl... howl..." Lang howled again while nodding his head again and again.

"Hehe." Xian Jinglan giggled at Lang's reaction. "I'm always grateful to have you by my side, Lang. We've been together since we were little, and you've always accompanied me through my joyful and sad times. If only you could turn into a human, I would be even happier. Normally, beasts can become humans after they break through to the sovereign realm. Your cultivation has reached the seven divine realms, but you can't turn into humans yet."
After hearing that, Lang made a disappointed face, let out a low howl, and snuggled into Xian Jinglan's embrace. "Howl... howl..."

"I know." Xian Jinglan nodded and rubbed the wolf's head. "I will continue to help you; I believe you will be able to transform into a human one day. After you become a human, you must not leave me, or I will definitely be sad."
"Howl..."
Xian Jinglan then sat on her bed with the brown wolf lying beside her. "Let's get started, Lang. We won't be leaving this room for a few years, and I hope we can both become very strong by then."
