Three hours had passed since Zhang Fei had soaked in the Fairy Mountain, but he had yet to receive any reaction from the fairy ancestors.

Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and Zefyr waited a little way away from the Fairy Fountain. They repeatedly let out soft sighs, believing that Zhang Fei did not have the qualifications to summon the fairy ancestors.

Things suddenly changed in the next hour as a dark aura began to appear and envelop the Fairy Fountain, which shocked the three female fairies. Moreover, the dark aura became increasingly thick and dense, giving them goosebumps.
"What happened, Big Sis? Where did this dark aura come from?" Xin Xianzi asked with a frown, especially since such a phenomenon had never happened before.
Lei Ting thought for a few moments before responding. "Zhang Fei succeeded in summoning one of the fairy ancestors."
"Are you kidding me? Since when do we have ancestors who possess the darkness element?" Xin Xianzi inquired in a raised voice, filled with astonishment.

Lei Ting released a heavy sigh. "Xianzi, our race actually has many members with the darkness element, and they call themselves dark fairies. However, they don't live on this island, and they live on the demon island close to the Ximen Demon Kingdom."
"Why were I and the others unaware of their existence?"

"Like the demons, our ancestors considered the dark fairies as heretics, and they banished them from this island. After that, they concealed their existence from our members and never discussed them again. Only a small handful of people of our race know about them, including me." Lei Ting paused briefly, gazing at Zhang Fei. "Even though they don't live on this island, they are still members of our fairy race, and their souls will return to this fountain after their death. None of our members have the darkness element, so they have never appeared before."
"Then—"
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Four old fairies suddenly appeared in front of them, and one of them asked directly. "What the hell is going on here? How could this dark aura appear in our fountain?"
"How could that male fox summon this dark aura?" Another person posed this question, pointing at Zhang Fei.

The other three immediately looked toward Zhang Fei, but they were confused because he was still in his white half-fox form. Furthermore, they could feel a strong light element radiating from his body, yet he managed to summon the dark aura.

"His name is Zhang Fei, a heavenly fox." The four old fairies turned to Lei Ting directly. "Apart from his identity as a heavenly fox, he still has two other identities, which are a human and a demon."
"What? Are you serious about that?"

"Emperor Lianghua told me and the leaders of the other races about Zhang Fei's three identities about a month ago, and he learned of them when he and Empress Jingling witnessed him breaking through to the Earth Realm." Lei Ting then rubbed the wind fairy's head. "Zefyr told me that the ten-tailed fox left a statue in their home realm, and he wrote a prophecy about him on it."
"A prophecy?" The four old fairies looked at Zefyr with questioning looks.

Zefyr immediately informed them about the prophecy the ten-tailed fox had left behind. "He wrote: One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this realm once again. However, he is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to humans, demons, and natural races. Since Zhang Fei has all three forms, my grandfather and the others believe that he will become the next ten-tailed fox in the future. Therefore, they decided to follow him, especially since the old ten-tailed fox was our savior and leader."

"The ten-tailed fox is the protector of the natural races, and he has greatly aided our races from all realms." As seniors, the four old fairies naturally knew about the legend, so they were not surprised by Lei Ting's words. "If the prophecy is true that Zhang Fei is the next ten-tailed fox, then we don't need to make a big deal about his darkness element. Furthermore, he still possesses the elements of light, wind, and fire."

After hearing Lei Ting's last sentence, the four old fairies took a deep breath. All these years, they had always believed that Xian Lianghua was unmatched with his three elements. However, suddenly, someone with four elements appeared before them, and Zhang Fei also possessed three identities.
"Hmm?" All of them shifted their focus back to the Fairy Mountain as a dark female figure with red eyes suddenly appeared before Zhang Fei. "She must be one of the dark fairy race."
"That's right." The four old fairies nodded at Lei Ting.

The dark female figure immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's head and pressed their foreheads together, but another dark creature appeared above them. Its form was similar to a fairy, but its entire body was black, and only its blue eyes were visible.

Zhang Fei could naturally feel the presence of the dark female figure and the dark creature, but he did not sense any evil intentions from either of them. Suddenly, something appeared in his mind, which excited him.

After that, the dark female figure disappeared into Zhang Fei's body, and the dark aura quickly dispersed. However, the dark creature didn't disappear and hovered in front of him, seemingly waiting for something to happen.
Zhang Fei remained still and learned the information the dark female figure had given him, especially since it was the method for mastering the darkness elemental law.

To make it easier, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] rushed into the training space and studied the method using the comprehension feature. Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Zhang Fei [5] also studied it from their respective places, except for Zhang Fei [4], who was still busy with alchemy.
"What is he doing? Why is he still meditating there?" The situation at the Fairy Fountain had returned to normal, leaving Xin Xianzi confused.
"See that?" Lei Ting pointed to the dark creature. "That thing is the darkness elemental spirit, and it is waiting for Zhang Fei to master the darkness elemental law."

"Oh?" Xin Xianzi was surprised for a moment before shouting. "Zhang Fei is really lucky! Not only did he obtain the method to master the dark elemental law, but he also obtained the recognition of a dark elemental spirit."
"In fact, Zhang Fei had already received recognition as a fire elemental spirit at the Star Tower, and his fire element power has now become extremely strong."
Xin Xianzi sulked immediately after Zefyr's statement. "Apart from the divine-grade technique, I didn't find anything else interesting."
"A divine-grade technique is already extraordinary, and not many people can obtain it." Lei Ting said this with a shake of her head. "You shouldn't be greedy, or it will harm you."
"I know." Xin Xianzi replied with pursed lips.
Time quickly passed, and another hour passed.

Zhang Fei's sudden transformation into his lustful demon lord form shocked Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and the four old fairies. A dark aura gradually enveloped his body, slowly forming a dark figure similar to his demon form, indicating that he had almost succeeded in mastering the darkness elemental aura.
Unlike Zefyr, who had grown accustomed to Zhang Fei, the six female fairies trembled upon seeing the dark figure, particularly due to its dense evil aura.
Sometime later, the dark figure has become thick and clear. Zhang Fei's darkness element covered the Fairy Fountain, blocking Lei Ting and the others' vision.
After seeing that, the darkness elemental creature immediately entered the dark figure and merged with it, triggering two consecutive notifications in Zhang Fei's mind.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the darkness law.]
[Congratulations! The host's darkness element has been upgraded to the Advanced stage.]
[The host obtained approval from a darkness elemental spirit.]

Zhang Fei immediately withdrew the darkness that enveloped the place, returned to his white half-fox form, and opened his eyes. "Phew! I've heard of the dark fairy race, but I didn't expect to meet one here, and she helped me master the darkness elemental law. Moreover, she brought the darkness elemental spirit to me, so I have two elemental spirits in my body now."
[Master, the woman did not leave after helping you, and she chose to stay in your soul space.]
Zhang Fei nodded in response, sensing the woman's presence in his soul space. He was curious about her reasons for doing so.

'Kid, this woman's soul is truly strong, and she will be of great use to you. Maybe you can help her reshape her body, and she will become a valuable ally for you in the future.' Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke to him.
'I'll see that woman later, Old Ma.'
After that, Zhang Fei immediately jumped out of the fairy fountain, but his action provoked a yell from Lei Ting and Xin Xianzi. "Shameless! Put on your clothes first!"
Upon seeing that, the four old fairies shook their heads, but they said nothing and immediately vanished.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled, seeing Lei Ting and Xin Xianzi blush. He quickly put on his clothes and spoke to them. "Anyway, thank you for bringing me here, and I've made two big gains today."
"Ugh! You make me jealous!" Xin Xianzi said as she flew towards Zhang Fei, sitting on his shoulder. "I have long mastered the light elemental law, but no light elemental spirit chose me."

Zhang Fei smiled and rubbed Xin Xianzi's tiny head. "Honestly, I did not expect that the fire and darkness elemental spirits would acknowledge me, so I did not know how to help you gain the recognition of the light elemental spirit. Perhaps you just need to try harder, and you might be able to gain recognition from one of them in the future."
"Yeah, you're probably right, and I'll try harder to get one of them to recognize me." Xin Xianzi then asked him. "Are you going back to your residence now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "The sun is almost setting, and they will be back soon. Moreover, I have to prepare myself for my wedding with Xian Xianqin, so I should go back now."
"I see." Xin Xianzi seemed disappointed to hear that. "Are you going into seclusion again after your wedding?"

Zhang Fei raised both hands and clenched his fists. "My strength is still lacking, and many powerful enemies await me. Moreover, I want to challenge the second floor of the Star Tower soon, so I will bring them into seclusion after my wedding. If you wish, you can join us, and you will enjoy your time with us."
Before Xin Xianzi answered Zhang Fei, Lei Ting spoke to her first. "You can go with him and enter seclusion with them."
"Huh?" Xin Xianzi looked at Lei Ting with surprise.

"I've been raising you since you were little, so I know you very well, and I know you want to join them. Moreover, Princess Jinglan has also entered seclusion, so you can join them, or she'll leave you behind." Xin Xianzi had a deep understanding of Xian Jinglan's character, which led her to understand the reason for her sudden retreat into seclusion. "Zhang Fei, I understand your wishes, and I also acknowledge your strength, but I forbid you from going to Cyanwood Mountain before your cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms. Once your cultivation breaks through to that stage, I will accompany you there, and I will help you obtain that item."

"So you already knew about the existence of the low-grade lightning elemental seed at the peak, huh?" Lei Ting nodded to Zhang Fei. "All right, I'll wait for my cultivation to reach that stage first, and I hope you can help me get it in the future."

"Yes." After that, Zhang Fei brought Zefyr and Xin Xianzi back to his residence directly, leaving Lei Ting behind. "I believe he will become truly powerful in the future, and he may succeed in bringing peace to all living beings."

How could this dark aura appear in our fountain?"
"How could that male fox summon this dark aura?" Another person posed this question, pointing at Zhang Fei.
The other three immediately looked toward Zhang Fei, but they were confused because he was still in his white half-fox form.
Furthermore, they could feel a strong light element radiating from his body, yet he managed to summon the dark aura.
"His name is Zhang Fei, a heavenly fox." The four old fairies turned to Lei Ting directly.
"Apart from his identity as a heavenly fox, he still has two other identities, which are a human and a demon."
"What?
Are you serious about that?"

"Emperor Lianghua told me and the leaders of the other races about Zhang Fei's three identities about a month ago, and he learned of them when he and Empress Jingling witnessed him breaking through to the Earth Realm." Lei Ting then rubbed the wind fairy's head.
"Zefyr told me that the ten-tailed fox left a statue in their home realm, and he wrote a prophecy about him on it."
"A prophecy?" The four old fairies looked at Zefyr with questioning looks.
Zefyr immediately informed them about the prophecy the ten-tailed fox had left behind.
"He wrote: One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this realm once again.
However, he is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon.
He is the one who will bring peace to humans, demons, and natural races.
Since Zhang Fei has all three forms, my grandfather and the others believe that he will become the next ten-tailed fox in the future.
Therefore, they decided to follow him, especially since the old ten-tailed fox was our savior and leader."

"The ten-tailed fox is the protector of the natural races, and he has greatly aided our races from all realms." As seniors, the four old fairies naturally knew about the legend, so they were not surprised by Lei Ting's words.
"If the prophecy is true that Zhang Fei is the next ten-tailed fox, then we don't need to make a big deal about his darkness element.
Furthermore, he still possesses the elements of light, wind, and fire."
After hearing Lei Ting's last sentence, the four old fairies took a deep breath.
All these years, they had always believed that Xian Lianghua was unmatched with his three elements.
However, suddenly, someone with four elements appeared before them, and Zhang Fei also possessed three identities.
"Hmm?" All of them shifted their focus back to the Fairy Mountain as a dark female figure with red eyes suddenly appeared before Zhang Fei.
"She must be one of the dark fairy race."
"That's right." The four old fairies nodded at Lei Ting.
The dark female figure immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's head and pressed their foreheads together, but another dark creature appeared above them.
Its form was similar to a fairy, but its entire body was black, and only its blue eyes were visible.
Zhang Fei could naturally feel the presence of the dark female figure and the dark creature, but he did not sense any evil intentions from either of them.
Suddenly, something appeared in his mind, which excited him.
After that, the dark female figure disappeared into Zhang Fei's body, and the dark aura quickly dispersed.
However, the dark creature didn't disappear and hovered in front of him, seemingly waiting for something to happen.
Zhang Fei remained still and learned the information the dark female figure had given him, especially since it was the method for mastering the darkness elemental law.
To make it easier, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] rushed into the training space and studied the method using the comprehension feature.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Zhang Fei [5] also studied it from their respective places, except for Zhang Fei [4], who was still busy with alchemy.
"What is he doing?
Why is he still meditating there?" The situation at the Fairy Fountain had returned to normal, leaving Xin Xianzi confused.
"See that?" Lei Ting pointed to the dark creature.
"That thing is the darkness elemental spirit, and it is waiting for Zhang Fei to master the darkness elemental law."
"Oh?" Xin Xianzi was surprised for a moment before shouting.
"Zhang Fei is really lucky!
Not only did he obtain the method to master the dark elemental law, but he also obtained the recognition of a dark elemental spirit."
"In fact, Zhang Fei had already received recognition as a fire elemental spirit at the Star Tower, and his fire element power has now become extremely strong."
Xin Xianzi sulked immediately after Zefyr's statement.
"Apart from the divine-grade technique, I didn't find anything else interesting."
"A divine-grade technique is already extraordinary, and not many people can obtain it." Lei Ting said this with a shake of her head.
"You shouldn't be greedy, or it will harm you."
"I know." Xin Xianzi replied with pursed lips.
Time quickly passed, and another hour passed.
Zhang Fei's sudden transformation into his lustful demon lord form shocked Lei Ting, Xin Xianzi, and the four old fairies.
A dark aura gradually enveloped his body, slowly forming a dark figure similar to his demon form, indicating that he had almost succeeded in mastering the darkness elemental aura.
Unlike Zefyr, who had grown accustomed to Zhang Fei, the six female fairies trembled upon seeing the dark figure, particularly due to its dense evil aura.
Sometime later, the dark figure has become thick and clear.
Zhang Fei's darkness element covered the Fairy Fountain, blocking Lei Ting and the others' vision.
After seeing that, the darkness elemental creature immediately entered the dark figure and merged with it, triggering two consecutive notifications in Zhang Fei's mind.
[Ding]
[Congratulations!
The host has mastered the initial stage of the darkness law.]
[Congratulations!
The host's darkness element has been upgraded to the Advanced stage.]
[The host obtained approval from a darkness elemental spirit.]
Zhang Fei immediately withdrew the darkness that enveloped the place, returned to his white half-fox form, and opened his eyes.
"Phew!
I've heard of the dark fairy race, but I didn't expect to meet one here, and she helped me master the darkness elemental law.
Moreover, she brought the darkness elemental spirit to me, so I have two elemental spirits in my body now."
[Master, the woman did not leave after helping you, and she chose to stay in your soul space.]
Zhang Fei nodded in response, sensing the woman's presence in his soul space.
He was curious about her reasons for doing so.
'Kid, this woman's soul is truly strong, and she will be of great use to you.
Maybe you can help her reshape her body, and she will become a valuable ally for you in the future.' Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke to him.
'I'll see that woman later, Old Ma.'
After that, Zhang Fei immediately jumped out of the fairy fountain, but his action provoked a yell from Lei Ting and Xin Xianzi.
"Shameless!
Put on your clothes first!"
Upon seeing that, the four old fairies shook their heads, but they said nothing and immediately vanished.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled, seeing Lei Ting and Xin Xianzi blush.
He quickly put on his clothes and spoke to them.
"Anyway, thank you for bringing me here, and I've made two big gains today."
"Ugh!
You make me jealous!" Xin Xianzi said as she flew towards Zhang Fei, sitting on his shoulder.
"I have long mastered the light elemental law, but no light elemental spirit chose me."
Zhang Fei smiled and rubbed Xin Xianzi's tiny head.
"Honestly, I did not expect that the fire and darkness elemental spirits would acknowledge me, so I did not know how to help you gain the recognition of the light elemental spirit.
Perhaps you just need to try harder, and you might be able to gain recognition from one of them in the future."
"Yeah, you're probably right, and I'll try harder to get one of them to recognize me." Xin Xianzi then asked him.
"Are you going back to your residence now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"The sun is almost setting, and they will be back soon.
Moreover, I have to prepare myself for my wedding with Xian Xianqin, so I should go back now."
"I see." Xin Xianzi seemed disappointed to hear that.
"Are you going into seclusion again after your wedding?"
Zhang Fei raised both hands and clenched his fists.
"My strength is still lacking, and many powerful enemies await me.
Moreover, I want to challenge the second floor of the Star Tower soon, so I will bring them into seclusion after my wedding.
If you wish, you can join us, and you will enjoy your time with us."
Before Xin Xianzi answered Zhang Fei, Lei Ting spoke to her first.
"You can go with him and enter seclusion with them."
"Huh?" Xin Xianzi looked at Lei Ting with surprise.
"I've been raising you since you were little, so I know you very well, and I know you want to join them.

Moreover, Princess Jinglan has also entered seclusion, so you can join them, or she'll leave you behind." Xin Xianzi had a deep understanding of Xian Jinglan's character, which led her to understand the reason for her sudden retreat into seclusion.
"Zhang Fei, I understand your wishes, and I also acknowledge your strength, but I forbid you from going to Cyanwood Mountain before your cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms.
Once your cultivation breaks through to that stage, I will accompany you there, and I will help you obtain that item."
"So you already knew about the existence of the low-grade lightning elemental seed at the peak, huh?" Lei Ting nodded to Zhang Fei.
"All right, I'll wait for my cultivation to reach that stage first, and I hope you can help me get it in the future."
"Yes." After that, Zhang Fei brought Zefyr and Xin Xianzi back to his residence directly, leaving Lei Ting behind.
"I believe he will become truly powerful in the future, and he may succeed in bringing peace to all living beings."

chapters.title: Chapter 683 Zhuo Xiaochuan's Arrival
paragraphs: Upon their arrival at the residence, only Qing Yi's group had returned, which was not surprising given the limited market in the Yun Kingdom.
When she saw Xin Xianzi, Zhang Chen smiled and took the female fairy away with her, which made her feel awkward.
"Hey, your grandmother seems interested in Sister Xianzi."
Zhang Fei nodded to Zefyr, who was sitting on his shoulder. "My grandmother wants Xianzi to be my wife, so you don't have to be surprised to see her act like that."
"Hehe." Zefyr giggled at that. "Actually, Sister Xianzi told me that she fell in love with you the moment you two met at the tower, but she was still embarrassed to admit her feelings."

"I know." Zhang Fei then brought Zefyr in front of his face. "What about you? We've lived together since you made a contract with me, and several months have passed since then. Additionally, you've always joined us in my mansion, so we've been together for more than a year, yet you are still not willing to be my wife."

"Hahaha." Zefyr laughed awkwardly before kissing Zhang Fei. "Honestly, I have long considered you my husband, but I am still not ready to dual-cultivate with you. When I am ready, I will dedicate myself to you, so I kindly ask for your patience while I prepare myself."

"If I didn't have patience, I would have eaten you long ago." Zhang Fei led Zefyr to meet Qing Yi and Tang Ziyu, who immediately handed over the earnings from their shop and restaurant in the Yun Kingdom to him. Though the earnings were lower than from his shop and restaurant in Xian Capital, he was satisfied.

Sometime later, Zhang Lingxue's group and Lillea's group returned to the residence. However, Zhang Fei did not send all his wives and family members to the training space; he only sent his wives' families there. After all, he wanted them to attend his wedding with Xian Xianqin, which would be held in the morning.

Zhang Fei shared the method of mastering the darkness element law with Janette and asked her to learn it first. His clones also shared the method with their partners from the Sky Jade Realm and the Netherworld Realm, which would make the female demons even stronger.
Xian Changyue and Yun Xinyue did not return to the training space. Instead, they asked Zhang Fei to send them to the Xian capital so they could prepare for his wedding.

Zhang Fei then asked Zhou Shenxin, Shang Yumei, and Ling Long to leave the training space. He asked the three women to join his family to strengthen their relationship with Zhang Chen and his other wives, especially since they had only been with them for a few days.

Zhang Fei decided to close all his shops and restaurants tomorrow because no one would take care of them, and Zhu Yan also had to cook for his wedding. Since many guests would attend his wedding tomorrow, and many of them were stronger than his family members, he asked Feng Yao and Shang Yumei to protect them.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to reject Yang Lu'er and the six women from Earth's wishes to join them, especially since they were not cultivators and would not be able to withstand the aura of so many powerful cultivators. However, Shang Yumei convinced him that she had a way to protect them, leading him to immediately agree to their requests.

If Shang Yumei were still the old her, she would never have thought of helping them. However, their warm and familial treatment slowly changed her character, and she has become increasingly gentle in recent days. Although Yang Lu'er and the others were not cultivators, they were still Zhang Fei's women, so she also treated them like sisters.

Zhou Shenxin, who previously felt awkward about her situation, also slowly began to mingle with Zhang Fei's family members. Unlike her, Ling Long already felt at home, and she became one of the most talkative among them.
"Are you sure I don't need to see my father?" Zhou Shenxin asked Zhang Fei. "If I don't see him, he will definitely suspect something has happened to me, and he might come directly to look for you."

"Why should you worry about that?" Zhang Fei turned to ask with a relaxed smile. "You are already aware that Zhou Xiaochuan has always regarded you as a tool, and Ximen Gui is a powerful demon. If they can't defeat him, he might use you as a sacrifice, and you will die in vain there. Therefore, I won't send you to him, but I have ordered Zhou Hanling to go there. Moreover, Ximen Chuixue and the others have already infiltrated your kingdom quite far, and they managed to capture many of your father's subordinates. If your father returns, he will undoubtedly be occupied with matters there, leaving him with no time to search for me. Have you gotten the information from your mother?"
"Yes." Zhou Shenxin then told Zhang Fei. "My mother has used those pills on the empress and the other concubines, but she was confused because they showed no reaction after taking them."

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "Those pills won't activate without a trigger, and I didn't give it to your mother. Instead, I ordered Zhou Hanling to give it to Zhou Xiaochuan, and I'm sure that he would panic if his wife and concubines were suddenly exposed to a mysterious disease."
Zhou Shenxin raised her eyebrows for a moment. "What exactly are the effects of those pills? Will they really not die from the effects?"

"I'm not a cold-blooded killer, okay?" Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "The empress and your father's other concubines have no issues with me, so I have no intention of killing them. They will only endure temporary suffering until I provide them with the antidote. Moreover, you need many influential people to support you after you take over your father's position, and they will be useful to help you. That way, your kingdom's nobles and powerful clans won't rebel against you, and you can establish your new status faster with their help."
Zhou Shenxin then told Zhang Fei something else. "My mother was curious about you and our relationship, so she asked me to take you to see her as soon as possible."

"Please tell your mother to be patient. Once we have settled our matter with Zhou Xiaochuan, I will go see him immediately." Zhang Fei then looked at his map to check the position of the Zhou Emperor. "Your father and master have almost arrived at the demon island, and Zhou Fanzhi is already waiting for them there. Zhou Hanling is still a little far away, but he will join them there soon."

"Sigh! I hope your plan for my father will really go smoothly, or we will face him directly." Zhou Shenxin then contacted her mother, Jiang Tingxi, and conveyed Zhang Fei's message. "My mother said that you shouldn't keep her waiting long."

"I know." Zhang Fei left Zhou Shenxin and approached the two women playing musical instruments in the distance. Zhao Ziqin played her lute as usual, but she was accompanied by Chang Wenjie, who played the flute by her side.
Chang Wenjie was startled when Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her from behind, but she didn't reject him and leaned against his chest while continuing to play the flute.
A few minutes later, the two women had finished playing their instruments. Zhang Fei immediately turned Chang Wenjie to face him and kissed her, surprising her.

After all, they had shared a kiss during their first meeting at the Blazing Volcano Mountain, and Chang Wenjie had waited months for Zhang Fei to accept her. She immediately responded to his kiss and wrapped her arms around his neck, enjoying their first intense and passionate kisses.

Zhao Ziqin smiled as she watched their kiss heat up; she was pleased that Zhang Fei had finally accepted Chang Wenjie. She immediately put away her lute and left them, giving her new sister-to-be some time with her husband.
Chang Wenjie immediately buried her face in Zhang Fei's chest as soon as he stopped their kiss, and a charming smile spread across her face. "Why did you suddenly kiss me?"
"Don't you like it?"
"I like it."

"You've been living with us for over a month now, and I can see that you're not as haughty as you used to be." Zhang Fei then raised Chang Wenjie's head, looked into her eyes, and caressed her cheeks. "To be honest, I've wanted you by my side since our first meeting, but your arrogant attitude really annoyed me, so I ignored you and chased you away."

"You're really mean, you know that?" Chang Wenjie protested with a pout. "At that time, I didn't know you were a demon, but now I know about it. Back then, you used your demon charm to seduce me, and I responded positively, but you treated me terribly instead. Even when I showed my body to you at the Chu Clan, you didn't spare me a single glance, and you only focused on having fun with Aunt Hua. Your words back then made me realize that I was wrong, and I kept thinking about your words after I returned to the sect. Since then, I have learned to change, and I have started to change when we met the second and third time, but you still ignore me, which makes me really sad. However, I am now happy because you brought me here, and your kiss just now answered the doubts in my heart."

"At first, I thought you would never change, especially since you are such a spoiled young miss. But you proved me wrong, and I liked your change." Zhang Fei then planted a short kiss on Chang Wenjie's red lips. "I promise I won't ignore or push you away again, and I will take you as my wife in the future."
"Yeah." Chang Wenjie then pulled Zhang Fei with him. "I know we will go to the Xian capital after this, but I want you to accompany me first, and we can leave after that."
"All right."

Meanwhile, Zhou Xiaochuan's flying artifact had landed a little far from the demon island, and Zhou Fanzhi was already waiting for them there. He immediately led Kong Zhi and his subordinates down, but his expression was filled with fury due to the absence of Zhou Shenxin.
In Zhou Xiaochuan's mind, Zhou Shenxin was still in the Xian Kingdom, which was much closer to the Demon Island than his kingdom. Thus, she should have been able to arrive earlier than him.
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately contacted his daughter, but Zhou Shenxin did not respond in accordance with Zhang Fei's plan, which infuriated him even more. "Try contacting my daughter, Old Kong."
"Did she not give you an answer?" After Zhou Xiaochuan shook his head, Kong Zhi tried to contact Zhou Shenxin, and the result was the same. "She still doesn't respond to my calls."

Zhou Xiaochuan immediately turned his head and looked toward the distance, specifically toward the human island. "Could something have happened to her? She wouldn't dare disobey my orders, so I'm sure something happened to her."
"What about Zhou Hanling, Brother? Didn't you send him to protect my niece?" Zhou Fanzhi asked him.
Zhou Xiaochuan nodded and contacted Zhou Hanling before informing them. "He'll be here in a moment, but Shenxin isn't with him."

A while later, Zhou Hanling landed in front of them, and he informed Zhou Xiaochuan according to Zhang Fei's orders. "Emperor, I have never stopped watching your daughter, and we had a meal together at Zhang Fei's restaurant that day. However, she disappeared from my senses as soon as she entered her inn, and I have been looking for her for several days but still have had no luck. I suspect that the mysterious person who attacked me back then had kidnapped her, but I don't know anything about that person's identity."

Zhou Xiaochuan turned to Kong Zhi, who immediately touched Zhou Hanling's chest to check his soul. Soon after, he shook his head at the Zhou Emperor. "I didn't find anything suspicious in his soul, so he shouldn't lie to you."
"I see." Zhou Xiaochuan nodded in understanding. "Can we defeat Ximen Gui without my daughter?"
"Fifty-fifty." Kong Zhi's answer caused Zhou Xiaochuan to frown. "Do you still want to continue with our plan?"

Zhou Xiaochuan did not answer Kong Zhi immediately, and he thought about their chances of winning first. He felt that it was too risky to fight Ximen Gui without proper preparation, so he wanted to cancel his plan and return to his kingdom.

Xin Yanluo, who was monitoring the Zheng Clan, suddenly sent a voice transmission to Zhou Xiaochuan. Naturally, she did it on Zhang Fei's orders, especially since he wanted to weaken him and Kong Zhi.

'Damn it! That two female demons really want me dead!' Zhou Xiaochuan then answered Kong Zhi. "We will continue with our plan, and we will move to the Ximen Demon Kingdom now. However, we should not travel there by air; instead, we will infiltrate there by land."

For a while, Kong Zhi stared at Zhou Xiaochuan, feeling that his decision was too forceful. "It will take us a few days to get there by land, and we have to pass through some tough areas on the way there."
"Let's go now." Zhou Xiaochuan immediately led Kong Zhi and the others across to the demon island.
Unknown to them, Feltia [2] was watching them from the air in an invisible state. "Hehe! Now everything is ready, so let's see if they can leave this island safely."
After that, Feltia [2] returned to the side of Fyr and the others who were still studying the method to master the darkness elemental law.

After she was unconscious for quite some time, Qu Qiuxue finally opened her eyes. She felt her head was so heavy, especially since Wushuang hit her too hard. "Damn it! Who exactly is that woman? Does she have a relationship with Huan Ya? I don't even know her, but she suddenly attacked me out of nowhere."

Qu Qiuxue contacted her senior and informed him about the situation, prompting Wei Chou to urge her to return to the Yun Kingdom immediately. He suspected Wushuang had a connection to Huangfu Shou and believed her to be powerful, particularly given her ability to easily knock down his junior.

After hearing that, Qu Qiuxue didn't waste any more time and hurriedly left the village. However, her doubts about Wei Chao's suspicions caused many questions to arise in her mind about the relationship between Huan Ya, Wushuang, and Huangfu Shou.

After he had accompanied Chang Wenjie for some time, Zhang Fei brought him back to the residence to meet the others. He then took them to the Xian royal palace, where Shi Qingzhuang had prepared rooms for them all.

After all, the distance between the residence and the Xian capital was too far, and the wedding ceremony would take place early in the morning. Furthermore, due to the size of their group, staying there would be more convenient.
Upon their arrival, Xian Feng immediately asked Zhang Fei to accompany him. They drank together and discussed several matters outside of the marriage.
"Do you think Zhou Xiaochuan and Kong Zhi will die at Ximen Gui's hands?" Xian Feng asked him.

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head. "I still need them to support Shenxin, so I can't let them die. My second clone is keeping an eye on them there, and I asked Xin Yanluo to save them if they are in a pinch."
Xian Feng nodded in understanding. "What about Huangfu Shou? Are you going to move against him soon?"

"For now, our main goal is to take down Zhou Xiaochuan and take over the Zhou Kingdom, and I will make plans to deal with Huangfu Shou after Li Tiannan returns to this realm." Zhang Fei then took a sip of his drink before continuing. "His ancestors are too powerful, and we will be in big trouble if he finds out about our actions, so we must make thorough preparations before fighting him."
"I see." Xian Feng then patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "You will marry Qin'er tomorrow, so I will leave her safety in your hands, and you must protect her well."
"I will definitely protect Qin'er well."

Zhao Ziqin smiled as she watched their kiss heat up; she was pleased that Zhang Fei had finally accepted Chang Wenjie.
She immediately put away her lute and left them, giving her new sister-to-be some time with her husband.
Chang Wenjie immediately buried her face in Zhang Fei's chest as soon as he stopped their kiss, and a charming smile spread across her face.
"Why did you suddenly kiss me?"
"Don't you like it?"
"I like it."

"You've been living with us for over a month now, and I can see that you're not as haughty as you used to be." Zhang Fei then raised Chang Wenjie's head, looked into her eyes, and caressed her cheeks.
"To be honest, I've wanted you by my side since our first meeting, but your arrogant attitude really annoyed me, so I ignored you and chased you away."
"You're really mean, you know that?" Chang Wenjie protested with a pout.
"At that time, I didn't know you were a demon, but now I know about it.
Back then, you used your demon charm to seduce me, and I responded positively, but you treated me terribly instead.
Even when I showed my body to you at the Chu Clan, you didn't spare me a single glance, and you only focused on having fun with Aunt Hua.
Your words back then made me realize that I was wrong, and I kept thinking about your words after I returned to the sect.
Since then, I have learned to change, and I have started to change when we met the second and third time, but you still ignore me, which makes me really sad.
However, I am now happy because you brought me here, and your kiss just now answered the doubts in my heart."
"At first, I thought you would never change, especially since you are such a spoiled young miss.
But you proved me wrong, and I liked your change." Zhang Fei then planted a short kiss on Chang Wenjie's red lips.
"I promise I won't ignore or push you away again, and I will take you as my wife in the future."
"Yeah." Chang Wenjie then pulled Zhang Fei with him.
"I know we will go to the Xian capital after this, but I want you to accompany me first, and we can leave after that."
"All right."
Meanwhile, Zhou Xiaochuan's flying artifact had landed a little far from the demon island, and Zhou Fanzhi was already waiting for them there.
He immediately led Kong Zhi and his subordinates down, but his expression was filled with fury due to the absence of Zhou Shenxin.
In Zhou Xiaochuan's mind, Zhou Shenxin was still in the Xian Kingdom, which was much closer to the Demon Island than his kingdom.
Thus, she should have been able to arrive earlier than him.
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately contacted his daughter, but Zhou Shenxin did not respond in accordance with Zhang Fei's plan, which infuriated him even more.
"Try contacting my daughter, Old Kong."
"Did she not give you an answer?" After Zhou Xiaochuan shook his head, Kong Zhi tried to contact Zhou Shenxin, and the result was the same.
"She still doesn't respond to my calls."
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately turned his head and looked toward the distance, specifically toward the human island.
"Could something have happened to her?
She wouldn't dare disobey my orders, so I'm sure something happened to her."
"What about Zhou Hanling, Brother?
Didn't you send him to protect my niece?" Zhou Fanzhi asked him.
Zhou Xiaochuan nodded and contacted Zhou Hanling before informing them.
"He'll be here in a moment, but Shenxin isn't with him."
A while later, Zhou Hanling landed in front of them, and he informed Zhou Xiaochuan according to Zhang Fei's orders.
"Emperor, I have never stopped watching your daughter, and we had a meal together at Zhang Fei's restaurant that day.
However, she disappeared from my senses as soon as she entered her inn, and I have been looking for her for several days but still have had no luck.
I suspect that the mysterious person who attacked me back then had kidnapped her, but I don't know anything about that person's identity."
Zhou Xiaochuan turned to Kong Zhi, who immediately touched Zhou Hanling's chest to check his soul.
Soon after, he shook his head at the Zhou Emperor.
"I didn't find anything suspicious in his soul, so he shouldn't lie to you."
"I see." Zhou Xiaochuan nodded in understanding.
"Can we defeat Ximen Gui without my daughter?"
"Fifty-fifty." Kong Zhi's answer caused Zhou Xiaochuan to frown.
"Do you still want to continue with our plan?"
Zhou Xiaochuan did not answer Kong Zhi immediately, and he thought about their chances of winning first.
He felt that it was too risky to fight Ximen Gui without proper preparation, so he wanted to cancel his plan and return to his kingdom.
Xin Yanluo, who was monitoring the Zheng Clan, suddenly sent a voice transmission to Zhou Xiaochuan.
Naturally, she did it on Zhang Fei's orders, especially since he wanted to weaken him and Kong Zhi.
'Damn it!
That two female demons really want me dead!' Zhou Xiaochuan then answered Kong Zhi.
"We will continue with our plan, and we will move to the Ximen Demon Kingdom now.
However, we should not travel there by air; instead, we will infiltrate there by land."
For a while, Kong Zhi stared at Zhou Xiaochuan, feeling that his decision was too forceful.
"It will take us a few days to get there by land, and we have to pass through some tough areas on the way there."
"Let's go now." Zhou Xiaochuan immediately led Kong Zhi and the others across to the demon island.
Unknown to them, Feltia [2] was watching them from the air in an invisible state.
"Hehe!
Now everything is ready, so let's see if they can leave this island safely."
After that, Feltia [2] returned to the side of Fyr and the others who were still studying the method to master the darkness elemental law.
After she was unconscious for quite some time, Qu Qiuxue finally opened her eyes.
She felt her head was so heavy, especially since Wushuang hit her too hard.
"Damn it!
Who exactly is that woman?
Does she have a relationship with Huan Ya?
I don't even know her, but she suddenly attacked me out of nowhere."
Qu Qiuxue contacted her senior and informed him about the situation, prompting Wei Chou to urge her to return to the Yun Kingdom immediately.
He suspected Wushuang had a connection to Huangfu Shou and believed her to be powerful, particularly given her ability to easily knock down his junior.
After hearing that, Qu Qiuxue didn't waste any more time and hurriedly left the village.
However, her doubts about Wei Chao's suspicions caused many questions to arise in her mind about the relationship between Huan Ya, Wushuang, and Huangfu Shou.
After he had accompanied Chang Wenjie for some time, Zhang Fei brought him back to the residence to meet the others.
He then took them to the Xian royal palace, where Shi Qingzhuang had prepared rooms for them all.
After all, the distance between the residence and the Xian capital was too far, and the wedding ceremony would take place early in the morning.
Furthermore, due to the size of their group, staying there would be more convenient.
Upon their arrival, Xian Feng immediately asked Zhang Fei to accompany him.
They drank together and discussed several matters outside of the marriage.
"Do you think Zhou Xiaochuan and Kong Zhi will die at Ximen Gui's hands?" Xian Feng asked him.
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head.
"I still need them to support Shenxin, so I can't let them die.
My second clone is keeping an eye on them there, and I asked Xin Yanluo to save them if they are in a pinch."
Xian Feng nodded in understanding.
"What about Huangfu Shou?
Are you going to move against him soon?"

"For now, our main goal is to take down Zhou Xiaochuan and take over the Zhou Kingdom, and I will make plans to deal with Huangfu Shou after Li Tiannan returns to this realm." Zhang Fei then took a sip of his drink before continuing.
"His ancestors are too powerful, and we will be in big trouble if he finds out about our actions, so we must make thorough preparations before fighting him."
"I see." Xian Feng then patted Zhang Fei's shoulder.
"You will marry Qin'er tomorrow, so I will leave her safety in your hands, and you must protect her well."
"I will definitely protect Qin'er well."

chapters.title: Chapter 684 Capture Intruders
paragraphs: Two groups of people had just arrived at an area a short distance from the north gate of the Xian capital. A sexy and ravishing middle-aged woman led one group, clad in black. A burly middle-aged man, with a scar on his left cheek, led the other group, dressed in purple.
The middle-aged woman then ordered her members to infiltrate the Xian capital. Without wasting any time, they used their concealment techniques and carried out her order immediately.
Unlike them, the people dressed in purple did not infiltrate the Xian capital directly; instead, they took a destination and rushed toward the city's water source.

The middle-aged man tilted his head to the side and inquired. "Are you sure Xian Feng succeeded in capturing our disciples, He Ya? Didn't they leave with Prince Lian? Moreover, I heard that Emperor Shou ordered Huangfu Ziyuan to protect them, so they should be fine. Perhaps they simply haven't accomplished their mission, which is why they haven't returned to our sect."

"You're not wrong about that, Du She. They haven't finished their task in almost two weeks." He Ya answered as she focused her gaze toward the Xian royal palace. "Emperor Shou felt that Prince Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan were hiding something from him, so he contacted me and ordered me to track their whereabouts. At first, I didn't believe that Xuan Cunhua would fail in carrying out her task, especially since I was sure that Xian Feng and his aides wouldn't be able to track her using my concealment technique. However, I've tried to contact her several times, but she never responded to my messages."

Du She nodded in response. "I also sent a message to Meng Yunjie before we left for this kingdom, but she still hasn't replied to my message. If Xian Feng really managed to capture them, I'm sure he imprisoned them in his palace dungeon."

"I think so too. That's why I ordered my other disciples to check there and ask them to release Xuan Cunhua and Meng Yunjie if they are imprisoned there." He Ya then asked Du She. "What poison did you give your other disciples?"

"Emperor Shou didn't want them to die, so I didn't use my seven-colored poison, and I ordered them to mix my crimson fang poison into their water source." Du She answered while taking out a clear bottle. "This poison is enough to paralyze all their nerves, so we don't need to fight them. After Xian Feng and his family are exposed to my poison, we will immediately bring them to our emperor, and our sects will receive a luxurious reward from him."

"I've found Prince Lian and Huang Ziyuan's location, so we'll go there to meet them now." After she said that, He Ya grabbed Du She's shoulder and used her vanishing mirage steps, taking him away to the location of the two men.
A while later, He Ya and Du She arrived at the residence rented by Huangfu Ziyuan, and they immediately met him and Huangfu Lian.
'These foolish people! They shouldn't have come to us!' Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian promptly notified Zhang Fei about their arrival.

After he got the information, Zhang Fei immediately checked his map to check on them. He was certain that He Ya and Du She would not come alone, so he notified Xian Feng, who promptly instructed Old Feng and his other aides to track the whereabouts of the two intruders' disciples.

Then, Zhang Fei immediately met Shang Yumei and took her away to the residence, but they did not immediately capture He Ya and Du She. Instead, he brought her into an invisible state, eavesdropping on their conversation from the roof.
"Why did you two come here?" Huangfu Ziyuan asked them.

Du She shrugged before responding. "Isn't this your fault? Emperor Shou ordered you to help Prince Lian capture a brat with cultivation in the 2-Star Earth Realm, but you still haven't succeeded in doing so. Therefore, he sent me and He Ya here to help you, and our disciples have moved now."
"What are you two planning?" Huangfu Lian asked, looking calm but also tense in his heart.

He Ya answered him first. "Prince Lian, we have contacted our disciples, but they have not given us a reply. I ordered my disciples to infiltrate the Xian Palace, especially since I was certain that Xian Feng had already captured and imprisoned them there."
"I ordered my disciples to mix my crimson fang poison into their water source, and they would be paralyzed after they drank the water." Du She casually replied.
'This guy is looking for death!' Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian screamed in their hearts.
As they expected, a powerful aura immediately descended and suppressed He Ya and Du She, causing both of them to fall to the floor directly.

Du She was completely shocked by the pressure, especially considering he couldn't move a single finger. 'Fuck! Where did this powerful pressure come from? Xian Feng is not stronger than Emperor Shou, so he can't possibly suppress us to this extent.'
'Shit! I should have guessed that these two men were bait! But who owns this powerful pressure?' He Ya inwardly muttered with an expression full of shock.
*Tap... Tap...*
Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian were surprised to see the owner's footsteps, making them wonder, 'Who is this woman? How could her aura be so oppressive?'

Shang Yumei looked at Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian with disdain. She then kneeled beside He Ya and Du She, sealing their cultivation, making both of them even more helpless. "What are you going to do with them, darling?"

"I expected them to come sooner or later, but I haven't thought of a plan for them yet." He Ya and Du She immediately looked at Zhang Fei in shock. After all, his cultivation was still at the 2-Star Earth Realm, but he was able to obtain the heart of a powerful cultivator like Shang Yumei. "I don't need this guy, but I can't kill him either, especially since he's one of Huangfu Shou's confidants. Even so, I can use him to do something against the evil emperor, and he will definitely never notice."
"Are you going to enslave him?" Shang Yumei's question made Du She trembled heavily, especially considering how miserable being a slave was for him.
"No." Zhang Fei then squatted at Du She's side. "You are curious about my other abilities, right? I will show you the most interesting one, and you will definitely be shocked."
"Is that one of your abilities as a lust demon?" Shang Yumei's question shocked the four people, especially since they could not feel the demon aura from Zhang Fei's body.
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded and touched Du She's body. However, he first turned to Huangfu Lian. "Which of your father's concubines has a cultivation equal to this guy's?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei's question confused Huangfu Lian, but he told him anyway. "Ruo Yanxi has the same cultivation as Du She, and my father is very fond of her."

"Show me her image." Huangfu Lian immediately approached Zhang Fei and shared his memories of Ruo Yanxi with him. "Oh? It is unsurprising that your father is fond of her. Although she is quite attractive and seductive, she is still inferior to Yumei.
Shang Yumei snorted. "Humph! You shouldn't compare women from this small realm with me, especially since they will never be able to match me."

"Hahaha! You are indeed my sexy and seductive little fox, and I always enjoy myself with you." Zhang Fei then looked at Du She, whose face had turned pale with fear. He then took a cloth and stuffed it directly into his mouth, aware that the process would be extremely painful and he didn't want people to hear his screams. "I'll do it now."
"Hmm." Du She instantly grimaced as Zhang Fei used the body modification ability on him, which caused his entire body to be engulfed in excruciating pain. 'Ugh! What did he do to me?'

Shang Yumei raised her eyebrows slightly as she watched Du She's body begin to change. His muscular body gradually shrank, causing several other parts of his body to undergo changes, including the disappearance of his Adam's apple.

Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan took a deep breath, and their expressions looked horrified as they watched Du She's change. He Ya, who was still under the pressure of Shang Yumei's aura, also looked horrified.
Half an hour later, Huangfu Lian and Huang Ziyuan instantly collapsed onto their buttocks, their gazes fixed solely on Du She. Their bodies trembled, and cold sweat drenched them.
He Ya and Shang Yumei were also shocked to the point of being speechless, and the atmosphere in the residence became completely silent.
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei's laughter brought them back to their senses.

Shang Yumei immediately gave Zhang Fei a sharp look. "Your abilities are too insane! It's no surprise that you can deceive everyone about your age. You have the ability to transform a man into a woman."
"Amazing, right? No cultivator has such an ability, and only a few types of demons have it." Zhang Fei then turned to Huangfu Lian. "Explain to me about Ruo Yanxi's character and demeanor."
After Huangfu Lian explained to him in as much detail as possible, Zhang Fei immediately altered Du She's memories so that Huangfu Shou would not suspect him.

"Release him, Yumei." Shang Yumei immediately withdrew her aura back from Du She. "Go back to the Huangfu Kingdom! You must kidnap the original Ruo Yanxi, hide her in a safe place, and then take her place by Huangfu Shou's side. Additionally, you can administer the mildest poison you have to him, especially since I still need him alive."
"Yes, Master."

After Du She left, Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian exchanged strange glances. They were sure that Huangfu Shou would never know that Ruo Yanxi by his side was not the real one, and imagining them doing intimate things made them feel strange.
Zhang Fei then turned to Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian with a smirk. "Does one of you want to be a woman? That way, you two can have fun with each other."
"No! Please! We will obey all your orders, but don't do that to us." Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian speak with trembling voices.
Zhang Fei then turned to He Ya, but he did not enslave or change her memories. He simply duplicated her soul before merging it with his. "Release her and unseal her cultivation, Yumei."
"Are you sure that's enough?" Shang Yumei inquired as she lifted He Ya to her feet.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded before speaking to He Ya. "I didn't kill you because I needed you, but I can tell you that your life is in my hands now. I can kill you whenever I want, so you better think twice before going against me."
He Ya took a deep breath. "What do you need from me?"

"From now on, your Black Feng Sect is mine, and you must act according to my orders." He Ya nodded to Zhang Fei. "For the time being, I want some of your disciples to infiltrate the Huangfu royal palace to monitor Huangfu Shou's movements, and I want you to imprison Ruo Yanxi in the sect."
"Yes... yes..."

"I will release your subordinates, including Xuan Cunhua. You can wait for them outside the capital." After that, Zhang Fei took Shang Yumei back to the Xian royal palace, which relieved Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian.
He Ya then asked them. "Why don't you two report this to Emperor Shou?"
"Do you think we can do that?" Huangfu Ziyuan asked back with a frown. "Zhang Fei has planted his slave mark into our souls, preventing us from leaking any information about him."

Huangfu Lian also spoke to He Ya. "If you and Du She hadn't met us, you guys would never have experienced such a terrible fate. Moreover, Zhang Fei is a madman, and his abilities are too absurd. Even if he didn't enslave you, I dare to bet that you wouldn't be able to do anything to defy his order."
He Ya had already realized this, so she said nothing and left the two men's place. She waited for her disciples outside the Xian capital, as Zhang Fei had ordered.

When they arrived at the Xian royal palace, Xian Feng immediately informed Zhang Fei that his subordinates had captured all the disciples from both sects. "What are your plans for them? What about Du She and He Ya?"

"You can release all the disciples of the Black Feng Sect and let them meet He Ya outside the capital." Zhang Fei then informed Xian Feng of his plans for the sect. "As for the disciples from the Venomous Serpent Sect, I don't need them, so you can execute them if you want, including Meng Yunjie."
Xian Feng nodded in understanding. "All right, I will release all the sects of the Black Feng Sect, but I will not execute the disciples of the Venomous Serpent Sect, and I will only imprison them."

"You are an emperor, but your heart is too soft." Shang Yumei expressed her thoughts with a shake of her head. "Zhang Fei is much younger than you, but he is much more decisive and vicious than you. If you go to the upper realms with such a weak mentality and a weak heart, you will suffer losses yourself, and the people around you will also perish.'

"Yumei has always been like this, so you shouldn't mind her words. Anyway, I'll take a short rest, and I'll prepare for my wedding with Qin'er later." Zhang Fei immediately took Shang Yumei away with him, but she repeatedly looked at Xian Feng with a look of disdain, especially since he was too weak for an emperor.
"She was right, and I was indeed too weak as an emperor." Xian Feng then turned to leave and ordered his aides to bring all the disciples of the Black Feng Sect to meet He Ya outside the capital.

Before long, all the disciples of the Black Feng Sect, including Xuan Cunhua, stood in front of He Ya. Their expressions were filled with fear, and they feared that their sect master would punish them.
"Master, I—"
"You don't have to say anything." He Ya immediately stopped Xuan Cunhua before rubbing her head. "You are my best disciple, and I'm glad nothing bad happened to you."
Xuan Cunhua felt relieved after hearing that. "What are we going to do now, Master? Why did Emperor Xian suddenly release us from prison?"

"From now on, our sect is in Zhang Fei's control, so we will only move based on his orders." He Ya's answer shocked all of them. "You guys didn't witness what he did to Du She before, but I can tell you all that he is far more terrifying than Emperor Shou. You should not think about leaving our sect, especially since he has a way to find you all. If you do that, I'm afraid he will hunt you down and kill you all."
The disciples glanced at each other before nodding to He Ya. Xuan Cunhua then asked their master. "Does that mean Zhang Fei will be coming to our sect soon, Master?"

"That's for sure, but I don't know when he'll come." He Ya then turned to several other disciples. "Ji Gou, we will return to our sect now, but I want you to bring Zi Liang and Chang Qi to infiltrate the Huangfu royal palace. However, your only responsibility is to monitor Emperor Shou closely, and you must immediately report to me if he makes any movements."
"Yes, Master."
"Let's go back."

The day was getting late, but the Xian capital was becoming more lively and bustling, especially since the guests from the surrounding cities and other kingdoms who would attend the wedding had started to arrive.

One of these groups was the Han Clan from the Bai Kingdom. Since Zhang Fei told her that he was going to marry Xian Xianqin, Han Yuanzhi decided to take some of her family members to the Xian capital using their fastest flying artifact.

However, none of the other guests knew that Zhang Fei was going to marry Xian Xianqin, especially since he had asked Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang not to spread the news. Moreover, they were going to get married at the same time as Xian Xianwu and Yao Yin.
