[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
Three days quickly passed, and Zhang Fei immediately said goodbye to Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.
He brought Xian Xianqin into the training space afterward.
Xian Xianqin immediately joined Qian Ying and the others in the training ground, and Zhang Fei accompanied all his wives and women in the Cloud Mansion.
When the sun rose, Zhang Fei escorted everyone out of the training space.
They had been training for too long, and he asked them to rest for a day or two.
When they arrived outside, Feng Yao immediately told Zhang Fei that Meng Qi's flying artifact had just entered the Nine Stars Realm.
He immediately brought the phoenix princess to meet her, shocking her.
"How did you two know that I had arrived?" Meng Qi asked them.
Feng Yao told her directly.
"This flying artifact belongs to my mother and has our phoenix aura, so I know you've arrived."
"I see." Meng Qi nodded in understanding before asking Zhang Fei.
"Can you send me back to the Sky Jade Realm now?
I've been missing for several months, and I know my sister is worried about me, so I want to return to see her right away."
Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to open the gate to the Sky Jade Realm.
"You will arrive at the Chu Clan once you enter it, and you can use the teleportation device there to go to the Liu Clan in the southern river city."
"Thank you." Meng Qi replied with a soft sigh.
"Wait a minute." Meng Qi turned to Zhang Fei again.
"Are you interested in bringing your clan to move to this realm?
People from the Chu, Liu, Ye, Zhang, Zhu, Shen, and Chang clans live in this realm now.
If you are interested in that, you can discuss it with Meng Guanqiu first, and I will meet you two there in a few days."

After she spent several months in the Blossom Heaven Realm, Meng Qi naturally realized that the quality and quantity of Qi in the middle realms were much more useful to her and her clan members compared to their home realm.
Zhang Fei's offer was tempting to her, but she also couldn't decide on it directly.
"I will discuss this matter with Guanqiu first, and I will give you our answer when you meet us."
Following the disappearance of Meng Qi and the gate, Feng Yao immediately questioned Zhang Fei.
"Why did you change your mind about her?
Do you want to keep her by your side?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before shaking his head.
"As I said before, I don't know Meng Qi, so I haven't decided whether I will keep her by my side or not.
However, she has grown quite strong, and her Meng Clan is also quite large.
If they stay here, I can bring them into the demon fox group, and my group will grow bigger with them."
"You want to use them for your gain, huh?" Zhang Fei smiled at Feng Yao, who immediately stored her mother's flying artifact in her storage ring.
She then used her senses to check in the direction of the Zhou Kingdom.
"Your people seem to be starting to face difficulties, especially since powerful cultivators guard the inner and central areas of the kingdom.
If you don't step in to help them, they will definitely lose or die at their hands."
"You're right." Zhang Fei did not immediately decide.
Instead, his second clone moved first to monitor the movements of Zhou Xiaochuan and the others.
"They decided to give up and turn around."
"Are you going to let them return to their kingdom?"
Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao.
"I don't want Zhou Xiaochuan and Kong Zhi to die, so I'll let them go back.
Moreover, their condition is extremely poor, and they have suffered greatly from the demon beasts' attacks over the past few days.
I think this is my best chance to take action against them, but I can't do it alone, and I'll ask Shang Yumei to help me do it.
Once my business with them is finished, I will prepare myself to face Huangfu Shou.
Anyway, please help them so they can take over the entire kingdom faster."
"All right, I will help them, but I will only do it from behind, and they have to keep trying on their own."
After Feng Yao disappeared, Zhang Fei went straight to the Xian Capital to check on Han Bingxing's progress.
He wanted to open the third branch of his restaurant and shop as soon as possible, and she would become the chef for his restaurant.
Zhu Yan told Zhang Fei that Han Bingxing was ready for it, but she advised him to send someone familiar with Earth's dishes to assist her.
Although Liu Qingyu is not an Earthling, she has mastered cooking Earth's dishes, so Zhang Fei chose her to assist Han Bingxing in his new restaurant.
Moreover, Liu Hua decided to go to the Bai Kingdom, so she was the best choice since they were biological sisters.

After discussing his plans to open his new restaurant with Zhu Yan and Han Bingxing, Zhang Fei immediately returned to his residence and took Ru Xue to the Sky Jade Realm to retrieve all the medical equipment left there so they could open a clinic in the Xian capital.
In the sky above the demon island, Feltia [2] stood there with the female demons, watching Zhou Xiaochuan's flying artifact quickly leave the island.
Feltia [2] checked the Zheng Clan through her map, but she still did not find any signs that the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan would appear.
After he gave some instructions to Xin Yanluo, Feltia [2] brought Ashreth and the others to the portable mansion, especially since they had been training on the demon island for several days.
Their demon power had increased quite significantly, even though their demon ranks had not yet increased.
"Big Sis!" Meng Guanqiu shouted and ran out as soon as she saw Meng Qi enter their clan.
She hugged her big sister very tightly as tears started to fall from her eyes.
"I'm glad you're alive, Big Sis."
Meng Qi let out a soft sigh and hugged her little sister back.
"I'm sorry for worrying you, but I'm back now, and I won't leave you again."
"Yeah." Meng Guanqiu then released her hug from Meng Qi and looked her up and down.
"What happened to you?
Where did the space rift take you?
Why does it feel like you've changed so much?
Moreover, your cultivation is much higher than mine now."

"It'll take a long time to tell you everything, so we should go in now, and I'll tell you everything." Meng Guanqiu nodded and pulled Meng Qi away to her room, where they spent quite a bit of time together.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 With Two Women
paragraphs: "What do you think about that, Guanqiu?" Meng Qi asked her sister.

Meng Guanqiu nodded to her. "Honestly, Zhang Fei's offer is fantastic, and our Meng clan will be stronger if we go to the Nine Stars Realm. All members of those clans are his wives' families, so they naturally follow him to that realm. As for our clan, we don't have a good relationship with him, and we've only met him a few times, so I hesitate to accept his offer."

"That's why I didn't accept his offer right away, and I discussed it with you first." Meng Qi paused for a few moments. "However, an opportunity like this won't come twice, and we'll be the ones losing out if we let this chance go. Moreover, the Nine Stars Realm is much bigger than our realm, so we don't need to stay with them, and we can look for another place to relocate our clan."

Meng Guanqiu did not deny that they would be at a loss if they missed such a good opportunity. "Unfortunately, our clan members are too weak, and we only have two heaven realm cultivators. I think it is too risky for us to stay in other areas of the realm, and we cannot possibly protect ourselves if those powerful cultivators attack us. If that happens, we and our clan could be wiped out forever."

"What if we move them in the future?" Meng Guanqiu raised her eyebrows in response to Meng Qi's question. "We can hand over the affairs of our clan here to Meng Zhuo, and we will stay in that realm. Once we have become stronger and know more about the situation in that realm, we can ask Zhang Fei for help to move them there. Given that he personally offered us this opportunity, I believe he will be willing to assist us."

Upon hearing that, Meng Guanqiu fell into deep thought, considering Meng Qi's idea carefully. "I think we can do that, Big Sis. Although there are still many evil deeds happening in this realm, the situation is much more peaceful after those heretics disappear, so I think Meng Zhuo should be able to handle our clan's affairs while we're gone."

"In that case, you can discuss this matter with Meng Zhuo and the others first, and we will go with Zhang Fei to that realm when he comes to us." Meng Guanqiu immediately agreed and left Meng Qi to rest.
Meng Qi immediately sat cross-legged on the bed, but she somehow felt uneasy, as if something was bothering her mind. 'Sigh! I hope my guess is wrong.'

After they had sorted out all the medical equipment in the Sky Jade Realm, Zhang Fei stored everything in the system inventory. He then took Ru Xue to his shop and restaurant in the Heavenly Sword City to collect the earnings and replenish the stock, and they went to the Yin-Yang Pavilion to meet Shen Yang and Shen Hao afterward.

After all, Shen Yang helped Zhang Fei manage his shop in the southern river city, and Shen Hao helped him sell Earth's items in the sect, so he went to them to collect the earnings and replenish the stock.

Zhang Fei left Ru Xue in his room at the sect, and he went to see Li Mengmeng to ask her about the evil nine-tailed fox. Unfortunately, she had never heard of it, and she couldn't give him an answer on the matter. "Since you are the ten-tailed fox's successor, I think only you can deal with its evil soul. However, I do not recommend you absorb his evil soul, and it would be better if you destroy it when you have the power to do so."
"Why is that?"

"Shouldn't you already know the answer?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before nodding to Li Mengmeng. "Since his actions weakened himself, the ten-tailed fox must have had a special reason to discard his evil soul and imprison it in that place."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "At first, I thought I could strengthen my soul power if I absorbed his evil soul, but your words made me think again. However, I'm curious about the specific reasons behind the ten-tailed fox's decision, and I plan to wait until I meet his other souls before making a decision."

"I don't know where the ten-tailed fox's other souls are located, but one of them should be in my Evergreen Spirit Haven." Zhang Fei looked at Li Mengmeng in surprise. "Like in the spirit forest, he also left a statue of him in our sacred place. It never gave us any reaction, but I thought you could activate it, especially since you activated one before."

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh because the Evergreen Spirit Haven was located in the upper realms, and he still could not go there with his current strength and abilities. "I'll go back now, and I'll come back if I have any other questions for you."

"All right, you can come to me anytime you want." After Zhang Fei left, Li Mengmeng fell into deep thought, and his story about the evil nine-tailed fox weighed on her mind. "What exactly was the reason behind his decision to discard his evil soul? Could it be that he couldn't control his evil soul? Or did he do it for some other reason? Hmm? I'll see my grandfather now, as he might have some knowledge about the matter."
On the other hand, Zhang Fei went to look for the lily couple in their room, but he only found Hong Xuan there, and Ying Sha was nowhere to be found.
"Why did you come here again?" Hong Xuan asked Zhang Fei as soon as he sneaked into her room.
Zhang Fei smiled and walked toward Hong Xuan, gently lifting her chin. "Don't you already know my reason? I already said that I wanted you and Ying Sha, so I came here to see you."

"I admit that you are extraordinary, and your Yang Qi helped us break through one minor stage in less than a month." Hong Xuan then slapped Zhang Fei's hand away. "We will never be your partners, so you better forget about us and don't come to us again."

"Unfortunately, I'm not a man who gives up easily, and I will do anything to get what I want. Since I have set my sights on you two, you guys will definitely be mine one day in the future." Zhang Fei then placed several bottles of his Yang Qi in front of Hong Xuan, causing her to raise an eyebrow. "Before that, you two must cultivate as best as you can using my Yang Qi, or you guys will be too weak to follow me to the higher realms."

After Zhang Fei vanished, Hong Xuan sighed softly, took one of the bottles, and examined it. "After cultivating with his Yang Qi, I realized that normal cultivation was too slow for me. If this continues, Ying Sha and I will become dependent on his Yang Qi, and we won't be able to resist him anymore."
Despite her thoughts, Hong Xuan drank Zhang Fei's Yang Qi before cultivating it.
Zhang Fei and Ru Xue were already in the Xian Capital, walking together and looking for a suitable location for the clinic.
"Husband, isn't the second floor of your shop still empty?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Do you want to use the second floor for your clinic? Unfortunately, the place is not big, so you can only accept a few patients at a time."

"I think that's fine." Ru Xue replied with a nod. "My healing technique is not yet at its peak, so I can't possibly accept many patients at once. Moreover, Lingxue is always on standby there every day, so my patients can directly buy pills from her."

"Since you want it like that, we can install your medical equipment there, and you can start opening your clinic immediately." Zhang Fei then asked her. "What about the supply of modern medicine to treat illnesses that have nothing to do with cultivation?"
Ru Xue thought for some time before giving her answer. "I think I'll just focus on minor illnesses, so we don't have to buy a lot of medicine from Earth, and we'll just buy what we need."

"I don't know anything about modern medicine. You can compile the list of medicines by yourself, and I will ask Huang Rong's subordinates to purchase them according to your needs." After that, Zhang Fei brought Zhang Lingxue to the Sky Jade Shop, and they started renovating the second floor to use as her clinic.

After they had been in seclusion in the Guo Clan's lightning pond for a week, Zhong Yan and Angela successfully broke through to the second stage of the lightning body technique. Not only did their bodies gain strength, but they also significantly increased their lightning element to the advanced stage, and their lightning elemental law also reached the intermediate stage.

Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them. "For the time being, I will send you two back to the training ground. You can try to adapt to your new strength by using the battle simulation. Once you have perfectly adapted, I will bring you two to this place again."
"All right." Zhong Yan and Angela immediately agreed with that.

Before sending the two women to the training space, Zhang Fei [5] questioned Yun Xinyue. "Do you also want to go back there? This lightning pond isn't very useful for you, and it would be better if you focused on practicing using the gravity feature."
"Yeah, you're right." Yun Xinyue answered with a nod. "In that case, you can send the three of us there, and I will train with the others."

After he sent the three women into the training space, Zhang Fei [5] jumped onto Lei Que's back again. "Now that it's just the two of us, you can fly higher and enter the lightning source, and we will absorb this lightning directly from the source."
"Yes, Master."

In the secluded house, Zhang Xiaolong [3] soaked in the wooden tub while absorbing the Jianshen Liquid. Although his lightning body technique had reached the half-perfection stage, his body cultivation level had yet to break through to the Blood Condensing Stage, so he did not want to waste time.

Moreover, the situation in the Wasteland Realm remains calm and peaceful. The two women continued to inform Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the changes in the Shang Clan, allowing him to focus fully on improving his body cultivation level.
"What happened?" Hong Xinxin questioned Murong Qianying after noticing her ugly expression.
Murong Qianying released a soft sigh. "Chongyun just informed me that Shang Ziyuan already knows about Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin's situation, and she will come to this realm soon."
"Isn't that too late?"

Murong Qianying nodded at her. "Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin left this realm two weeks ago, and no one knows their destination. Moreover, this universe is so vast, and finding them in the vastness of the universe is much harder than finding a needle in a haystack. Anyway, we don't need to think about them, especially since Shang Ziyuan won't dare to do anything in Shang Huaqiang's absence."
"Where do you think Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan went?"

"Where else?" Murong Qianying responded with a shrug. "I still don't understand why Shang Huaqiang is so determined to take over the Sky Jade Realm, but the portal connecting the realms is now destroyed, so he can't use those demons to invade it. Therefore, I believe they went to the Xianjin Realm to buy another teleportation portal, but I heard that Senior Gong Ren has already rejected them, so they will go to Senior Cheng Gaoji to buy one."

"I see." Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding. "Unlike Senior Gong Ren, Senior Cheng Gaoji never thinks about the fate of others as long as he can get a lot of benefits, so I believe that he will be willing to sell his teleportation portal to Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was listening to their conversation, immediately asked, "Who is the best between Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji?"
"Gong Ren." Both women answered simultaneously. "He is the best formation array in the Xianyin Realm, and Cheng Gaoji's ability is second only to his."
"I recall that my children found you in the Netherworld Realm, so you should be familiar with many demons there, correct? Are you worried about them?" Murong Qianying asked him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I have lived in that realm for quite some time, and I know many good demons there, such as the Old Demon Tree, Arbeola. Even though he was powerful, he never intimidated me, and he always protected me from other demons. Big Sis Yaolin told me about Shang Huaqiang's attempt to control them through the fake demon emperor, but some people foiled his plan. Since they have regained their peace, I don't want them to live in oppression anymore."

"I can understand your feelings about those demons, but you can't do anything to help them. Once they get a teleportation device from Cheng Gaoji, I'm sure Shang Huaqiang will send someone to control those demons again, and he will definitely order them to invade the Sky Jade Realm right away." Murong Qianying rubbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head and continued. "Even we don't dare to fight them openly, so you can forget about them and focus on yourself."

Upon hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately devised plans in his mind to prevent it from happening. Back then, the portal was sealed by the ancestors of the Sky Jade Realm, so Shang Huaqiang couldn't directly invade the realm, and they had to break the seal first. However, if he used a new teleportation portal, the situation would change, and he could immediately order those demons to invade the realm. "Do you think Cheng Gaoji has a teleportation portal ready?"
"I can't say for sure, but he might have one ready."
Hong Xinxin then asked him. "Are you thinking of going to the Netherworld Realm to warn them?"

"I can't help them fight Shang Huaqiang, but I can at least tell them about this matter so they can prepare themselves. Unfortunately, my strength is still too low to go there by myself, and I also don't have a flying artifact." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, who immediately understood. "Aunt Xinxin and Aunt Qianying, please take me to that realm. I don't want them to suffer anymore, so I have to warn them."

Both women exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to each other. Hong Xinxin then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "We don't want you to worry about them disturbing your concentration, so we will take you to that realm after you finish absorbing the Jianshen Liquid, and we will arrive there in a day using my flying artifact. However, we cannot stay there for too long, and we must return to this realm immediately after you warn them."
"Yes, Aunt Xinxin." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and quickly absorbed the Jianshen Liquid again.
Hong Xinxin let out a soft sigh before pouring more of the Jianshen Liquid into the wooden tub. "His body cultivation level will probably breakthrough in a week."
"So soon?" Murong Qianying was shocked by that, especially since Hong Xinxin had told her some time ago that Zhang Xiaolong [3] needed three months to break through.

"At first, I was shocked because he took the risk of using the poisonous lightning grass to temper his internal organs, but he turned out to have poison immunity, and the poison had no effect on him." After Hong Xinxin said that, Murong Qianying immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock. "The thunderstorm three days ago was powerful, and I also used my lightning element on him for a whole day, which accelerated his progress."

Murong Qianying nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, it's not enough, and he still has to continue improving himself. As long as the two of us continue to help him, I'm sure he can break through to the Seven Divine Realms faster than we estimated."
"Yeah."

"Where else?" Murong Qianying responded with a shrug.
"I still don't understand why Shang Huaqiang is so determined to take over the Sky Jade Realm, but the portal connecting the realms is now destroyed, so he can't use those demons to invade it.
Therefore, I believe they went to the Xianjin Realm to buy another teleportation portal, but I heard that Senior Gong Ren has already rejected them, so they will go to Senior Cheng Gaoji to buy one."
"I see." Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding.

"Unlike Senior Gong Ren, Senior Cheng Gaoji never thinks about the fate of others as long as he can get a lot of benefits, so I believe that he will be willing to sell his teleportation portal to Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was listening to their conversation, immediately asked, "Who is the best between Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji?"
"Gong Ren." Both women answered simultaneously.
"He is the best formation array in the Xianyin Realm, and Cheng Gaoji's ability is second only to his."
"I recall that my children found you in the Netherworld Realm, so you should be familiar with many demons there, correct?
Are you worried about them?" Murong Qianying asked him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.
"I have lived in that realm for quite some time, and I know many good demons there, such as the Old Demon Tree, Arbeola.
Even though he was powerful, he never intimidated me, and he always protected me from other demons.
Big Sis Yaolin told me about Shang Huaqiang's attempt to control them through the fake demon emperor, but some people foiled his plan.
Since they have regained their peace, I don't want them to live in oppression anymore."
"I can understand your feelings about those demons, but you can't do anything to help them.

Once they get a teleportation device from Cheng Gaoji, I'm sure Shang Huaqiang will send someone to control those demons again, and he will definitely order them to invade the Sky Jade Realm right away." Murong Qianying rubbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head and continued.
"Even we don't dare to fight them openly, so you can forget about them and focus on yourself."
Upon hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately devised plans in his mind to prevent it from happening.
Back then, the portal was sealed by the ancestors of the Sky Jade Realm, so Shang Huaqiang couldn't directly invade the realm, and they had to break the seal first.
However, if he used a new teleportation portal, the situation would change, and he could immediately order those demons to invade the realm.
"Do you think Cheng Gaoji has a teleportation portal ready?"
"I can't say for sure, but he might have one ready."
Hong Xinxin then asked him.
"Are you thinking of going to the Netherworld Realm to warn them?"
"I can't help them fight Shang Huaqiang, but I can at least tell them about this matter so they can prepare themselves.
Unfortunately, my strength is still too low to go there by myself, and I also don't have a flying artifact." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, who immediately understood.
"Aunt Xinxin and Aunt Qianying, please take me to that realm.
I don't want them to suffer anymore, so I have to warn them."
Both women exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to each other.
Hong Xinxin then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"We don't want you to worry about them disturbing your concentration, so we will take you to that realm after you finish absorbing the Jianshen Liquid, and we will arrive there in a day using my flying artifact.
However, we cannot stay there for too long, and we must return to this realm immediately after you warn them."
"Yes, Aunt Xinxin." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and quickly absorbed the Jianshen Liquid again.
Hong Xinxin let out a soft sigh before pouring more of the Jianshen Liquid into the wooden tub.
"His body cultivation level will probably breakthrough in a week."
"So soon?" Murong Qianying was shocked by that, especially since Hong Xinxin had told her some time ago that Zhang Xiaolong [3] needed three months to break through.

"At first, I was shocked because he took the risk of using the poisonous lightning grass to temper his internal organs, but he turned out to have poison immunity, and the poison had no effect on him." After Hong Xinxin said that, Murong Qianying immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock.
"The thunderstorm three days ago was powerful, and I also used my lightning element on him for a whole day, which accelerated his progress."
Murong Qianying nodded in understanding.
"Unfortunately, it's not enough, and he still has to continue improving himself.
As long as the two of us continue to help him, I'm sure he can break through to the Seven Divine Realms faster than we estimated."
"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 689 Shang Ziyuan
paragraphs: *Bam... Bam... Bam...*

On top of the flying artifact, Kong Zhi kept kicking its side while continuing to curse. "Bastard! How could all the demon beasts have been on the rampage for so many days? They are clearly targeting us and want to kill us."

Like Kong Zhi, Zhou Xiaochuan also felt that the situation of those demon beasts was too strange. Their berserk state usually lasted only a few hours, but they went into berserk mode for several days nonstop. 'What exactly happened to those demon beasts? Moreover, Xin Yanluo is clearly on the island, and she should know our situation, yet she did not move to save us. Could it be that she purposefully incited them to kill me? Did her master order her to do that? What did I do wrong?'
Zhou Fanzhi, Zhou Fenghu, and the others were also frustrated by their previous situation. Furthermore, they sustained significant internal injuries, and their external injuries were equally severe.
"Hey! Xiaochuan! Are you still unable to contact Zhou Shenxin?" Kong Zhi asked with a frown.

Zhou Xiaochuan shook his head in response. "I have sent messages to her too many times, but she still hasn't responded to me. If my guess is correct, she has probably fallen into Zhang Fei's hands, so she can't reply to me. I have sent someone else to look for her in the Xian Kingdom, but he hasn't arrived there yet, so we can only wait."

"Who exactly is Zhang Fei?" Kong Zhi muttered to himself. "Zhou Shenxin has already mastered the soul whisper art to a high degree, and her cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. There's no way a brat with a cultivation at the ten mortal realms like him can fight her, let alone capture her."

"Unfortunately, I don't have clear information about Zhang Fei, but he was able to defeat Zhou Fang, and he even fought with Zhou Tong before." Kong Zhi looked at Zhou Xiaochuan with a frown. "His identity is too mysterious, so we can't underestimate him. I thought about looking for him myself, but I'll do it after my injuries recover."
Kong Zhi nodded slightly. "In that case, I will join you to capture Zhang Fei, and I will use my soul technique to force that brat to reveal all his secrets to us."
"All right."

Without them realizing it, Zhou Hanling, who was sitting a little far away from them, looked at them with an evil smile. 'Hahaha! You guys are too naive if you want to capture my master! You don't even realize that it was my master who caused those demon beasts to go berserk.'
After that, Zhou Hanling sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei, informing him about Zhou Xiaochuan and Kong Zhi's plans to capture him.

"Hmm?" An old man sitting behind a desk raised his eyebrows as two people walked into his room. "Oh? Why did you two come to me, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan? Don't you two have more confidence in Gong Ren's abilities than mine?"

"Senior Cheng Gaoji, you don't have to be so sarcastic to us." Fei Qinyuan spoke casually as she walked to the table and placed a fiery crystal on it. "We all know that your abilities are still below Senior Gong Ren's, and you already admit it, right? Anyway, he refused to sell his teleportation portal to us because of his relationship with the Phoenix Race, especially since Princess Yao was the one who thwarted our plans. That's why we came for you to buy one, and this Sunfire Crystal Core should be enough to buy one, right?"
"Hmm?" Cheng Gaoji immediately took the Sunfire Crystal Core and observed it seriously to ensure its authenticity. "How could the two of you be enemies of the Phoenix Princess?"

"We have never had any enmity with Princess Yao, but she suddenly interfered in our affairs, and she destroyed the portal to our target realm." Cheng Gaoji looked up at Shang Huaqiang with a questioning look. "You definitely won't be interested in that realm, especially since it's located in the lower realms. Even so, we have some goals there, so we want to take it over."
"Tell me the truth, or I won't sell you my teleportation portal to you two."

Shang Huaqiang's face darkened upon hearing that, but Fei Qinyuan immediately grabbed his hand to calm him. "A few hundred years ago, we received information about the existence of a powerful beast in that realm. The beast died long ago, but it left its inheritance there, and we want to get it."
"What kind of powerful beast? Is it one of those mythical beasts?"
Fei Qinyuan nodded at him. "The beast is the ancestor of the heavenly fox race, the one and only ten-tailed fox."
"What?" Cheng Gaoji exclaimed as he rose from his seat. "Are you sure that the beast is the ten-tailed fox?"

"Yes." Fei Qinyuan then told him. "The Sky Jade Realm used to be the Heavenly Wilderness Realm, and the ten-tailed fox moved it from the upper realms to the lower realms. Since then, it stayed in that realm to protect it, but it eventually died by splitting itself into the two ancestors of the heavenly fox, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing. Over the past hundreds of years, many people, including other mythical beasts, have tried to find it. Unfortunately, none of them found its inheritance, and they only found its statue. Even though we are not sure about the existence of its inheritance, we do not want to give up looking for it."

"Where did you two get that information?" Fei Qinyuan just smiled at Cheng Gaoji. "I will sell my teleportation portal to you two, but I don't just want this Sunfire Crystal Core; I also want a part of the ten-tailed fox's inheritance. If you don't agree, you can find someone else to buy one."

"I agree." Shang Huaqiang turned to his wife with a frown, but Fei Qinyuan immediately explained. 'We don't know whether the ten-tailed fox's inheritance is still in that realm or not, and Princess Yao might have taken it after the last incident. Moreover, Cheng Gaoji's status is different from ours, and he can set foot in the Sky Jade Realm directly. It would be better if we let him help us check into that realm directly, and we will order those demons to invade that realm once he finds the inheritance.'

Shang Huaqiang gave a light nod. 'However, this old man is too greedy, so we have to think of a way to prevent him from getting his hands on that inheritance, and we have to keep everything for ourselves.'

'Don't worry, I've thought about it, and this old man won't get anything.' Fei Qinyuan then extended his hand to Cheng Gaoji. "Please give me the teleportation portal, and you will immediately draw up our next plan. You can go directly to the Sky Jade Realm to track down the inheritance, and we will send those demons to take over the realm once you find it."

Cheng Gaoji immediately gave the teleportation portal to Fei Qinyuan. "You two can go back now, and I will go directly to the Sky Jade Realm. If I succeed in finding the inheritance, I will contact you two directly."
"I will wait for good news from you, Senior Cheng."

Following the departure of Fei Qinyuan and Shang Huaqiang, Cheng Gaoji promptly made preparations. Naturally, he knew that the two people would not let him get the inheritance so easily, so he also prepared himself to face their hidden plans against him. After he prepared everything, he immediately left the Xianjin Realm for the Sky Jade Realm.
After their flying artifacts left the Xianjin Realm, Shang Huaqiang unexpectedly received a voice transmission. "What the heck is going on? Since when were the two of them in a relationship?"
"What happened? Who are the two people you're referring to?" Fei Qinyuan asked her husband.

"Shang Baixi is in a relationship with Shang Xiaoyin, and they have already escaped from the Wasteland Realm to avoid exposing their relationship." Shang Huaqiang's answer shocked Fei Qinyuan. "I remember my sister sent him to help her daughter snatch a fox brat from Shang Yaolin, but I never knew that he had such a relationship with her."

"I personally never knew or heard that the two of them were in a relationship." Fei Qinyuan said with a nod. "Since when were Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin in a relationship? How did my sister-in-law know about their relationship?"

"Shang Jiali returned home and told her mother about their relationship, and Shang Jingyi immediately told my sister about it." Fei Qinyuan naturally knew that Shang Jiali was one of Shang Xiaoyin's three friends. "Anyway, I feel that there is something strange about the situation in the Wasteland Realm, especially since my sister told me that the little girl wants to marry Shang Wuzi."
"Huh?" Fei Qinyuan was surprised to hear that. "Wasn't Zhang Wuzi always infatuated with Shang Xinyu? Why did he suddenly change his mind and want to marry Shang Jiali?"

Shang Huaqiang shook his head. "Shang Jiali's decision coincided with the change in Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin's relationship, so I think something is going on in the Wasteland Realm that we don't know about, or else the four of them wouldn't have acted like that."
"I also feel that the changes in the four of them are too strange." Fei Qinyuan then asked. "Are you planning to send people to that realm to investigate this matter?"

"My sister decided to go to the realm, so I will let her handle this matter herself." Shang Huaqiang suddenly remembered something. "Two weeks ago, my sister told me that Hun Di came to the Wasteland realm, and he took some of our people with him to another realm."
"Who?"
"Shang Yingyue, Shang Yaolin, and Shang Guangming."

Fei Qinyuan was not surprised that Hun Di brought Shang Yingyue with him, especially since she was his disciple. However, she was confused about why he brought Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming with them, especially since the two had no relationship with him. "Which realm did they go to?"

"Shang Yingyue didn't tell my sister about their destination, and she only asked for permission to go with her master and bring those two with them." Shang Huaqiang's answer made Fei Qinyuan fall into thought. "Forget it! We don't need to think about them and let my sister handle everything, and we just need to focus on our goals in the Sky Jade Realm."

"Yeah." However, Fei Qinyuan felt uneasy about the sudden change in the situation in the Wasteland Realm, so she contacted her Fei Clan members to investigate the realm. "Who are we going to send to the Netherworld Realm this time?"

Shang Huaqiang immediately thought of a few names from his Shang Clan. "I will no longer send our younger generation; instead, I will send a few seniors from the branch clans. I always feel like Shang Chongyun, Shang Chenguang, and Shang Tinglong will betray us one day. Therefore, I will send them there so they won't be able to plan anything against us."

"Shang Chongyun is Murong Qianying's husband, and her Murong Clan has never liked you." Shang Huaqiang nodded to Fei Qinyuan. "Shang Tinglong is his brother, and he is very loyal to him. Moreover, Ran Keqing and her Ran Clan prefer the Murong Clan over us, so I believe we can seize this opportunity to eliminate them."
"Yes." Shang Huaqiang then asked her. "What do you think about Murong Qianying? What should we do to get rid of her and her Murong Clan?"

"Hmm?" Fei Qinyuan raised an eyebrow in thought. "Murong Qianying and her Murong Clan are too close to Hong Xinxin and her Hong Clan. If we make a move against them, I'm sure Hong Quan and Hong Chong will protect them. Both of them are stronger than us, so we have to ask for help from our seniors to fight both of them. If possible, we can ask them to kill both of them, and the Hong Clan will collapse without them."

Shang Huaqiang nodded repeatedly in response. "Once we arrive in our realm, we will meet our seniors directly. I hope they are willing to help us so we can solidify our clan's position there, and other clans will definitely not dare to think about going against us."
"All right." Fei Qinyuan immediately agreed with that. "I'm tired of dealing with those clans, and we should try to eliminate them quickly, starting with the Murong Clan."
"Yeah."

Ning Menghao, who was thinking about something, became tense as soon as a middle-aged woman walked out of the portal room. 'Crap! Why did she come here by herself? Does she already know about the disappearance of Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin?'

The middle-aged woman is none other than Shang Xiaoyin's mother, Shang Ziyuan. Despite her old age, her appearance is no less than a woman in her twenties, and she is no less sexy than Murong Qianying or Hong Xinxin, even though her figure is not as curvy as theirs.

Shang Ziyuan wore a tight black dress that exposed a large amount of skin around her neck and shoulders. Any man would drool over the two huge, round bumps on her chest. Her long, silky, dark hair falls to her waist. A black veil covered her face, preventing any men from seeing it.

Shang Ziyuan's black eyes looked calm and mellow, but they caused Ning Menghao's body to tremble uncontrollably until cold sweat flowed from his forehead. "Aunt... why did you suddenly come to this realm?"

Shang Ziyuan stretched her right palm forward, sucked Ning Menghao toward her, and tightly strangled his neck. "Why didn't you report to me about Shang Baishi's relationship with my daughter? Why did you let them leave this realm?

Although Shang Ziyuan's voice was gentle, Ning Menghao could feel the anger in her tone, and the murderous aura emanating from her body caused him to tremble even more. "Ahh... Aunt... let go of me first... I can explain everything."
"Explain to me now."

"When... when I arrived in this realm... Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin had already left... so I couldn't stop them." Shang Ziyuan narrowed her eyes at Ning Menghao, and it was clear that she did not believe him. "If... if you don't believe me... you can ask your daughter's friends... I learned about their departure from Shang Jiali and Shang Wuzi."

"Why didn't you report it to me right away?" Shang Ziyuan tightened her grip on Ning Menghao's neck, causing his face to become very red. "If you had reported it to me right away, I could have sent someone to chase after them, but you chose to keep their departure a secret from me. It's been two weeks since they left, and the universe is so vast, which means you deliberately caused trouble for me."
'Shit! I'm definitely going to die!' Ning Menghao tried to plead. "Aunt... please spare me... I didn't mean it... Ugh..."
"Do you really think I'll spare you after all this?" Shang Ziyuan then put her left hand on Ning Menghao's chest. "I warned you not to think of betraying me, but you didn't listen to my words."
"No... Ugh... please... spare me... Aunt."
"Too late."
*Boom*
*Splurt*

Ning Menghao's chest exploded as soon as Shang Ziyuan used her strength, causing his blood to spurt out and wet the room. Despite this, the blood did not spill onto her body in the slightest, and she immediately threw his corpse aside.

Shang Ziyuan immediately left the room, and her presence caused the representatives of the other clans to tremble in fear. However, she ignored them and left the fortress for the residence of the Shang Clan.

Murong Yinghua immediately contacted Murong Qianying, informing her of Shang Ziyuan's arrival and Ning Menghao's death. 'This is really bad! The situation on this island will be chaotic with her here!'

A while later, Shang Ziyuan arrived at the Shang Clan residence, but he became even more furious after he couldn't find Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu there. She then searched the entire northern island, but she was unable to locate them, particularly since the two women were in the secluded house with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others. "Where did those two damn girls go? Did they run away from this realm, too? The fox brat isn't here either, but he's Hun Di's disciple, so he probably went with them."

"What do you think about Murong Qianying?
What should we do to get rid of her and her Murong Clan?"
"Hmm?" Fei Qinyuan raised an eyebrow in thought.
"Murong Qianying and her Murong Clan are too close to Hong Xinxin and her Hong Clan.
If we make a move against them, I'm sure Hong Quan and Hong Chong will protect them.
Both of them are stronger than us, so we have to ask for help from our seniors to fight both of them.
If possible, we can ask them to kill both of them, and the Hong Clan will collapse without them."
Shang Huaqiang nodded repeatedly in response.
"Once we arrive in our realm, we will meet our seniors directly.
I hope they are willing to help us so we can solidify our clan's position there, and other clans will definitely not dare to think about going against us."
"All right." Fei Qinyuan immediately agreed with that.
"I'm tired of dealing with those clans, and we should try to eliminate them quickly, starting with the Murong Clan."
"Yeah."
Ning Menghao, who was thinking about something, became tense as soon as a middle-aged woman walked out of the portal room. 'Crap!
Why did she come here by herself?
Does she already know about the disappearance of Shang Baixi and Shang Xiaoyin?'
The middle-aged woman is none other than Shang Xiaoyin's mother, Shang Ziyuan.
Despite her old age, her appearance is no less than a woman in her twenties, and she is no less sexy than Murong Qianying or Hong Xinxin, even though her figure is not as curvy as theirs.
Shang Ziyuan wore a tight black dress that exposed a large amount of skin around her neck and shoulders.
Any man would drool over the two huge, round bumps on her chest.
Her long, silky, dark hair falls to her waist.
A black veil covered her face, preventing any men from seeing it.
Shang Ziyuan's black eyes looked calm and mellow, but they caused Ning Menghao's body to tremble uncontrollably until cold sweat flowed from his forehead.
"Aunt... why did you suddenly come to this realm?"
Shang Ziyuan stretched her right palm forward, sucked Ning Menghao toward her, and tightly strangled his neck.
"Why didn't you report to me about Shang Baishi's relationship with my daughter?
Why did you let them leave this realm?
Although Shang Ziyuan's voice was gentle, Ning Menghao could feel the anger in her tone, and the murderous aura emanating from her body caused him to tremble even more.
"Ahh...
Aunt... let go of me first...
I can explain everything."
"Explain to me now."
"When... when I arrived in this realm...
Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin had already left... so I couldn't stop them." Shang Ziyuan narrowed her eyes at Ning Menghao, and it was clear that she did not believe him.
"If... if you don't believe me... you can ask your daughter's friends...
I learned about their departure from Shang Jiali and Shang Wuzi."
"Why didn't you report it to me right away?" Shang Ziyuan tightened her grip on Ning Menghao's neck, causing his face to become very red.
"If you had reported it to me right away, I could have sent someone to chase after them, but you chose to keep their departure a secret from me.
It's been two weeks since they left, and the universe is so vast, which means you deliberately caused trouble for me."
'Shit!
I'm definitely going to die!' Ning Menghao tried to plead.
"Aunt... please spare me...
I didn't mean it...
Ugh..."
"Do you really think I'll spare you after all this?" Shang Ziyuan then put her left hand on Ning Menghao's chest.
"I warned you not to think of betraying me, but you didn't listen to my words."
Ugh... please... spare me...
Aunt."
"Too late."
*Boom*
*Splurt*
Ning Menghao's chest exploded as soon as Shang Ziyuan used her strength, causing his blood to spurt out and wet the room.
Despite this, the blood did not spill onto her body in the slightest, and she immediately threw his corpse aside.
Shang Ziyuan immediately left the room, and her presence caused the representatives of the other clans to tremble in fear.
However, she ignored them and left the fortress for the residence of the Shang Clan.
Murong Yinghua immediately contacted Murong Qianying, informing her of Shang Ziyuan's arrival and Ning Menghao's death. 'This is really bad!
The situation on this island will be chaotic with her here!'
A while later, Shang Ziyuan arrived at the Shang Clan residence, but he became even more furious after he couldn't find Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu there.
She then searched the entire northern island, but she was unable to locate them, particularly since the two women were in the secluded house with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others.
"Where did those two damn girls go?
Did they run away from this realm, too?
The fox brat isn't here either, but he's Hun Di's disciple, so he probably went with them."

chapters.title: Chapter 690 Shang Ziyuan's Abilities
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
Murong Qianying was completely shocked after listening to Murong Yinghuau's message. "Xinxin, Shang Ziyuan just arrived in this realm, and she killed Ning Menghao."
"What?" Hong Xinxin was also shocked. "Has she gone crazy? Why did she kill Ning Menghao?"

"Shang Ziyuan has indeed been crazy for a long time, right? None of her actions and thoughts are sound." Murong Qianying then looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I think we should leave this realm for now and take Long'er with us, or she will attack us if she finds out we are here."

"Hmm?" Hong Xinxin raised her eyebrows. "Shang Xiaoyin had already reported Long'er's presence in this realm to Shang Ziyuan, and she sent Shang Baishi here to help her daughter capture him. Instead, the two ended up in a taboo relationship, and she would probably blame him."

"That's right." Murong Qianying replied with an affirmative nod. "Shang Ziyuan never acts using her common sense, and she always acts based on her anger. Long'er's abilities might influence us, but I'm uncertain about their impact on her. Therefore, we should avoid taking any risks and take him away from this realm immediately."

"How can we take him away?" Hong Xinxin asked with a frown. "Shang Ziyuan is already in this realm now, and she will notice our presence here once we leave this house. Her speed is superior to ours, and she will definitely appear in front of us before we can take him away."

"Your worry is too much, Aunt Xinxin." Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately jumped out of the wooden tub. "We don't need to leave this house to escape, and I have another way to escape without Shang Ziyuan knowing. However, I want to know about her first, especially since Aunt Qianying doubts that my abilities will have any effect on her."

Murong Qianying explained to him directly. "Long'er, Shang Ziyuan was born with an unusual physique, and she can adjust her physique as she pleases, including making her body insensitive. Moreover, she is impervious to charm techniques and similar methods, and she has the ability to reflect them back against the user. That's why I doubt that your abilities will have any effect on her, and we will die if they don't affect her."

"What kind of physique is that?" Both women shook their heads at Zhang Xiaolong [3], then proceeded to share with him the information they had about Shang Ziyuan, which caused him to frown. "How can she be immune to charm techniques and whatnot?"

Hong Xinxin immediately answered him. "Behind her arrogant and ambitious nature, Shang Ziyuan is a genius among geniuses. She doesn't want to fall under anyone's control, so she tries to create a technique to counter charm or control techniques. Her intelligence and meticulousness enabled her to develop the Reversal Mirror Technique, and over the years, she created numerous other techniques that became her trademark. In fact, she was more terrible than her brother, and Shang Huaqiang didn't dare to contradict her if she had already decided something."

"The Reversal Mirror Technique, huh?" Without having to ask about the effects of the technique, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could already guess it straight away. "If her technique and physique are that great, she is my nemesis, and all my abilities will be useless against her."
"That's right." Hong Xinxin nodded to him. "Shang Ziyuan is indeed the nemesis of all charm or control technique users, so we should avoid her as much as possible."
They suddenly felt a powerful aura flying toward them. "Speak of the devil! Shang Ziyuan must want to find Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen in her daughter's secret place."
"Does she know about this house?"

"No." Murong Mengying shook her head in response. "Only I and a few of my clansmen know about this house, but we shouldn't take the risk of continuing to stay here, especially since Shang Ziyuan might be able to find it. By the way, what did you mean by your previous words? How can we escape without leaving this house?"

"Aunt Qianying, I've evolved once, and I gained some new abilities after my evolution. I've never shown them to you or Aunt Xinxin, but I've shown them to Big Sis Yaolin and Big Sis Xinyu. If we leave this place using one of my abilities, Shang Ziyuan won't be able to track us." With curious gazes, Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin gazed at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately dressed himself. "You don't have to look at me like that, and you two will find out after we meet Wu Lianzhi and the others."
Upon arriving at the living room, Murong Qianying explained the situation to Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen, who were shocked and frightened by the news.
"We have to leave this house now, so you guys pack up now." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen did not delay any longer and hurriedly packed their things.
"Why must we leave this house, Grandma Qianying?"

Murong Qianying rubbed Wu Lianzhi's head. "A wicked woman is looking for us, and she will kill us if she manages to find us. We have to leave this house, and Long'er will take us to hide somewhere else."
"Won't that evil woman be able to find us there?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at the little girl. "I promised your parents to protect you, remember? I will take you to the safest place, and that evil woman won't be able to find us there."
"I'll go wherever you take me, Long'er." Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and lifted Wu Lianzhi in his arms. "Can we inform my parents about our departure?"

"Unfortunately, we can't do that, and we can only contact them after they leave the Sun Tower." Wu Lianzhi seemed disappointed by that, but she could also understand her parents' situation. She then hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s neck and rested her head on his shoulder. "Don't worry, okay? They'll contact us once they get out of there, and we'll tell them at that time."

After Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen finished packing, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Mei to open the gate to the Azure Sky Realm, which shocked Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin. "Are you two coming with us?"
"Yes." Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin immediately nodded, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] led them all into the Azure Sky Realm.

"Is that gate part of your heavenly fox abilities, Long'er? How did you know about this realm?" Murong Qianying asked as she observed their surroundings, and she could immediately tell that the realm was also in the middle realms.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then led them to the nearest city. "The gate is indeed one of my abilities as a heavenly fox, and I obtained it after I evolved into two tails. However, my abilities are limited, and I can only go to realms that I have visited before. Anyway, this realm is the Azure Sky Realm, and my parents have brought me here once in the past. Unfortunately, we didn't stay here for too long, so I don't have any connections here."
"Doesn't that mean you can also return to the Netherworld Realm easily? Why are you hiding this ability from us?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose in response to Hong Xinxin's question. "Aunt Xinxin, there are too many dangerous enemies, so I can't possibly reveal my abilities carelessly, right? If it weren't for Shang Ziyuan's presence in the Wasteland Realm, I wouldn't use my abilities either. If too many people knew my abilities, they would definitely think of various ways to stop me, and I would be in danger if I couldn't escape from the enemy."
Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement before posing another question. "What other abilities did you gain after your evolution?"
"I gained one other ability, but I'll show you after we get a home in this realm."
Before long, they had arrived at the nearest city, the same city where Zhang Xiaolong [3] had hidden Linghu Yincheng and her three children.

Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin immediately looked for a house in that city, and it was not difficult for them to find one. Instead of renting, the two women decided to buy a fairly large house on the outskirts of the city so no one would bother them.
After they arrived at their new house, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately showed Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin another ability of his—the invisibility ability.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions shocked not only Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin but also Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen. Only Wu Lianzhi was not shocked by that, and the little girl walked around him while touching him.
As soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] reappeared, Murong Qianying immediately questioned him. "Can you take Xinxin and me into an invisible state?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately grabbed the hands of the two women and took them into an invisible state, but he only used it for a few moments. "Do you two want to use my abilities to do something?"
"Yes." Both women answered in unison.

Murong Mengxin then spoke. "We want to accompany you in this realm, but we believe the situation in the Red Sun Realm will be chaotic, so we have to return there now. However, Shang Ziyuan is in the Wasteland Realm, and we don't want her to know about our presence there."
"We want you to use your invisibility ability to take us back to our realm, especially since it's the only way to ensure Shang Ziyuan won't notice our presence." Hong Xinxin added.

"All right, I will take you two to that realm, but I will return to this realm directly." Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to go to the Red Sun Realm for a long time, but no one had any intention of taking him there, so he didn't want to waste the opportunity.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had two reasons for that. First, he guessed that if he went to that realm, the system would likely undergo an upgrade. Second, he still had matters pending with Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan, so he could go there whenever he was ready.
Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin immediately agreed, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not ready to explore their realm.

Before Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought them back, Hong Xinxin first gave him a storage ring and an interspatial communication device. "There are a thousand bottles of Jianshen Liquid inside, and you can use them until your body cultivation level reaches the third stage. After you reach the third stage, you can contact me directly, and I will prepare new liquid to help you break through to the fourth stage."

"Thank you, Aunt Xinxin." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Wu Lianzhi and the other two women. "If you want, you can go for a walk in this city. The cultivation of the people in this city is below yours, so you guys will be fine, and I'll be back here as soon as I can."
"Yay!" Wu Lianzhi cheered joyfully before holding Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen by the hand. "Let's go, big sisters! We'll walk around the city while waiting for Long'er to come back."
After spending some time in the secluded house, Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen became bored and immediately took Wu Lianzhi for a walk in the city.
"Let's go; you must send us to the Red Sun Realm now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought the two women back to the Wasteland Realm using his invisibility. On his map, Shang Ziyuan was located in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then brought both women to the fortress, but they didn't use the Shang Clan's portal; they used the Hong Clan's portal instead. This way, he could more easily pick up Hong Xinxin if he needed her help.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Red Sun Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]
[The system upgrade process to level 6 begins.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Red Sun Realm.]

'Hahahaha!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed with satisfaction in his heart as those notifications appeared. 'As expected! I hope the system will give me even better features, and we can become stronger faster with its help.'

'You can go back now, Long'er. Sister Qianying and I will go to see my grandfather and father.' After she said that, Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying immediately released Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hands from their waists, causing them to leave the invisible state. Both women hurriedly left the place, and they went to meet Hong Quan and Hong Chong.
'Hey, Mei! Can I return to the Azure Sky Realm before the system finishes upgrading?'

[Master, I think you should stay in this realm until the system finishes mapping this realm, and it won't take long, about one to two hours. Once it's done, you can return to that realm, and the system will continue the upgrading process.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding and immediately sat cross-legged in that place. 'If that's the case, I will cultivate here for the time being. The quality and quantity of Qi in the Nine Stars Realm is already very good, but the quality and quantity of Qi in this Red Sun Realm is even better.'

Shang Ziyuan had arrived at the underground pond, but his expression was growing increasingly furious because the beast blood pond had dried up. Moreover, most of the precious stones on the surrounding walls have been dug out, making the place completely worthless.

Shang Ziyuan let out a heavy sigh to calm herself down. "Could it be that Baishi and Xiaoyin dug up those precious stones and dried up this pond? Where are Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu hiding? Could it be that the two of them are hiding on another island? They are not in the residence, and they're not here either."
After some consideration, Shang Ziyuan decided to leave the place. However, the area inside began to collapse every time she walked forward, and it completely collapsed after she arrived outside.

Shang Ziyuan once again used her senses to check every area of the northern island, but she still could not find Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already moved them to the Azure Sky Realm.

Shang Ziyuan then flew high into the sky and checked the eastern and western islands without being detected by the demihuman and beast races, but her efforts were once again in vain. In the end, she decided to return to the fortress and contacted some people to meet her there.

In a few minutes, several people were already standing in front of Shang Ziyuan; two of those people were Shang Wuzi and Shang Jiali. However, they were horrified to find Ning Menghao's corpse still there.
"When did you two last see Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu?"

"Eh?" Shang Ziyuan's question surprised Shang Wuzi and Shang Jiali. "We last saw them before Xiaoyin left this realm, Aunt Ziyuan. After that, we didn't see them again, and we don't know where they went."
Shang Ziyuan scowled as she asked the two middle-aged women a question. "Did your two daughters tell you anything, Sun Jingwei and Kang Xiaoyi?"
"No." Kang Xiaoyi was the first to answer. "Yifen hasn't contacted me for two weeks, so I don't know where she went."
"Xinyu is the same, and she hasn't contacted me since she returned from our realm about a month ago." Sun Jingwei answered her as well.
After hearing that, Shang Ziyuan became lost in thought. "You two must contact your two daughters and use all means to force them to return to this realm, or I will punish you both."
Sun Jingwei and Kang Xiaoyi took a deep breath before nodding. "We will try to contact them now."

"Leave now and report to me the results as soon as possible." All of them hurriedly left the room, but Shang Ziyuan suddenly spoke again. "Wuzi! Take Ning Menghao's corpse and feed it to those beasts."
"Yes, Aunt Ziyuan." Shang Wuzi hurriedly carried Ning Menghao's corpse away, causing his blood to soak his body.
