"Thank you, Aunt Xinxin." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Wu Lianzhi and the other two women.
"If you want, you can go for a walk in this city.
The cultivation of the people in this city is below yours, so you guys will be fine, and I'll be back here as soon as I can."
"Yay!" Wu Lianzhi cheered joyfully before holding Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen by the hand.
"Let's go, big sisters!
We'll walk around the city while waiting for Long'er to come back."
After spending some time in the secluded house, Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen became bored and immediately took Wu Lianzhi for a walk in the city.
"Let's go; you must send us to the Red Sun Realm now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought the two women back to the Wasteland Realm using his invisibility.
On his map, Shang Ziyuan was located in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then brought both women to the fortress, but they didn't use the Shang Clan's portal; they used the Hong Clan's portal instead.
This way, he could more easily pick up Hong Xinxin if he needed her help.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Red Sun Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]
[The system upgrade process to level 6 begins.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Red Sun Realm.]
'Hahahaha!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed with satisfaction in his heart as those notifications appeared. 'As expected!
I hope the system will give me even better features, and we can become stronger faster with its help.'
'You can go back now, Long'er.

Sister Qianying and I will go to see my grandfather and father.' After she said that, Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying immediately released Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hands from their waists, causing them to leave the invisible state.
Both women hurriedly left the place, and they went to meet Hong Quan and Hong Chong.
'Hey, Mei!
Can I return to the Azure Sky Realm before the system finishes upgrading?'
[Master, I think you should stay in this realm until the system finishes mapping this realm, and it won't take long, about one to two hours.
Once it's done, you can return to that realm, and the system will continue the upgrading process.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding and immediately sat cross-legged in that place. 'If that's the case, I will cultivate here for the time being.
The quality and quantity of Qi in the Nine Stars Realm is already very good, but the quality and quantity of Qi in this Red Sun Realm is even better.'
Shang Ziyuan had arrived at the underground pond, but his expression was growing increasingly furious because the beast blood pond had dried up.
Moreover, most of the precious stones on the surrounding walls have been dug out, making the place completely worthless.
Shang Ziyuan let out a heavy sigh to calm herself down.
"Could it be that Baishi and Xiaoyin dug up those precious stones and dried up this pond?
Where are Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu hiding?
Could it be that the two of them are hiding on another island?
They are not in the residence, and they're not here either."
After some consideration, Shang Ziyuan decided to leave the place.
However, the area inside began to collapse every time she walked forward, and it completely collapsed after she arrived outside.

Shang Ziyuan once again used her senses to check every area of the northern island, but she still could not find Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already moved them to the Azure Sky Realm.
Shang Ziyuan then flew high into the sky and checked the eastern and western islands without being detected by the demihuman and beast races, but her efforts were once again in vain.
In the end, she decided to return to the fortress and contacted some people to meet her there.
In a few minutes, several people were already standing in front of Shang Ziyuan; two of those people were Shang Wuzi and Shang Jiali.
However, they were horrified to find Ning Menghao's corpse still there.
"When did you two last see Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu?"
"Eh?" Shang Ziyuan's question surprised Shang Wuzi and Shang Jiali.
"We last saw them before Xiaoyin left this realm, Aunt Ziyuan.
After that, we didn't see them again, and we don't know where they went."
Shang Ziyuan scowled as she asked the two middle-aged women a question.
"Did your two daughters tell you anything, Sun Jingwei and Kang Xiaoyi?"
"No." Kang Xiaoyi was the first to answer.
"Yifen hasn't contacted me for two weeks, so I don't know where she went."
"Xinyu is the same, and she hasn't contacted me since she returned from our realm about a month ago." Sun Jingwei answered her as well.
After hearing that, Shang Ziyuan became lost in thought.
"You two must contact your two daughters and use all means to force them to return to this realm, or I will punish you both."
Sun Jingwei and Kang Xiaoyi took a deep breath before nodding.
"We will try to contact them now."
"Leave now and report to me the results as soon as possible." All of them hurriedly left the room, but Shang Ziyuan suddenly spoke again.
"Wuzi!
Take Ning Menghao's corpse and feed it to those beasts."
"Yes, Aunt Ziyuan." Shang Wuzi hurriedly carried Ning Menghao's corpse away, causing his blood to soak his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 The Hong Clan
paragraphs: Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin were sitting in front of two old men. They were Hong Chong and Hong Quan, the patriarch and ancestor of the Hong Clan. An old woman and a middle-aged woman sat beside them, but they didn't say a word and listened to their conversation.
The two old men's expressions turned serious after Hong Xinxin told them about Shang Ziyuan's act of killing Ning Menghao.
"What do you think we should do now, Father? Should we help the Ning Clan?" Hong Chong asked Hong Quan.

Hong Quan deeply thought as he stroked his long white beard. "I believe we should leave Ning Yuzhong and Ning Xizhun to handle their own affairs. Even if Shang Ziyuan didn't kill Ning Menghao, the Ning Clan is too weak to be our ally. Instead, we must focus more on strengthening our alliance with the Hao, Qiao, Tie, and Huang Clans. We also still have to convince the Li, Wu, Ren, and Jin Clans to join us. As for the Wang and Dai Clans, those old folks were truly foolish, and they still think that siding with the Shang Clan is the best solution for their clans, so changing their minds is really difficult."

"That's true." Hong Chong nodded in response. "I still can't understand why Wang Jinghsan and Dai Guowei are so obedient to the Shang Clan, even though Shang Huaqiang has repeatedly exploited their Wang and Dai Clans."

Hong Quan let out a soft sigh before telling him. "Their ancestors owe a great debt to Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, especially since their clans should have been wiped out long ago if not for their help. Therefore, you should not be surprised if the two of them are loyal to the Shang Clan, and they will never stop fawning over the clan like mad dogs. Our other problem is those clans from the western region because they have their own agenda, so they will never join either side, and they will definitely wait for the opportunity for one side to be destroyed first before taking action. The Xi Clan is the most ambitious among the six clans, and Xi Hongyan is no less cunning than Shang Huaqiang. Moreover, the Xi Clan's strength is equal to ours, so we cannot be careless in opposing them."

"Grandpa, what do you think if I go to the Mai Clan?" Hong Chong and Hong Quan immediately looked at Hong Xinxin with raised eyebrows. "The Mai Clan is not as ambitious as the Xi Clan, and I have known Mai Xiaomeng for decades, so I understand her character to some extent. Moreover, she is in control of her clan now, so I think I might be able to persuade her to join our side. Even though her clan is not as strong as the Xi Clan, they will still be valuable allies for us."

"All right, you can visit Mai Xiaomeng to discuss this matter, but you must not tell her the details. If she leaks everything to Xi Hongyan, it will be a disaster for us." Hong Quan then asked Hong Xinxin. "Who is your new lover?"
"Huh?" Hong Xinxin pretended not to understand.
On Hong Xinxin's side, Murong Qianying chose to turn her face to the side, especially since Hong Quan glanced at her with a strange look.
Hong Chong and the two other women immediately looked at Hong Xinxin, and their expressions clearly showed that they were suspicious of her.

Hong Quan shook his head at his granddaughter's expression. "Do you think I don't know that you took so much Jianshen Liquid from our warehouse? Even with meticulous cleaning, you cannot conceal a man's Yang Qi in your body, and it certainly does not belong to Shang Guangming. Additionally, I can sense the same Yang Qi in Qianying's body, indicating that you two are in a relationship with the same man, as evidenced by her reaction."
'This old man's instincts are as sharp as ever.' Murong Qianying inwardly grumbled.
"Are you really in a relationship with another man, Qianying? What about your husband?" The old woman, who had been silent from the start, finally spoke.
The middle-aged woman also asked. "Qianying, why are you cheating on Shang Chongyun? Are you tired of him?"

'These people! Why are they interrogating me instead? They should be interrogating Xinxin and not me!' Murong Qianying let out a heavy sigh before answering the two women. "Grandma Cai Yinzhi! Aunt Yan Yizhen! You two should already be aware that I married Chongyun solely for his status as a member of the Shang Clan, and I never truly loved him. Actually, I never thought of cheating on him, but I was caught in a situation that I never expected, and I couldn't extricate myself from it."
"Who is that man? How could he pull you into such a situation? Why did Xinxin join you?" Cai Yinzhi asked as she glanced at her granddaughter.

"I'm sorry, Grandma Yinzhi. I can't tell you his identity now, and you will meet him when he is ready to go to the upper realms." Murong Qianying's words caused the four people to frown. "You guys don't have to look at me like that because I won't hide it. That man is indeed still young, and his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, but he is much more cunning than seniors like us."

"For the time being, we will not reveal his true identity for his safety, so I hope you can understand our decision." Hong Quan and the others looked at Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying with suspicious gazes. "Actually, I haven't been in a relationship with him for long, and we started dating about two weeks ago when I brought Hong Jingquan and Hong Liying to the Wasteland Realm."

"How did that man manage to seduce you? Why did you suddenly turn your back on Shang Guangming?" Hong Xinxin sighed softly at her mother's questions, but she immediately told them about the beginning of her relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing Yan Yizhen and the others to glare at Murong Qianying. "Are you sure you want him as your future husband?"

"Honestly, I haven't thought about our relationship that far, Mother. I feel comfortable and enjoy my time with him, but he's still too young now, and his future is still long, so I don't want to burden him with our relationship." Yan Yizhen sighed heavily at Hong Xinxin's response, particularly considering her age and the fact she still hadn't tied the knot. "Anyway, I can share a few details about him, which will undoubtedly surprise you all."
"Quickly! Tell us!"

"Haha." Hong Xinxin softly laughed before telling them a few things about Zhang Xiaolong [3], which shocked them. Her next words shocked them even more. "Anyway, he is Senior Hun Di's newest disciple, so you guys should already understand his talent and qualifications, right?"

Cai Yinzhi then spoke to her. "If everything you say about him is true, he has a bright future, especially with Hun Di behind him. However, his talent and potential will arouse the jealousy of many people, and they will definitely try hard to kill him if they know about him. Therefore, you and Qianying must protect him well, or he will die before he can grow."
Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin nodded at her. "That's why we chose to keep his identity a secret for the time being, so not many people know about him, and it can keep him away from danger."

"All right, we don't need to talk about that guy anymore, and you two can take care of him yourselves." Hong Quan then stood up from his seat. "You can go to the Mai Clan now, Xin'er. Your father and I will meet the people of those clans to discuss matters of the Ning Clan."
"Yes, Grandpa." After Hong Quan and Hong Chong left, Hong Xinxin asked Murong Qianying. "Do you want to join me to meet Mai Xiaomeng?"
"Sure." However, Murong Qianying suddenly received a voice transmission, and her face immediately darkened after listening to it.
"What happened?" Cai Yinzhi asked.

Murong Qianying tightly clenched her fists. "That bastard managed to get a teleportation portal from Cheng Gaoji! Chongyun informed me that Shang Huaqiang ordered him, Shang Chenguang, and Shang Tinglong to prepare to go to the Netherworld Realm. He asked them to leave once he and Fei Qinyuan returned to this realm."

"Shang Huaqiang appears to have harbored suspicions about you, and he intended to eliminate them in order to target you and the Murong Clan; otherwise, he wouldn't have taken such a decision." Murong Qianying nodded in agreement with Cai Yinzhi.
Yan Yizhen then asked her. "What are your plans next? Are you going to fight them openly?"

"Aunt Yizhen, you know that my Murong Clan cannot fight them openly, so I have to think of another way to save my clan's main members." Murong Qianying paused for a few moments before continuing. "The only person who can save my clan is my new partner, but I will observe the situation first. If the situation becomes too complicated and beyond my control, I will ask for his help to move them to another realm far from Shang Huaqiang's reach."

"I think that is the best choice for your clan." Yan Yizhen nodded in response. "If you need our help, you don't have to hesitate to say so, and we will help you to save your Murong Clan from Shang Huaqiang."
"Thank you." Murong Qianying then turned to Hong Xinxin. "Let's go to the Mai Clan now, especially since Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan will be back in a few days."
"All right."

Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still in the Hong Clan and eavesdropped on those people's conversations earlier, Zhang Fei [4] immediately brought Zilvora, Ilsath, and Orith back to the Netherworld Realm.
Zhang Fei [4] first took them to meet Arbeola and told the old demon tree about Shang Huaqiang's latest plan. "Can you warn the other demon kings and queens, Old Demon?"

"I can do that, but I'm not sure they'll listen to me." Arbeola then looked at Zilvora. "She's one of the demon queens, so her words will be more influential than mine. Additionally, you can go see Cain, and you can use your favorable relationship with him to inform King Oxgorth about this."
"Old Demon, you can try to warn them first, and I will go see Cain now." After Arbeola nodded, Zhang Fei [4] brought the three female demons to the northern mansion in Lust City.
Not long after, Zhang Fei [4] had explained everything to Cain, causing his face to darken. "I will tell my father about this matter, but I hope you can help me with one thing."
"What is it?"

"Alder, the wolf king." Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows in response to Cain's request. "That guy was supposed to be stronger than you, but he was never willing to help us, even though he lived in our realm and used our resources. My father and Queen Zilvora even tried to persuade him, but he drove them away. Since you are a demon cultivator like him, he might be willing to help us if you talk to him."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "I will try to talk to Alder, but I can't promise that he will be willing to help us."

"It's okay; you can at least try first." As soon as Zhang Fei [4] and the three female demons disappeared, Cain immediately contacted his father, King Oxgorth, informing him about the situation. "Sigh! Our realm hasn't regained peace for long, yet those human cultivators will invade here again soon."
A few minutes later, they had arrived at the Black Moon City. Zhang Fei [4] immediately released his heavenly fox aura and demon power to intimidate all the demon wolves that wanted to attack them.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately led them to Alder's residence, where they found him talking to his daughter, Tasha.

"Why did you suddenly come here?" Zhang Fei [4] briefly glanced at Tasha before sitting down in front of the wolf king and telling him the situation, causing Alder to frown. "I will help you, but on one condition."
"Tell me."

"I want you to take my daughter with you to your current realm so she can continue her cultivation there, and she will be safe from those who are trying to come after me." Tasha wanted to refuse her father, but Alder immediately stopped her. "You are the hope of our race, but you will never become strong as long as you stay in this realm with me. Therefore, I want you to go with Zhang Fei, and you can focus on your cultivation there. Once you become strong, you can return to this realm, and we will return to our realm to save your mother and the others then."

Hearing Alder mention her mother, Tasha's expression turned sad. She immediately agreed with her father. "All right, I will go with him, and I will cultivate seriously. Since you are here alone, you must take proper care of yourself, okay?"

"Haha." Alder laughed and rubbed Tasha's head. "I can even take you to escape from our realm, remember? I know quite a bit about the people from the Red Sun Realm, and they are not stronger than our enemies. You shouldn't worry about me, as I will be fine. Instead, you should concentrate on enhancing your cultivation in that realm."
"Yes, Father."
After Tasha finished packing, Zhang Fei [4] immediately sent her off to his residence in the Nine Stars Realm, and he asked Xu Ling'er to accompany her.
Zilvora suddenly asked Zhang Fei [4] to take her to meet some demon queens who were friendly with her. He immediately agreed to her request and took them on a tour of the Netherworld Realm.

Alder immediately gathered his wolf demon subordinates to discuss it, and he also invited Gu Tong and Chi Yang to join them, especially since they came from the Sky Jade Realm, which was Shang Huaqiang's main target.
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Nine Stars Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]

After the notification appeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately checked the areas in the realm. The Red Sun Realm was much larger than the Nine Stars Realm. However, the realm was unique because it was divided into five islands that were far from each other. The Hong Clan, along with the Shang, Murong, Qiao, Hao, and Deng Clans, was located on the southern island.

"Sigh! I will explore this realm in the future, and I will return to the Azure Sky Realm for now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] instructed Mei to open the gate to that realm, after which he immediately vanished from the Hong Clan.
By the time Zhang Fei and Ru Xue finished installing the medical equipment, the sun was almost setting, so he asked her to return to their residence first.

However, Ru Xue prefers to help Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters in their shop, especially since there are many buyers there. Zhang Fei does not mind this since they can return together via the teleportation device in their shop. He then went straight to the Bai Kingdom, or rather to the Han Clan, to meet Han Yuanzhi.
'This guy! He always comes and goes like a ghost.' Han Yuanzhi then asked Zhang Fei. "Why did you come to see me at this hour? Are you satisfied with your honeymoon with Princess Xianqin?"

"Qin'er is a good wife, and I am completely satisfied with our honeymoon." Zhang Fei then sat down in front of Han Yuanzhi. "Didn't you invite me to stay at this clan twice? Since I refused you twice before, I came here to fulfill your invitation, and I will spend the night here today."
"Oh?" Han Yuanzhi was taken aback for a moment, but she immediately remembered Zhang Fei's words at his wedding. "Were you really serious about what you said at that time?"

"Do you think I would joke about such a thing?" Zhang Fei then supported his chin with both hands. "I know you deliberately used Han Bingxing to get close to me, so I offered that to you. Have you thought about the answer?"

Xu Ling'er felt pleased to have Tasha by her side, especially since the people around her were adults, and she was the youngest among them.
Although the wolf girl was much older than her, her childish behavior made it comfortable for her to have a friend like her, and the two became close very quickly.
After they had walked around for almost a full day, Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu brought Wu Lianzi back to their residence in the Azure Sky Realm.
"Long'er!" Wu Lianzhi shouted as she ran towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just opened his eyes.
She immediately climbed onto his lap and leaned against his chest.
"Hehehe!
This city isn't big, but there are many interesting places outside the city, and we visited those places before.
Moreover, the people in this realm are kind and friendly, unlike in the Red Sun Realm or the Wasteland Realm."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and rubbed Wu Lianzhi's head.
"If you like this realm this much, we'll stay here until your parents come back from the Sun Tower.
However, you mustn't have fun every day and neglect your cultivation, okay?"
"Yes." Wu Lianzhi immediately jumped down and ran to her room.
"I'm sleepy and tired, so I'll sleep now and cultivate tomorrow."
After that, Shang Xinyu pulled Shang Yifen to sit at Zhang Xialong [3]'s side.
"Long'er, our mothers contacted us via long-distance communication, and they asked us to return because Shang Ziyuan threatened to punish them."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows.
"Aren't your parents supposed to be in the Hong Clan?
Why did your mother meet Shang Ziyuan?"

"My parents did live in the Hong Clan, but Shang Ziyuan contacted my mother and threatened that she would destroy her Sun Clan, so she had no choice but to meet her." Shang Xinyu then pointed to her friend.
"Yifen's parents still live in the Shang branch clan, so Aunt Xiaoyi can't avoid her."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding and thought of several ways to sort out the problems of the two women's families.
He immediately pulled out the interspatial communication device that Hong Xinxin had given him to contact her and Murong Qianying.
The two women immediately agreed to help their families, but they would only assist the main family.
"Aunt Qianying and Aunt Xinxin will do something about your two families, but they will only help the main members." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen let out a sigh of relief when they heard that.
"Contact your mothers and convey this matter to them so that they can prepare from now on."
"Yes." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen immediately contacted their mothers.
"They will prepare right away, but they must do it carefully, especially since Shang Ziyuan might have people watching them."
"I know." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Shang Yifen.
"Release your soul, and I will guide you to become a soul cultivator.
After that, we will engage in dual soul cultivation."
Shang Yifen was overjoyed and released her soul according to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s request.
Shang Xinyu also released her soul, especially since she had often had a dual soul cultivated with him and Shang Yaolin.
As he guided Shang Yifen to become a soul cultivator, Zhang Xiaolong [3] initiated dual soul cultivation with Shang Xinyu, a feat only he could accomplish.
"Phew!" Yuan Luo sighed with relief as she took a seat near a large tree.
"Brother, we've been in the Zhou Kingdom for ten days, and we've almost cleared up the inner area."
"Yeah." Ximen Chuixue replied with a nod.
"However, I feel that something is strange, especially since our task today has become easier than before."
"I agree with you." Bai Tian'er joined their conversation as she looked up at the night sky.
"I think Zhang Fei sent people to help us without us knowing."
"Who do you think Zhang Fei sent to help us?" Ru Yanyue asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 Huo Ling
paragraphs: Bai Tian'er thought for a moment, especially since she wasn't very familiar with the people around Zhang Fei. "If my guess is right, he sent Senior Feng Yao to help us, especially since she's the strongest among all his close people that I've met before."

"I think so, too." Ye Zhiqiu then showed four fingers. "So far, we've only met Senior Feng Yao, Boitata, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu. It's undeniable that she's the strongest among them, especially since her cultivation has reached the Divine Manifestation Realm. Have you ever met Zhang Fei's other women before?"
Bai Tian'er nodded to her. "I met three other women in Zhang Fei's shop, but I don't know their names. Additionally, he had a relationship with Huan Ya, and she acknowledged him as her master."
"Who is Huan Ya?" Ying Shanhu asked.

"Huan Ya is one of Lian Jianshu's five bodyguards, and Zhang Fei's shop is the former shop of the Alchemy Union." Ying Shanhu and the others looked at Bai Tian'er in shock. "I'm sure Senior Feng Yao helped him fight that organization, or else he wouldn't have been able to chase them out and take over their shop."

"Sigh." Yu Chongming suddenly sighed. "Zhang Fei is much younger than us, and his cultivation is far below ours, yet all his abilities make me feel inferior. If it weren't for him, some of us wouldn't have made it past the first floor of the Star Tower."
"I agree with you." Huang Chi spoke. "If it weren't for Zhang Fei's plans, Emperor Xian would have reconsidered sending us to invade this kingdom, and his plans have enabled us to proceed smoothly."
All of them nodded in agreement with Huang Chi. Yan Luo then asked. "Hey, Tian'er, did your mother attend the wedding of Zhang Fei and Princess Xianqin a few days ago?"

"Yes." Bai Tian'er responded with a nod. "My mother attended their wedding, and she told me that Zhang Fei had dozens of wives. She didn't know their identities because they closed themselves off from the public, but she said that one of them was powerful, and she might be stronger than Senior Feng Yao."

"Zhang Fei is truly a lucky man! So many beautiful and powerful women surround him! Despite being a woman, I can't help but feel envious of him." Yuan Luo then turned to Ximen Chuixue. "Brother, we must complete our tasks in this kingdom as soon as possible, especially since we will be getting married in three weeks."
Ximen Chuixue nodded to his future wife. "I want to complete our task here as quickly as possible, and I hope we can do so before our wedding day. Otherwise, we will have to postpone it."

"No!" Yuan Luo exclaimed, shaking his head. "I don't want to postpone our wedding! If we don't finish by then, I will arrange for Zhang Fei to pick us up, preventing the need to postpone our wedding."
"Haha." Ru Yanyue laughed at that. "Why are you so impatient to get married?"
"We have been lovers for a long time, so I want to marry Brother Chui as soon as possible." Yuan Luo glanced at Yu Chongming and asked. "What about you and Brother Yu? Don't you two like each other?"
Ru Yanyue and Yu Chongming immediately turned their faces away, as they had no intention of answering Yuan Luo's question. Their behavior amused Yan Luo and the others.
Yuan Luo then asked Bai Tian'er. "What about you? Does Zhang Fei still reject you?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" Bai Tian'er responded with a shake of her head. "We should rest now, and we will continue our journey early in the morning. Although Senior Feng Yao is protecting us, we cannot rely on her for everything, and we must still take turns guarding."
Xuan Wuji then spoke to her. "You, Yuan Luo, Ye Zhiqiu, and Ru Yanyue can rest first. The six of us will guard."

In another region of the Zhou Kingdom, Xian Qifeng was resting with his wife and team members, but their condition was not as good as Bai Tian'er's group, and some of them had suffered quite serious injuries.

After she examined their group members, Luo Qinglin immediately spoke to her husband. "I think we should rest for a day or two, or they won't be able to continue our fight with the people from the Zhou Kingdom."

"You are right." Xian Qifeng replied with a heavy sigh. "I didn't expect that Zhou Xiaochuan would place some powerful cultivators in our area, and the soldiers under them are not weak cultivators either, making us completely overwhelmed. Since most of them suffered quite serious injuries, we will rest here until they recover. If they encounter difficulties during their recovery, I will allow them to return using the returned jade."

Her husband's decision brought Luo Qinglin relief. "Who do you think helped us before? If it weren't for that mysterious person's help, we would never have been able to defeat Zhou Xiaochuan's subordinates, and we would have died at their hands."

"That mysterious person is definitely not my father and uncle's subordinate." Xian Qifeng paused for a few moments while thinking. "Perhaps Zhang Fei sent that person to help us, but I don't know the identities of the people by his side other than the female senior cultivator we met at the Star Tower."

"Her name is Feng Yao." Xian Qifeng nodded to Luo Qinglin. "She came to this realm from the upper realms, and her cultivation is higher than that of our parents, so I think she is indeed the mysterious person who helped us before."
Xian Qifeng then pulled Luo Qinglin into his arms. "You can rest first, and I will monitor the situation around us."
"All right, I will replace you later." Luo Qinglin immediately lay her head on her husband's shoulder and closed her eyes.

Meanwhile, Yun Aoxian's group had just arrived near the small waterfall. The female members, such as Li Yao and Su Zhen, were hurriedly cleaning their bodies. The men immediately made a bonfire and cleaned the wounds on their bodies.
"What about your injury, Qinghai?" Yun Aoxian asked his little brother.
Yun Qinghai shook his head. "My injuries are quite numerous, but none of them are serious. I have already taken a healing pill earlier, and all I need to do now is apply ointment to my injuries."

"That's good." Yun Aoxian nodded in relief. "Fortunately, our mother bought a lot of pills and ointments from Zhang Fei's shop, and their effects were much better than those of the Alchemy Union. Without them, we would have been seriously injured and unable to continue our journey."
"The people of the Zhou Kingdom sure are cunning, Brother Aoxian." Guo Jihai spoke. "They even used sneaky methods to attack us, and we would have died if that mysterious person hadn't helped us."

"You are too naive, Jihai." Guo Jihai frowned at Yun Aoxian. "In war, all means are lawful as long as we can achieve victory. Moreover, this kingdom is their territory, and they know it much better than we do. Therefore, we must exercise caution and thoughtful consideration before taking any action while remaining vigilant to any changes in the situation."
Guo Jihai let out a soft sigh. "Unlike you, I have never participated in a war, so I am not familiar with tactics and battlefields."
"I know." Yun Aoxian then asked him. "How about you join me at the army barracks? There, you can meet many soldiers who have experienced many wars, and you can learn directly from them."
"Hmm?" Guo Jihai thought for a moment before nodding in agreement. "All right, I will join you, but we have to finish this mission first."

Yun Aoxian looked far away. "We should be close to the core area of the Zhou Kingdom, and we will probably arrive at their capital in a few days, but we will not infiltrate there directly. Zhou Xiaochuan may be away from his kingdom, but there are too many powerful cultivators there, and the demons might help them."
Before long, Li Yao and Su Zhen had returned, so the three men took turns guarding and cleaning their bodies. After that, they immediately rested before continuing their journey tomorrow.

Above the Zhou Kingdom's sky, Feng Yao stood alone, watching the cultivators from the Yun and Xian Kingdoms. "Compared to Yun Aoxian and the others, Ximen Chuixue and his group are more worthy to be Zhang Fei's subordinates. However, Ye Zhiqiu has the greatest potential among them, but she will never be able to unleash her full potential before she goes to the upper realms. Bai Tian'er is not bad, but she is mentally weak, and she will meet a dead end sooner or later. If she can't overcome that, she will never be able to become a powerful cultivator, let alone become his subordinate."

Feng Yao then looked towards the east, particularly the location of the Bai Kingdom. "That brat has once again added another woman to his harem. Unfortunately, that woman had already reached her limit, and she wouldn't be able to progress any further, so she would no longer be of use to him when he reached her level."
[Master, why are you so eager to help Zhang Fei? Do you want to help him because he is the next ten-tailed fox? Or have you fallen in love with him?] A woman suddenly asked Feng Yao in her mind.

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed in response. A young woman materialized before her, her entire body composed of fire. "Huo Ling, we've been together for several lifetimes, so you should already know everything about me, right?"1

Huo Ling nodded to Feng Yao. [Well, I know everything about you. However, I feel that you have become much more cunning than in all your past lives, and you even fooled your current parents with your innocent looks.]

"I never fooled them." Feng Yao denied it with a shake of her head. "After all, they were born in these three mortal realms, so their minds are too shallow to understand me. Even those guys in the Star Tower, who were born in the Paradise Realm, couldn't see through me. Regarding Zhang Fei, he is simple to understand, yet he can also be difficult to understand at times."
[Oh? Even your nirvana eyes can't see through his mind and heart?]

"I can see his mind and heart with my nirvana eyes, but there is something inside him that often prevents me from investigating him more deeply. I have repeatedly checked his body, but I can't find the source." Feng Yao's answer confused Huo Ling. "Even if Zhang Fei succeeds in becoming the ten-tailed fox in the future, he is still not worthy to be my husband. If he wants to get me as his wife, he must first go to the Paradise Realm, where he will face many tough challenges."
[Do you think Zhang Fei can really set foot in our realm?]
"Yes." Feng Yao replied with an affirmative nod. "You have heard that the will of the universe summoned Zhang Fei and talked with him, so I believe he will succeed in setting foot in our realm."

[I hope you are right, Master. You've reincarnated several times in search of the right person, but you've never managed to find the one. Zhang Fei is the most unique person we have ever met, and if he fails, we will never succeed in finding the right person.]
Feng Yao smiled at that. "Don't worry, he won't fail."
After that, Huo Ling returned to Feng Yao's body, and the phoenix princess disappeared from that place immediately.
Zhang Fei had just finished having fun with Han Yuanzhi, who immediately fell asleep due to exhaustion. He immediately dressed and left the Han Clan, but he did not return to his residence.
Zhang Fei first went to the Bai royal palace, but he did not meet Huan Ya. Instead, he went underground, where he found a sealed door.
[Master, this formation is too strong for you right now, but you might be able to ask Fa Zhen for help to breach it.]
"Can you check the room behind it, Mei?"

[Unfortunately, this formation blocks the system's sensor, so I can't check the room behind it. If you are curious, you can use your third clone to meet and ask Linghu Yincheng. I'm sure she will know, as she is the empress of this kingdom.]

"My third clone is still dual soul cultivating with Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen, so I'll go see Linghu Yincheng later." As soon as Zhang Fei disappeared from the place, a black shadow appeared from under the sealed door, but it immediately disappeared back inside.
When Zhang Fei arrived at his residence, he found almost everyone busy cultivating in their respective rooms, with some already fast asleep.

However, Zhang Fei was surprised to find Shen Huang sitting alone near the southern ocean, especially considering that she almost never left her room each time he brought her out of the training space.
Zhang Fei quickly approached Shen Huang and inquired. "Why are you daydreaming here? Are you thinking about something?"
"I'm not thinking about anything." Shen Huang replied with a shake of his head. "I just want to enjoy the night sea breeze."

"Do you want to swim in the ocean?" Shen Huang turned to Zhang Fei with a raised eyebrow. "Hey! You are a sea serpent, and you are used to living in an underwater cave. Since we came to this realm, you have never once swum in the sea because the beasts inside are much stronger than you, so I thought you missed swimming in the sea."
Shen Huang nodded at him. "You're right; I miss swimming in the sea freely like in the past."

"So what are we waiting for?" Zhang Fei extended his hand to Shen Huang. "I will accompany you on your swim, and I will use my heavenly fox aura to keep those aquatic beasts away from us, allowing you to swim to your heart's content."
"All right."

Once they arrived there, they immediately jumped into the ocean, and Shen Huang transformed into her sea serpent form before swimming quickly. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei swam beside her without any Qi protection and spread his heavenly fox aura as far as possible, preventing those aquatic beasts from approaching.
'How can you breathe underwater?'

Zhang Fei told Shen Huang directly. 'I've been mimicking Angela's alternate respiration ability for a long time, but I hardly ever use it because I rarely go underwater. As long as I use her ability, I can breathe freely underwater like aquatic beasts.'
'Shall we swim to the seabed?'

'Sure!' Zhang Fei's transformation into a black sea serpent left Shen Huang stunned. 'Why are you stunned? I have a special transformation technique thanks to my demon form; I can transform myself into all types of demons, including this serpent demon.'
'Do you know that nothing about you is normal?'
'Hahaha!
After that, Zhang Fei and Shen Huang swam to the seabed, and they spent some time together there until two notifications appeared in his mind.
[Ding]
[ Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
Shortly after, both of them hurried back to the surface and returned to their human forms, but Zhang Fei suddenly pushed Shen Huang down onto the beach sand. "What are you doing?"
"Why don't you still want to admit your feelings to me?" Zhang Fei asked her back.

"I've told you too many times that I don't have any feelings for you." Shen Huang denied it by shaking her head. "I've always been grateful for the help and opportunities you've given me, but I really don't want to have those kinds of feelings anymore."
"Is that so?" Shen Huang wanted to deny it again, but Zhang Fei immediately sealed her lips, causing her eyes to widen.
Shen Huang wanted to push Zhang Fei back, but her body suddenly heated up and reacted to his kiss, especially since he used his enhanced demon touch on her.
'Ugh! Does he want to force me to be his woman?' As her lust was aroused, Shen Huang closed her eyes and returned Zhang Fei's kiss, which delighted him.
Zhang Fei became bolder by leading Shen Huang into a passionate French kiss, but he did nothing else to her besides kissing her.
Huo Ling means fire spirit.

"Would you be sad if I killed Zhou Xiaochuan?"

"I don't know." Jiang Tingxi once again let out a heavy sigh before continuing. "At first, I married Zhou Xiaochuan because I had no other choice, especially since he threatened to destroy my Jiang Clan. "This is my residence, and all my family lives here. They are either sleeping or cultivating now, but you will meet them this morning." Zhang Fei then led the two women to Zhou Shenxin's room and dropped Jiang Tingxi there. "You guys can rest first, and I'll do something else."

After Zhang Fei left, Jiang Tingxi looked around the room in disbelief, especially at the many modern pieces of furniture. She then pulled Zhou Shenxin to lie down beside her and said. "Tell me everything about him."

"Even though I don't know Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue in person, I know that princesses like them would never possibly accept you if you were unfair.
By the way, are you going to kill my husband?"
"Would you be sad if I killed Zhou Xiaochuan?"
"I don't know." Jiang Tingxi once again let out a heavy sigh before continuing.
"At first, I married Zhou Xiaochuan because I had no other choice, especially since he threatened to destroy my Jiang Clan.
Despite his lack of true love for me, his desire for my body, and his unfair treatment of me and my daughter, we have been husband and wife for hundreds of years.
Therefore, I don't know if I would be sad if he died in your hands."
"I can understand your feelings, but you should learn to forget him." Jiang Tingxi responded to Zhang Fei with a frown.
"Even if I don't kill Zhou Xiaochuan, he will no longer be himself, and he will only be a puppet to support Shenxin to ascend as the empress of this kingdom."
"Huh?" Jiang Tingxi was shocked to hear that.
"Are you serious about making my daughter the empress to replace her father?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Shenxin will ascend to the throne, and Zhou Xiaochuan will stand by her side to confront those who oppose her.
Besides him, Kong Zi and others will support her, and no one will dare to oppose her."
"That's—"
"I've packed everything, so let's leave now, and you two can continue your conversation later." Zhou Shenxin suddenly said as she approached them.
Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to his residence and brought the two women there, which shocked Jiang Tingxi.
She then looked around the area, finding many buildings there.
"Where are we?
How could you bring us here so quickly?"
"This is my residence, and all my family lives here.
They are either sleeping or cultivating now, but you will meet them this morning." Zhang Fei then led the two women to Zhou Shenxin's room and dropped Jiang Tingxi there.
"You guys can rest first, and I'll do something else."
After Zhang Fei left, Jiang Tingxi looked around the room in disbelief, especially at the many modern pieces of furniture.
She then pulled Zhou Shenxin to lie down beside her and said.
"Tell me everything about him."

chapters.title: Chapter 695 Zhang Yue's Idea
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei?" The six men on guard were surprised by his sudden appearance, but then they glanced at Shang Yumei at his side. 'She is much stronger than Senior Feng Yao!'
Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the Xian Kingdom. "There have been some changes in the situation, and Zhou Xiaochuan will be back in two days, so I want you all to go back now."
"Then—"

"It's okay." Zhang Fei interrupted Ximen Chuixue. "I will also send the others back, and the two of us will deal with Zhou Xiaochuan's confidants ourselves. As for the people from the other sects, Emperor Xian should have ordered them to retreat."

Ximen Chuixue and the other five men immediately agreed and woke the four women. Yuan Lao and the three women were surprised by Zhang Fei's presence, but they were even more surprised by Shang Yumei's presence by his side.
Unlike Ye Zhiqiu and the other two, Bai Tian'er looked sad after she saw Shang Yumei, who was hugging Zhang Fei's arm intimately. "Enter the portal now, and you guys will arrive at our kingdom."
"Let's go." Ximen Chuixue immediately led his group members, but Bai Tian'er seemed reluctant to leave, and she wanted to be with Zhang Fei.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei maintained an indifferent attitude toward Bai Tian'er, which caused her to sigh deeply and immediately follow the others.
"Why are you indifferent to that woman? Isn't she beautiful and sexy?" Shang Yumei inquired after Zhang Fei had closed the portal.

Zhang Fei nodded in response. "I admit that Bai Tian'er is indeed beautiful and sexy, but I am not interested in her because of her character. Actually, she is not much different from you, and she likes to use men for her benefit. At the same time, she is also different from you, but I can't explain the difference between the two of you in words."

"Hmm?" Shang Yumei contemplated for a moment. "Bai Tian'er's mentality and cultivation are weak, and she lacks the ability to support her actions, leaving her completely dependent on her victims. As for me, I never depend on my victims, and I always milk their resources dry. If they turn against me, I just need to kill them."
"Maybe." Zhang Fei searched for the location of Zhou Xiaochuan's remaining subordinates, and he informed Shang Yumei, who immediately moved to capture them.
"Do you intend to speed up your plans?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao, who had just landed in front of him. "Zhou Xiaochuan and Kong Zi wanted to hunt me down, so I decided to speed up my plans. Their current circumstances will overwhelm them, leaving them with little time to search for me. After this, all I need to do is wait for Nanfeng Yunxi to arrive in this realm, and once I speak with her, I will bring them into seclusion."
"What are your plans for Nanfeng Yunxi?" Feng Yao asked again.

"I don't have any plans for Nanfeng Yunxi yet." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "She is indeed part of the Alchemy Union, but we have no enmity with each other, and her higher-ups intentionally used her as bait to approach me. I will talk to her first, and I will make a decision depending on her attitude."

"I don't know Nanfeng Yunxi's alchemy abilities or alchemist rank yet, but she is Xiu Hanyu's direct disciple. If you can convince her to side with you, she will be a useful ally for you, and she might be able to help you take over the Alchemy Union." Feng Yao's last sentence surprised Zhang Fei, especially since he had not thought that far ahead. "As you already know, that organization controls the entire alchemy market in these middle realms, and there are many excellent alchemists in it. If you take over that organization, it will become your extension, allowing you to control all realms in these middle realms."

Zhang Fei was certainly interested in Feng Yao's idea, especially since it was in line with his plans for the future. However, he felt that it was still too far out of reach, so he didn't want to think about it for now. "Please help me capture them."
"All right."
After Feng Yao disappeared, Zhang Fei went to see Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin. He immediately sent their group and several other groups from that kingdom back to the Xian Kingdom.

Zhang Fei then searched for Yun Aoxian's group on the map, but he was unable to locate them in the Zhou Kingdom. He was certain that they had immediately returned to the Yun Kingdom following Yun Shang's order.
Later, Shang Yumei and Feng Yao returned to Zhang Fei, bringing with them many of Zhou Xiaochuan's subordinates, including those previously captured by all those groups.

Zhang Fei immediately took action against them, surprising the two women, particularly Feng Yao. "Originally, I thought you would hand them over to Zhou Shenxin, so I didn't expect that you would keep them by your side."

"Weren't you the one who told me not to trust other people easily?" Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei. "I trust Zhou Shenxin, but I trust my gut feeling more. I can't explain my feelings about her to you, but I feel that I can't leave everything to her, so I decided to keep them by my side, at least for now."
"What about me? Do you trust me?" Feng Yao asked with a smile.
"Do you want to hear the truth?" Feng Yao gave Zhang Fei a light nod. "The truth is I don't trust you completely, especially since you repeatedly tried to probe me with your eye technique."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei's answer greatly surprised Feng Yao. "How did you notice my actions? Not even my parents could notice my actions, and you are the first person to notice my eye ability."
"Secret." Zhang Fei replied with a wink. "Aside from you, I also harbor a bad feeling about Feng Jinqiu, and I feel that she has ulterior motives toward my big sister."

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed upon hearing that. "Whether you believe me or not, I dare say that I have no ill intentions toward you. However, you are correct that I have a specific purpose to delve deeper into your life, but I won't reveal it to you just yet. You will learn everything once you reach the Seven Divine Realms."
"Are you really going to tell me everything when I break through to the Seven Divine Realms?" Zhang Fei doubtfully asked.

"I swear I'll tell you a lot of things once you reach that stage." Zhang Fei still looked doubtful even though Feng Yao had said that. "As for Feng Jinqiu, I dare to guarantee that she has no evil intentions toward Zhang Yue. However, your big sister is part of her ice phoenix race now, and she has to go to the Frozen Lotus Basin to face the first and last trial of the ice phoenix."
"A trial of the ice phoenix?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei. "Since I am a fire phoenix, I don't know about the ice phoenix trial, so I can't tell you anything about it. Anyway, you don't need to ask Feng Jinqiu about it, especially since I'm confident that she won't tell you. She will only tell Zhang Yue when your big sister is ready to go there."
Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that. He felt that the Ice Phoenix trial was not a good thing, forcing him to reconsider bringing Zhang Yue to the Frozen Lotus Basin.

Observing Zhang Fei's expression, Feng Yao gave him a pat on the shoulder. "Rather than thinking about that, you should focus on helping Zhang Yue improve herself. I don't know anything about the Ice Phoenix trial, but I can tell you that your big sister will be the strongest among your harem members if she manages to pass it; not even the nine-tailed demon fox can match her at that time."

Shang Yumei, who had only been listening to them, finally spoke. "Princess Yao is right, Zhang Fei. The ice phoenix is one of the strongest mythical beasts, and her ice is extremely freezing. If your big sister succeeds in going through the trial and obtains her inheritance, she will become truly powerful."
"Did Huli Yaohu tell you about that?"
"Yes." Shang Yumei answered Zhang Fei with a nod. "My master once fought with the ice phoenix, and she forced her to flee, or else she would freeze to death."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, especially since the nine-tailed demon fox was no less powerful and arrogant than the other mythical beasts. "All right, I will help my big sis prepare herself as best as possible before I bring her to the Frozen Lotus Basin, and she will not fail to pass the Ice Phoenix trial."
After he gave some instructions to Zhou Xiaochuan's subordinates, Zhang Fei brought Shang Yumei and Feng Yao back to his residence, and those people hurriedly left to carry out his orders.

Zhang Fei then went to Zhang Yue's room, but she was immersed in her cultivation. Although her room was extremely cold, she controlled her cold well so it did not spread throughout the building. 'Her control in the ice element is truly amazingly skilled. If I were in her shoes, I'm not sure if I could control it like she did.'

Noticing Zhang Fei's presence, Zhang Yue immediately pulled her ice element back and suppressed her cold. She hurriedly opened her eyes and smiled at her little brother. "Why did you come here? Did you miss me?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then lifted Zhang Yue to her feet. "I missed you and wanted to eat you, so I came here to see you."

Zhang Yue put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck and pressed their foreheads together. "Since my husband wants to eat me, I will fulfill your wish. How about we do it in the open? I will use one of my techniques when we do it, and it might be able to help you gain resistance to the ice element. However, we can't do it inside your training space, and we have to do it in a deserted place, or everything around us will freeze. Besides, I have an idea for a technique, and I want to try to create one with you."
"Do you really want to create a technique?" Zhang Fei asked in surprise, especially since he had never thought of creating his own technique.

Zhang Yue nodded before sharing her thoughts with Zhang Fei. "Over the past few days, I've been contemplating a specific idea. I was thinking whether we could combine our ice and fire elements to create a combined technique, and I believe the effect would be tremendous if we could do it."
"Big sis, you know that fire and ice are opposites of each other, right?"
"Naturally, I know that, but I still want to try it."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at Zhang Yue's serious expression. "All right, we can try, but I'm not sure that it will work."
"Hehe." Zhang Yue giggled and briefly kissed Zhang Fei. "Let's go now! We have to find a deserted place to try it."
A while later, they arrived at a small island in the middle of the southern ocean, and Zhang Yue immediately activated her ice element before using one of her ice techniques.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows as Zhang Yue's ice element spread to the surrounding area. It enveloped the entire island before forming an ice dome, causing the entire area to freeze. He hurriedly channeled his fire element throughout his body, especially since the cold pierced his bones and almost froze his body. "So how are we going to do it?"

"Try using your ordinary fire and dark fire together." Zhang Fei immediately opened both his palms, and two different fires appeared above them. Zhang Yue immediately used her ice to freeze both of them, but only his ordinary fire froze, leaving his dark fire untouched. "As expected, my ice is unable to freeze your dark fire because you have infused it with your darkness element."
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then withdrew both fires. "So, what do you think we should do to create that combined technique?"

"Before we begin, we should first attempt to combine my ice and your dark fire at a low intensity to achieve equilibrium. Once we successfully achieve equilibrium, we will gradually increase both elements." Zhang Fei gazed at his elder sister with astonishment. Zhang Yue, who had previously possessed minimal knowledge about cultivation and related topics, had undergone a significant transformation following her two-week training under Feng Jinqiu. "Actually, I've already discussed this with Senior Jinqiu, and she was not sure that my idea would work. However, if you can combine your fire and darkness elements to form your dark flame, I believe that we should be able to combine our fire and ice elements."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before speaking. "Big Sis, the darkness and fire elements are different, but they are not opposing elements like fire and ice, so I can combine them easily."
"I know." Zhang Yue suddenly had an idea. "Fei'er, you have successfully combined your fire and darkness elements, so I want you to try combining your light and darkness elements."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before opening his palms again, and his darkness and light elements instantly appeared on them. "Step back first, Big Sis. I already understand your idea, but I have never tried combining these two opposing elements."

After Zhang Yue moved away from him, Zhang Fei carefully tried to merge his light and darkness elements, but it immediately exploded and pushed him several steps back. "Damn it! It's not easy, Big Sis. We should try it in the training space."
"All right."

Soon, they entered the training space, and Zhang Fei immediately sat cross-legged while thinking about how to combine his light and darkness elements. Unlike combining his beast and demon forms, combining two opposing elements was truly difficult.

Zhang Yue sat slightly apart from Zhang Fei, her entire attention fixed on the elements of light and darkness on his palms. 'If Fei'er could combine all his elements, he could create techniques that solely belonged to him, and he would definitely become truly powerful.'

Once he felt ready, Zhang Fei tried to merge his light and darkness elements again, but he failed once again. He then withdrew his light element and used his fire element, and he tried to merge it with his darkness element from scratch to get the feeling.

'Hmm? The feeling when combining my fire and darkness elements is completely different, and the two do not conflict with each other.' Zhang Fei then withdrew his darkness element and replaced it with his wind element, reducing its intensity before bringing it closer to his ordinary fire.
*Swoosh*

Zhang Fei's fire instantly flared as soon as his wind element touched it, and it flared even more once he increased its intensity, causing its color to turn reddish green. 'Wind can be a support for fire, and vice versa, so it's not difficult to combine the two elements.'

After he succeeded in combining the two elements, Zhang Fei then got up and tried a few things. First, he adjusted his fire so that it was dominant over his wind, then threw it far away, creating a powerful firestorm.

After that, Zhang Fei made his wind element more dominant than his fire element, but he did not throw it; he channeled it to both of his legs. Then, as he ran around the training ground at a steady pace, fire emerged with each step, creating a trail.

Once he was satisfied with the outcome, Zhang Fei immediately withdrew his fire element, replaced it with his darkness element, and attempted to combine it with his wind element. 'Wind and darkness, what would happen if I made one of them more dominant?'

[I believe the outcome is similar to the fusion of your darkness and fire elements, Master. Perhaps you can create two new techniques by combining your darkness and wind elements, such as a wind scythe that merges with darkness. If you use such a technique at night, your enemies will definitely have a hard time avoiding your attacks, especially if you combine it with your darkness corruption.]
'Yeah, you're right.'

paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5]'s ability to withstand the power of lightning within the lightning core shocked and amazed Guo Jizhe. 'How is this possible? His cultivation is only at the 3-Star Earth Realm; he shouldn't be able to last more than five minutes, yet he's been here for two hours. Moreover, he didn't look like he was in the slightest pain, and he used the lightning to temper his internal organs.'
Unfortunately, Guo Jizhe was unaware that Zhang Fei [5] had endured numerous powerful lightning tribulations and had already advanced to the fourth stage of his lightning body cultivation technique.
[Master, that guy looked down on you too much, and he is now shocked by your actions.]
Zhang Fei [5] chose not to respond to Mei's words. Instead, he asked him something else. 'Do you think Fa Zhen can breach the formation array on the sealed door?'

[The formation used to seal the sealed door is only a high-level intermediate-grade array, Master. Fa Zhen can create a mid-level advanced-grade array, so he should be able to breach that formation. However, we don't have any information about the demon behind the sealed door, so I think you should think twice about opening it, or the situation will become difficult.]

'Mei, this realm is only in the middle realms, and the cultivation of living creatures in this realm is no more than the Divine Expansion Realm, so I think Feng Yao and Shang Yumei should be able to defeat that demon.' Zhang Fei [5] paused for a while. 'I should take them to the sealed door before deciding whether to break it.'
[I think that's the best choice, Master. Perhaps Feng Yao can check the room behind the sealed door using her eye technique, and you can consider your next steps after that.]
'Yeah.'

"Those two damn bitches! I ordered them to contact their two daughters, but they brought members of their clans to the Hong Clan instead!" Shang Ziyuan contacted her brother using an interspatial communication device, informing Shang Huaqiang about them.

Shang Ziyuan did not have to wait long to get an answer from Shang Huaqiang, and her expression turned joyful after he told her about his new plans. "Heh! They can escape from me now, but they won't be able to escape anymore once the Murong and Hong Clans are destroyed, and I will destroy the Sun and Kang Clans then."

After that, Shang Ziyuan contacted her subordinates, who supervised the Shang clan branch and the Murong Clan. She ordered them to increase surveillance of Shang Chenguang, Shang Chongyun, Shang Tinglong, and Ran Keqing.

Shang Ziyuan also ordered them to capture the four people if they intended to escape. "If those four die, the Murong Clan will definitely weaken, and Murong Qianying will never dare to oppose me again."
Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue, who had already dressed, did not immediately return to their residence. Instead, they tried to combine their elements to create their fusion technique.
They had no difficulty combining Zhang Yue's ice element with Zhang Fei's darkness, wind, and light elements.

However, Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue found it difficult to combine their ice and fire elements, especially since both elements continued to repel each other. Even though they used their elements at a low intensity, the two elements exploded as soon as they came into contact.
Suddenly, Feng Yao and Shang Yumei landed on the small island, but they immediately exchanged astonished glances as they saw Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue trying to combine the two elements.
"Do you know how to combine our ice and fire elements, Feng Yao?" Zhang Fei asked her.

Feng Yao shook her head. "I have often seen other cultivators combine their fire element with other elements, but I have never met a crazy cultivator who has such a crazy idea of combining fire and ice elements or light and darkness elements, especially since they always conflict with one another."
"I also feel that your plan will never work, so you guys can stop doing something useless." Shang Yumei added.
Zhang Yue looked gloomy after hearing their words, but she was aware that combining her ice element with Zhang Fei's fire element was truly difficult. "Fei'er, let's—"

"Be patient, Big Sis." Zhang Fei immediately stood up and moved away from them. Zhang Fei then used his light element on his left hand and his darkness element on his right hand, causing Feng Yao and Shang Yumei to frown.

[Master, why don't you try asking Ursula? They have light and darkness elements in their body, and their elements have never had any conflict. The Amaris Twins also have light and darkness elements, and they have used techniques combining the two elements, so they might be able to give you some pointers on combining the two.]

'Oh! That's right! I forgot about them.' Ursula and the Amaris Twins arrived on the small island in a few moments, and Zhang Fei immediately questioned them. "How do you guys combine your light and darkness elements?"
"My lord, we didn't know about that, and we were able to do it as soon as we were born." The White Amaris was the first to answer.
The Black Amaris nodded in agreement with her twin sister. "My sister is telling the truth, my lord. We don't need to think about anything to combine our elements, and we can just do it like that."
After they said that, the Amaris Twins used their light and darkness elements, and they combined both without any significant difficulty.

Zhang Fei, Zhang Yue, Feng Yao, and Shang Yumei were shocked to see the small black-and-white vortex in front of them. It was clear in their eyes that the Amaris Twins' light and darkness elements blended perfectly without showing the slightest conflict.
"Have you ever seen something like this before, Princess Yao?" Shang Yumei questioned Feng Yao as she observed the small black-and-white vortex.
"This is the first time I've seen light and darkness elements merge like this." Feng Yao then turned to Ursula. "Try using your darkness and light elements."

Ursula nodded and opened their palm. In an instant, a black and a white snake appeared on their palms, and the two immediately merged into one. "Unlike you guys, our body has fused our darkness and light elements since birth, allowing us to use them directly together. However, I can tell that our light element is more dominant than our darkness element, especially since light can suppress darkness."
"So I have to make my light element more dominant than my darkness element, and I have to use my light to suppress my darkness, right?" Ursula nodded to Zhang Fei. "I'll try it now."

Zhang Fei immediately drew his light element closer to his darkness element, leading to an immediate conflict and instability between the two. He immediately increased the intensity of his light element, slowly swallowing his darkness element and nearly causing it to disappear.

Zhang Fei decided to increase the power of his darkness element to keep it from dissipating, and his light element slowly began to engulf it. Even though his darkness element continued to show resistance, his light element began to suppress it and continued to swallow it.

Sometime later, Zhang Fei's light element swallowed his darkness element, but it did not disappear. A speck of darkness appeared within his light element, indicating that he had successfully merged the two. "Damn! I did it!"

"Hmm?" Shang Yumei and Feng Yao leaned forward, observing the light ball on Zhang Fei's palm that contained the darkness element. "Try increasing the power of both of them! If it doesn't disappear, it means you have succeeded."
Zhang Fei nodded and followed the two women's request. He gradually increased the power of his light and darkness elements in sync, thereby preventing them from going haywire and exploding.

A while later, Zhang Fei's light ball was already quite large, and the darkness inside it became increasingly clear to their eyes. "I will try to increase the strength of my darkness element now and balance the two."
"You can try, but you must immediately reduce the strength of your darkness element once it fights back, or this light ball will explode."

Zhang Fei nodded and gradually increased the power of his darkness element, but it immediately fought back and caused the light ball to waver. He swiftly lowered its power again, making sure they achieved stability first.

Once they reached stability again, Zhang Fei began to increase the power of his darkness. However, he suddenly remembered something. 'Light is yang, and darkness is yin. I have often combined my Yang Qi and a woman's Yin Qi, so I will use that principle to combine my two elements.'

Zhang Fei then closed his eyes, envisioning the merging of Yang and Yin Qi while dual soul cultivating with all his women. Soon, the light ball and the darkness merged, forming a small Yin-Yang symbol on his palm.

Although the Yin-Yang symbol was not yet perfect due to the dominance of Zhang Fei's light element, both elements gradually reached the same strength as he increased the strength of his darkness element.
Sometime later, Feng Yao and Shang Yumei were shocked when the Yin-Yang symbol above Zhang Fei's palm was complete, and it began to rotate above his palm in balance.

Ursula and the Amaris Twins nodded in satisfaction after they saw that. Zhang Yue looked excited after Zhang Fei managed to combine his light and darkness elements perfectly, which increased her confidence that they could combine their ice and fire elements to create their ultimate combination technique.

Once Zhang Fei was confident that his two elements had reached a perfect equilibrium, he raised his hand, causing the Yin-Yang diagram to float high into the sky and then expand as it continued to rotate.

When the Yin-Yang diagram reached a large size, it immediately showered the area below with countless rays of light and darkness simultaneously, a phenomenon similar to Zhang Fei's Exorcismus ability.
*Boom... Boom... Boom...*
Naturally, all of Zhang Fei's attacks missed the six women and only struck a distant area, scattering dust everywhere.

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei laughed out loud as he used his wind element to blow away the dust. "Finally! I managed to create a technique using the combination of my light and dark elements! This way, I can fight demons and others at the same time, and such an area attack will be difficult for them to avoid."
"Congratulations, my lord." The Amaris Twins spoke in unison.
Ursula nodded to Zhang Fei. "The attack from your technique just now was really powerful, and the demons would be seriously injured if you hit them."
Zhang Yue immediately moved to Zhang Fei's side. "What if we try combining our ice and fire elements now?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei first turned to the Amaris Twins and Ursula, but he immediately sent them back to the training space and the Netherworld Realm.

Shang Yumei immediately spoke to them. "Unlike light and darkness, fire and ice will put up stronger resistance against each other. Therefore, you two should use both in small intensities, or you will suffer a backlash if you fail to combine them."

"Under normal conditions, ice will never win against fire. However, Zhang Yue's ice element is the ice of the ice phoenix, so it is extremely powerful." Feng Yao warned the two. "To combine the two elements, I think you should make your fire element more dominant than her ice, or your fire will freeze."

Zhang Fei nodded to them and led Zhang Yue to sit in front of him. However, they did not start right away, and he first spoke to Feng Yao and Shang Yumei. "By the way, I found a sealed door in the dungeon beneath the Bai royal palace, and I have confirmed with Linghu Yincheng that there is a demon sealed inside."
"A demon?" That surprised Feng Yao and Shang Yumei.

"Yes." Zhang Fei then asked Feng Yao and Shang Yumei to come closer to him, and he shared the memories he got from Linghu Yincheng with them. "I will try to combine my fire element with my Big Sis's ice element, so I hope you two can help me check the sealed door. Actually, I tried to check it yesterday, but I couldn't check through the formation array on it."

Feng Yao and Shang Yumei exchanged glances for a moment before they nodded to Zhang Fei. After they disappeared, he immediately used his fire element, and Zhang Yue used her ice element with a low intensity. "Let's do it slowly, Big Sis. I'm sure we'll make it, but it might take us quite a while to succeed."
"Yeah." Zhang Yue nodded at Zhang Fei. "Take the lead, Fei'er."
Meanwhile, Feng Yao and Shang Yumei arrived at the dungeon beneath the Bai royal kingdom. The two immediately checked the sealed door that Zhang Fei had mentioned.
<Yumei, the information from Zhang Fei is indeed correct because I can feel a strong demon from behind this door.> Huli Yaohu suddenly spoke.
"Hmm?" Shang Yumei raised her eyebrows as the formation array prevented her from sensing any demon aura. 'Do you know the identity of that demon, master?'

<I don't know the identity of the demon for sure, but I think it is an ancient demon based on this demon's aura. The formation array is only a high-level intermediate-grade array, but it is an ancient formation, so the demon has been sealed inside for a very long time>

Unlike Shang Yumei, Feng Yao could sense the demon aura, even though the formation array blocked it. She then placed her hand on the formation to analyze it. 'Ling'er, can you infiltrate this formation array? The demon behind this door shouldn't be that strong, but I'm afraid it's not just any demon, and it might have some special ability that forces the people of this realm to seal it.'
[Why don't you just destroy this formation array, master? It is too easy for you, and you can also exterminate the demon inside by using your phoenix flames.]

'If the demon inside is an ancient demon, it will be useful to Zhang Fei, so I want you to check inside to confirm its identity first. If it's just an ordinary demon, I'll destroy this formation and exterminate it.' Feng Yao's answer caused Huo Ling to sigh helplessly, and she immediately left the Phoenix Princess's body before sneaking into the sealed door.
"Is that girl a fire spirit, Princess Yao?"

Feng Yao nodded to Shang Yumei. "Her name is Huo Ling, and we've been together for a very long time. Anyway, you should not mention her to Zhang Fei; I don't want him to know anything about her, at least for now."

"Why don't you want Zhang Fei to know about Huo Ling?" Shang Yume inquired in confusion, but Feng Yao chose to remain silent. "All right, I won't tell him anything about her, and you can tell him yourself in the future."
"That's good." Feng Yao replied with a light nod.
Huli Yaohu suddenly spoke to Shang Yumei again. <Hey, I feel that Feng Yao is deliberately hiding something from Zhang Fei, but I can't guess her plans for him.

'I feel the same way as you, master.' Shang Yumei stole a glance at Feng Yao before continuing. 'Somehow, I feel that this woman is much more mysterious than she shows us, and I think that her secrets might be directly related to Zhang Fei.'
Before long, Huo Ling had already come out from behind the sealed door and entered Feng Yao's body again. [Master, the demon behind this door is the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast.]

'The Ancient Devourer Demon Beast, huh? I didn't expect to find such a demon beast sealed in this realm." Feng Yao then spoke to Shang Yumei. "The demon beast inside is quite powerful, and it will be very useful to Zhang Fei. Therefore, we don't need to do anything, and we can wait for him to be ready to deal with it."
"A demon beast? What kind of demon beast is there?"
"The Ancient Devourer Demon Beast."

Zhang Fei thought of doing so because combining auras was much easier than combining their elements directly. Just as he expected, his fire aura could fuse with Zhang Yue's ice aura without the slightest resistance, giving them a deeper understanding of combining their elements.
"Big Sis." Zhang Fei called out to her as his dark fire appeared on his palm. He deliberately used it because Zhang Yue's ice element would freeze his ordinary fire if the two came into contact.
Zhang Yue nodded slightly and opened her palm. In an instant, an ice lotus appeared above it. "I'm ready."

<If you look closely, their elements are still showing resistance to each other, but their resistance is not as violent as before, mainly because Zhang Fei used his darkness element to prevent Zhang Yue's ice element from freezing his dark fire. As long as they can make their elements reach perfect equilibrium, they will probably succeed in combining the two.>
'I see.' Shang Yumei nodded in understanding, and a beautiful smile spread across her face. 'The more I know about him, the more I like him.'

<Hahaha.> Huli Yaohu laughed out loud when she heard this. <A few months ago, you were constantly upset and angry because you couldn't subdue Zhang Fei, but now you are no different from a little girl crazy about your lover, and you became submissive to him.>
Shang Yumei pouted her lips in response to that. 'You're enjoying my situation, right? You can dual soul cultivate with Zhang Fei every day, which will gradually strengthen your soul.
<Hehehe!>
