"If Zhang Fei kills our cousin, his parents will gang up on him and make matters worse." Yun Qinghai added.
Yun Xinyue then asked her mother. "Didn't Cousin Jihai already return to the Guo Clan at dawn? He should have already arrived there, right?"

"Do you think Jizhe will be willing to listen to Jihai?" Yun Xinyue, Yun Qinghai, and Li Yao shook their heads at Guo Xuehua. "The only person who can control him is Aoxian, so I sent your big brother there. Otherwise, he will die in Zhang Fei's hands, and it will not only ruin our good relationship with him, but it will also ruin your relationship with him."
"Haha." Yun Xinyue laughed instead. "Zhang Fei is not that petty, Mother. Even if he has a problem with the Guo Clan, I'm sure he would never hate me."
"So, how far has your relationship with Zhang Fei progressed?" Yun Shang suddenly asked her daughter.

Yun Xinyue shrugged her shoulders. "My relationship with Zhang Fei has gotten better after I lived with him and the others, but we haven't stepped into a more intimate relationship yet. I know he can't wait to have intimate things with me, but I'm not ready for it yet, so he never forces me."
"I see." Yun Shang then asked her daughter-in-law a question. "What about you, Yao'er?"
Li Yao lowered her face. "Father, I've started to show signs of pregnancy."
"Eh? Is that true, sister-in-law? Are you pregnant now?" Yun Xinyue exclaimed loudly.
Guo Xuehua grabbed Li Yao's hand and checked her body. "Yao'er's pregnancy is already two weeks old."
"Wow! I'll be an aunt in a few months!" Yun Xinyue exclaimed excitedly.

"Why didn't you tell us before?" Guo Xuehua asked her daughter-in-law. We wouldn't have sent you to the Zhou Kingdom if you'd told us about your pregnancy. Fortunately, nothing bad happened to you, or you would have miscarried."
Li Yao looked apologetic and answered, "Mother, I started feeling signs of my pregnancy two days ago. The areas we explored before weren't too dangerous, so I haven't told you about it yet."

"From now on, I won't allow you to go anywhere, and you have to stay here to focus on your pregnancy. Do you understand?" After Li Yao nodded, Guo Xuehua spoke to her husband. "I will take Yao'er to the Li Clan, and our in-laws will be thrilled to hear about her pregnancy."
"All right, you can bring Yao'er to visit them." Yun Shang immediately agreed.
Guo Xuehua immediately took Li Yao with her to go to the Li Clan, but Yun Xinyue decided to go with them, especially since Zhang Fei was still busy with Zhang Yue.
Meanwhile, Yun Shang took his second son away to train him in the art of war, especially since Yun Qinghai himself took the initiative to learn.
Four women were sitting together, discussing various topics when Xian Xianqin suddenly asked her sister-in-law a question. "Are you pregnant now, Yin?"
"Huh?" Yao Yin looked at Xian Xianqin in surprise. "Why do you ask that? Qinghai and I have only been married for five days, so I can't possibly get pregnant right away."
"Actually, that's possible, Yin'er." Xian Changyue said to her niece-in-law. "Moreover, you and Xianwu have been doing that every day since you two got married, and you might be pregnant by now."
Yao Yin's face flushed red with embarrassment upon hearing Xian Changyue's comment. Since their marriage, they have been doing this every night without considering the possibility of having children.

Shi Qingzhuang smiled at her daughter-in-law's shyness, but she immediately grabbed Yao Yin's hand to check whether she was pregnant. Soon, she sighed gently and informed her daughter and sister-in-law of the news. "I haven't found a life force inside her womb, so I'm sure that she's not pregnant."
"In that case, you and Xianwu should do it more often, Yin'er."
Xian Xianqin immediately spoke. "I agree with Aunt Changyue, Yin! The sooner you get pregnant, the better, and it would be even better if you get pregnant with twins like me and Xianwu."

"Qin, it's not easy to become pregnant, especially with twins." Yao Yin refuted her sister-in-law with a shake of her head. "Rather than you think about my pregnancy, you better think about your relationship with Zhang Fei. You two haven't had your first night, so you are a virgin wife now."

Xian Xianqin released a helpless sigh in response to that. "To tell you the truth, I still feel that my relationship with Zhang Fei feels surreal between dream and reality. At first, I thought our relationship wouldn't progress to the next stage for the next few years, but we are husband and wife now. If I had known our relationship would be this fast, I would have postponed my breakthrough to the Seven Divine Realm, and we wouldn't have had to postpone our first night. His physique is indeed superior to that of other cultivators at his level, but he won't be able to withstand my virgin Yin Qi, and he will undoubtedly explode if we do that now."

"I see." Yao Yin nodded in understanding. "With Zhang Fei's cultivation speed and the number of his other women, I don't think you will have to wait too long. Perhaps he will successfully break through to the Seven Divine Realms in two years, and the two of you can do it by then."

"You are right." Xian Xianqin replied with a nod of approval. "Zhang Fei told us that his cultivation is almost stable, and he will break through to the 4-Star Earth Realm by then. Anyway, we will enter seclusion after he carries out his plan for Zhou Xiaochuan, and we won't be coming out for a few months, so his cultivation will probably have reached the Heaven Realm by the time we come out."
"Qin'er, could you convince Zhang Fei to take Yin'er and Xianwu into seclusion with you?" Shi Qingzhuang inquired.
Xian Changyue nodded in agreement. "If you persuade him, Zhang Fei might be willing to take them with us, Qin'er."

"All right." Xian Xianqin immediately agreed, especially since Zhang Fei also brought many people who were not his family members into the training space. "He and Zhang Yue are trying to create a new technique now, so I'll talk to him later."
After that, they engaged in various conversations until Xian Feng and Xian Xianwu joined them, at which point they proceeded directly to the Sky Jade Restaurant for dinner.

A group of disciples from the Xian Imperial Sect had just arrived at the Sky Jade Shop. They had long since returned from the Star Tower, but they had never visited it because they had gone straight to practice as soon as they returned, except for Bai Tian'er.
Moreover, Yuan Luo and the other two female disciples were curious about Zhang Fei's other wives, and Bai Tian'er told them that they could meet some of his women there.

"Let's go in, Brother Chu! We have to buy some supplies for our wedding preparations, especially the mattress." Ximen Chuixue immediately followed Yuan Luo into the shop. Ru Yanyue and the others also followed behind them.
Not long after they entered, two other women also walked into the shop. They were Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, and Zhang Fei asked the two to go there after they finished their mission.
Zhang Lingxue immediately recognized their identities. "You guys are the disciples of the Xian Imperial Sect who went with my husband to the Star Tower, right?"
"Are you one of Zhang Fei's wives?" Ru Yanyue asked.

"My name is Zhang Lingxue, and I am one of his wives." Zhang Lingxue's answer confused them, especially since she had the same surname as Zhang Fei. "My husband and I have the same surname, but we are from two different realms, so we are not related."
Yuan Luo then pointed at the Chu Sisters. "Are they also his wives?"
"Yes, Chu Ying and Chu Qing are blood sisters." Zhang Lingxue then turned to Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying. "You two can go to the back room, and one of my sisters will take you to our residence."
Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying nodded to Zhang Lingxue and hurried to the backroom, but they stole glances at the three female disciples of the Xian Imperial Sect, especially since they knew them.
"Sister Lingxue, aren't those two women Huangfu Lian's women?" Ye Zhiqiu inquired. "I once engaged in a practice sparring match with the disciples of their sect, and I saw him with them back then."

Zhang Lingxue nodded to her. "You are right; they are indeed Huangfu Lian's women, but my husband snatched them. In fact, the Huangfu Prince is under his control now, so he won't be able to do anything."

Ximen Chuixue and the others were no longer surprised to hear that, especially considering how many unbelievable things Zhang Fei had done while they were still in the Star Tower. If it weren't for him, some of them wouldn't have made it past the first floor.
Yuan Luo suddenly hugged Zhang Lingxue's arm. "Sister, please explain to us the goods in this shop, and we will buy several kinds, especially mattresses."

"All right, I will explain everything to you all, and you guys can choose the one that suits you best." Zhang Lingxue then led the three women to look through each item, but she did not take them to the sex toy counter.
Ximen Chuixue and the male disciples went to the sex toy counter, and a member of the demon fox group explained everything to them, which made them shocked and curious at the same time.

Several hours had passed since Zhang Yue and Zhang Fei started, and the sun was already in the west and about to set. However, a dark flame encircled an ice lotus, spinning between them. Even though the lotus was still small and not yet perfect, it showed their success in combining their elements.

Feng Yao and Shang Yumei stared at the lotus in awe. Moreover, the lotus was not only created from ice and fire elements, but Zhang Fei also merged his darkness element into it, and it became blackish blue with red around it.
"We did it, Big Sis." Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction.

Zhang Yue was overjoyed as she looked at the lotus. "Even though we had difficulties at first, our hard work over the hours has paid off, and we have successfully created our first combined technique. What is the suitable name for this technique, Fei'er?"

"Hellflame Frost Lotus." Zhang Yue was taken aback by the name, to which Zhang Fei promptly provided an explanation. "My dark flame is one of my demon cultivation techniques, the hellflame incantation, and it can burn everything to ashes. Your ice element is from the ice phoenix, and it can freeze anything. Therefore, I think that name is most suitable for this technique, but we still need to perfect it further, and it will produce extraordinary effects."
Zhang Yue nodded in understanding. "All right, we will use the Hellflame Frost Lotus for this technique."

After that, Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue pulled their Qi back, and the lotus instantly disappeared. He then lifted his big sister to her feet and looked at Feng Yao and Shang Yumei. "What do you two think about our combined technique?"

"Marvelous!" Shang Yumei was the first to answer. "Unfortunately, it is a combined technique, so you cannot use it without your big sister. Moreover, it takes some time to use it, so you cannot use it openly, especially since your enemies will not give you a chance to use it."

Feng Yao nodded in agreement with Shang Yumei. "If you were the same as other cultivators, you wouldn't have had the time to use that technique. Fortunately, you have your invisibility ability, so you can use it before using the lotus, and your enemies won't be aware of it."
"Yeah, you two are right." Zhang Fei then enveloped them with his aura. "The sun is almost setting, and the others have probably returned to our residence, so we should go home now."

"Big Brother!" Xu Ling'er called out to Zhang Fei. She then pulled the wolf girl over to Zhang Fei and said, "Can you take us to the Earth? Tasha is curious about our home, so I want to take her for a walk there."

"It should still be daytime on Earth, so it won't be a problem if we go there." Zhang Fei then looked at Tasha, who still seemed afraid of him. "You don't have to be afraid of me, okay? Your father entrusted you to me, so I will never hurt you, and I will help you improve yourself."
"Thank you, Big Brother." Tasha answered in a low voice.
Zhang Fei rubbed Tasha's head, and he immediately took the two little girls to the Earth after Mei opened the gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 Zhou Xiaochuan's Return
paragraphs: "Ling'er, you can take Tasha to walk around the city, and I will take all the goods for our shops in the Nine Stars Realm." Zhang Fei promptly departed after giving Xu Ling'er a substantial amount of money.
"The air here is much more foul than in the Netherworld Realm, Ling'er." After all, Tasha was a demon wolf, and her sense of smell was too keen, forcing her to cover her nose with Qi.

"Hehehe." Xu Ling'er laughed as she pulled Tasha out of Zhang Chen's house. "The air here is bad, but there are many delicious foods and snacks here. I'm sure you'll like them, but we have to go to the city first."
"Show me the direction, and I'll take you there directly." After Xu Ling'er showed her the directions to the city, Tasha immediately took her there, and they spent quite a lot of time together.
Xu Ling'er took Tasha to various places, such as the amusement park. She also brought the wolf girl to try various Earth snacks, such as ice cream and other types of snacks.
After visiting his country's warehouse, Zhang Fei swiftly traveled to various countries on Earth to gather all the goods available in warehouses.

Although the quantity of the goods was slightly smaller than his estimate, Zhang Fei felt that it was enough to fill his fourth shop in the Bai Kingdom. Additionally, he asked Huang Rong's subordinates to prepare various modern kitchen equipment for his fourth restaurant, and he left for Paris after he had finished everything.

Both women were stunned for a moment as soon as Zhang Fei appeared in front of them, but Jiang Yinghua let out a soft sigh as she felt helpless to stop him from sneaking into their apartment. "Why did you suddenly come here again?"
"Did you and Meng Tianshi return to the Tian Realm two days ago?" Zhang Fei asked her back.

"Yes." Jiang Yinghua nodded before telling him. "Lord Gabriel asked us to come back to take care of something, and we came back last night. Anyway, the Throne has become more active, and he will probably order his subordinates to descend here sooner than we previously thought."

Zhang Fei casually responded to the matter. "The sooner they get here, the better. Seraph must be prepared to lose his subordinates, especially since my subordinates will never let any of them go, and I order them to slaughter them."

"Can you ask your subordinates not to slaughter them?" Zhang Fei just smiled at Jiang Yinghua, especially since he would never change his mind about the winged race, leaving her helpless. "So, what is the purpose of your visit this time?"
Jiang Yinghua's eyes widened when Zhang Fei used his new light element technique, especially since the light figure was her own.

Unlike her, Meng Tianshi immediately approached the light figure and looked at it up and down. "Hey, Jinghua! The woman's figure bears a striking resemblance to you, yet it originates from a pure and powerful light element. Even our light element pales in comparison to this one."

"Since you are a winged race, and you have the light element, I deliberately used your figure to create my newest technique." Jiang Yinghua glared at Zhang Fei, but he returned it with a smile.
